tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (pa)༄༅/ /chos tshan brgya dang brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ston pa nyid kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum dang*/
(pa)༄༅/ /chos tshan brgya dang brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ston pa nyid kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum dang*/

tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// chos tshan brgya dang brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ ston pa nyid kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum dang*/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug gi bstan bcos rnams dang*/ grub pa'i dbang phyug mang po pa dag gi gsung rabs la 'jug pa'i sgo ma nor ba nyid du rnam par dbye ba'i chos tshan brgya dang brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i bstan chos/ chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du// rnam sangs rgyas pa'i thub kho na// chos smra kun gyi mgon dang ni// dpal du grub pa 'di ya mtshan// gang yang 'di na chos dang srid kyi ngo mtshar ltad mo sna tshogs mngon par ston pa'i rig byed rnam bzhi'i byed por khas len gyur pa'i drang srong rgyas pa des kyang zab mo'i chos kyi de nyid gang 'di nges par ma bsams tshu rol nyid kyi mtha' la gnas// tshu rol srid pa nyid la mngon par dga' ba'i sred pa btang nas gang zag dang ni chos 'ga' yi yang bdag med gnas la gdeng thob gyur pa de dag gis kyang rgya che'i chos kyi khang bzang der zhugs yod min pas na pha rol nyid kyi 'gram la gnas// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rnam rol gyi ni stobs ldan dregs pa'i khengs pa 'phrog byed 'jug pa rnam bcu'i gar mkhan des kyang zab dang rgya che'i tshul 'di ma bsams kho nar ma zad srid zhi'i dbang phyug nyid du khas len de yang yid kyi shing rta'i khyim du nyal// bdag lta'i ri bos non pa min pa'i chos 'di dang ni rigs pa'i gnas gzhan mang po dag gi dregs pas myos gang kun gyis phyag byas kho bo'i ston pa sna tshogs 'byin byed gser gyi padma'i mngal can dang mtshungs tshangs pa'i 'khor lo rigs par bskor mdzad de la phyag bgyi'o// zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i// chos kyi rnam bzhag ma nor bar// ston mdzad thub pa nyid dang ni// 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug po// de yi srol chen phal che ba// ma nyams grub dang 'chad mkhas ni// gangs can ljongs 'dir sngon byon pa// mang zhig dag pa'i zhing gzhan du// gshegs nas 'di na ring zhig lon// ding sang phyis byung gtam mang po// dag dang bsres nas gang smra ba// ma 'dres gsal bar bya don du// chos tshan brgya dang brgyad pa zhes// rnam par grags pa'i lde mig gis// chos 'khor gnad kyi sgo gsum po// rigs par phye ba 'di yin no// zhes mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/

thog mar ni// na mo buddha ya/ pha rol phyin pa'i 'bras bu yi// mthar thug chos kyi sku yin te// yon tan kun dang dbyer med pa'i// ye shes chos dang chos nyid sku// gzhan snang gzugs kyi sku gnyis po// kun rdzob dang ni sems can gyi// rnam par shes pas bsdus so zhes// gsung ba rje btsun byams pa'i gzhung*// sgrib kun spangs pa'i chos kyi dbyings// stong nyid kho na chos sku dang*// smon lam dang ni bsod nams kyis// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur snang ba// sangs rgyas rang dang sems can gyi// shes rgyud kyis kyang bsdus min pa// zla ba'i mtshan dang zhi ba lha'i// rtsod bral gzhung du gsal bar gsungs// theg mchog rtse mor 'bras bu yi// mthar thug zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs// sangs rgyas nyid kyi sas bsdus pa// kho nar ma zad gzhan snang du// rnam bcas blo la gang shar ba// de yang kun rdzob sgyu ma'i sku// nyams len byed po'i ye shes dang*// gnyis su med pa kho na'o// 'di ni 'phags skor 'chad po 'ga'// rdzogs sangs rgyas la rang rgyud kyis// bsdus pa'i ye shes med pa nyid// thad sor bzhag nas 'bras bu yi// mthar thug zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs// sa bcu pa la 'chad pa ni// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo sogs kyi// rjes su 'brangs nas 'chad ces gsungs// de 'dra slob pa'i zung 'jug tu// srid kyang mi slob pa yi min// 'od gsal ba dang zung 'jug pa// gnyis ka med par dgag pa las// gzhan du 'jog tshul ma rnyed pas// rim pa lnga yi rnam gzhag nyams// ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa yis// bshad pa ji bzhin kha sbyor gyi// yan lag bdun dang ldan pa ni// sngags kyi 'bras bu'i mthar thug go/ //shubhaṃ// ༄// na mo dharmā ya/ bstan pa'i snying po sdom pa gsum// rim par mnos pas ldan tshul ni// gnas gyur ngo bo gcig pa dang*// zil gnon rdzas gzhan ma nyams par// 'dod pa'i lugs so gnas gyur ni// rje btsun gyis gsungs paṇa chen ni// ngo bo gcig par bzhed pa yang*// lung dang rigs pa'i stobs kyi grub// lugs de cung zad rgyas bshad na// gnas zhes bya ba chos dbyings kyi// ye shes nyid las logs shig tu// 'chad na mkhas pa'i bshad pa min// gyur pa zhes bya gnas skabs skyon// bral nas yon tan gong 'phel la// 'chad pa shing rta'i srol gnyis kyi// gzhung las gsal bar gsungs de'i phyir// rnam byang yon tan ji snyed kyi// gnas ni chos dbyings ye shes te// de goms pa las goms pa po'i// sems kyi ngo bo nyid du 'gyur// so thar dge slong sdom pa ni// ldan pas theg chen sems bskyed tshe// nges 'byung lhag med don gnyer gyi// sems pa spangs nas rdzogs pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' nyid du gyur// de nas rdo rje sems dpar ni// dbang bskur pa las skyes de gsum// ngo bo gzhan min pa'i sgrub byed// sems can kun kyang rnam shes dang*// ye shes rgyud re re bar nges// gsum po ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir// gzhi mthun nyid du 'gyur zhe na// gsum ka gnas pa'i shes rgyud der// 'gal phyir gzhi mthun srid ma yin// ci phyir zhe na 'thob byed kyi// rgyu dang thob pa'i ngo bo dang*// gtong rgyu 'gal ba nyid phyir te// dus 'dir dge slong thob byed rgyu// mngon gyur bcu las gzhan med la// sems bskyed pa dang sngags kyi sdom// 'thob byed de las gzhan du nges// dge slong yang ni de dag gi

/'thob byed rgyu las skye mi srid// thob pa'i ngo bo lus ngag gi /rjes 'brang dang ni yid kho na'i// rjes su 'brang dang ye shes kyi// dbang du byas pa nyid yin phyir// gtong rgyu yang ni smon pa'i sems// btang bas gong ma gnyis gtong yang*// dge slong sdom gtong min phyir dang*// 'dul bar grags pa'i pham pa bzhi// gong mar gnang ba'i skabs srid kyang*// 'og mar gnang ba'i skabs yod min// 'o na de dag phan tshun du// gtong rgyur thal ba min nam zhes// zer na dgag bya dgos pa dag /gtso bo gang che'i dbang byas tshe// byang chub sems dpa'i dgos pa yis// so thar dgag bya mi khegs pa// srid mod sdom pa gong 'og dag /phan tshun gtong rgyur song bas min// gsum ldan shes rgyud gcig nyid la// sdom gsum ldog pa tha dad kyang*// rdzas ni shes rgyud gcig po nyid// yon tan du ma'i rten yin no// sdom gsum la sogs chos rnams kun// don dam ngo bo gcig gyur kyang*// gzhi mthun med phyir kun rdzob tu// ngo bo gcig par 'gal zhe na// mi 'gal bum sogs rags pa dang*// de rtsom byed pa'i rdul phran nam// nags tshal phreng ba dmag sogs kyi// mthun pa'i dpe las rigs par shes// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ dkon mchog gsum po re re la// kun rdzob dang ni don dam dang*// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i skyabs gnyis su// 'byed pa byams pa'i gzhung du byung*// zla grags kun rdzob ma gtogs pa'i// don dam skyabs gnas khas mi len// 'on kyang 'jig rten la grags bzhin// gnas skabs bden pa gnyis su'ang dbye// 'dul bar grags pa'i dkon mchog gsum// kun rdzob grags pa tsam la ni// gtso bor bzung nas skyabs 'gro ba'i// shes byed don dam pa la 'chad// sngags kyi sgrub pa la zhugs nas// rang bzhin chos sku ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan yod par mi bzhed na// dkon mchog gsum po smos ci dgos// khyad par dam chos 'chad po dang*// bshad bya'i chos dang nyan po dang*// sgrub pa po yang nga nyid ces// bshad phyir don dam pa kho na// de phyir rdo rje'i theg par ni// sangs rgyas dang ni sems can dang*// byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed pa// chos dbyings ye shes las gzhan min// 'on kyang glo bur dri ma yis// dag dang ma dag pa nyid dang*// dag ma dag pa'i dbye ba yis// skyabs dang skyabs su 'gro bor dbye// mdor na rig pa 'dzin pa yi// dge 'dun don dam pa nyid de// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dge 'dun ni// nyan thos sogs dang khyad par che// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o//

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄// na mo gu ra we/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi// rgyun gyi nyams len byed pa'i tshe// sgrub pa po dang sgrub bya dang*// sgrub pa'i bla ma gsum ka yang*// 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin nyid du// mtshungs na gang gis gang zhig sgrub// gang la gang gis zhen pa spong*// gang gis gang la dngos grub len// snyam na gzhan rkyen byin rlabs dang*// gzhi dus rang bzhin rnam dag dang*// nyams len thabs kyi sgrub po yang*// rnam pa lhag pa'i lhar bzhengs pa'i// blo ni log par mi bsam ste// zhen pas zhugs nas 'brel pa yis// 'jug pa'i yul la mi bslu ba// tshad ma nyid du 'chad phyir ro// sgrub pos rang nyid lam dus kyi// dgyes pa rdo rje'i skur bzhengs nas// 'bras dus rdor 'dzin nyid du ni// zhen par mi byed de yi tshe// bla ma nyes pa kun bral zhing*// yon tan ma lus rdzogs pa yi// 'bras dus rdo rje 'dzin nyid du// tshad mas shes nas dngos grub len// tshad ma yid ches lung las te// bstan chos slob dpon tshad ma dang*// lung gi rjes 'brang de nyid rig /ces pa skabs 'dir lung nyid phyir// sgrub pa po la mtshungs min te// rang gi shes rgyud mngon sum du// gyur dang bla ma'i thugs rdo rje// lkog tu gyur pa nyid phyir ro// rnam shes dag par ma gyur pa'i// sgrub pa po des ma dag lus// sbyang rtogs sbar gsum gyis bsgrub pa// de tshe zhen pa spangs zhes bshad// zhen pa de yang gang zhe na// tshogs pa'i lus la gang zag gi /bdag tu zhen dang cha shas la// chos kyi bdag tu zhen pa'o// lam dus dgyes pa rdo rje yis// 'bras dus dgyes pa rdo rje las// dbang bzhi po dang thun mong gi /dngos grub blangs nas de bsgrub bya// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma yi// rnam bzhag ngos 'dzin tshig le'ur byas// chos tshan brgya dang brgyad po yi// thog mar dge ba 'di bzung bya// dge'o//

// ༄/ zab rgya'i snying po bsdus pa rin chen gter mdzod chos tshan brgyad pa ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo mañdzu badzrā ya/ dbu ma chen po'i ngos 'dzin la// 'phags pa'i yul dang bod 'dir yang*// rang rang blo yis nyer brtags pa'i// 'dod tshul mi mthun 'dir bsam bya// slob dpon zla ba grags pa ni// stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i chos// gzhan gyis gsal bar ma bshad phyir// rang gzhung dbu ma che zhes zer// 'phags pa thogs med mched bcas ni// thal rang gzhung gi stong pa nyid// nyams su myong byar mi rung phyir// chad smra nyid du ltung zhes gsung*// thal rang smra rnams byams chos dang*// 'khor lo gsum pa'i nges don la// sems tsam pa zhes sgro btags nas// nam yang dbu mar mi rung zer// mai tri pa sogs thal rang gi /dbu mas mtshan 'dzin 'gog pa'i phyir// dbu ma 'bring po tsam zhig ste// dbu ma chen po sngags la 'chad// bod 'ga' dbu ma thal 'gyur ba// ma gtogs sngags kyi dbu ma med// thal 'gyur rigs pas ma btsal na// sngags kyi dbu ma mi rtogs zer// de dag rim bzhin brtag bya ba// rigs pas gtan la phab pa yi// stong pa nyid dang 'phags blo yis// nyams su myong bya'i stong nyid ces// tshad ldan rtsod pa kun bral ba'i// mdo rgyud gzhung mang rab las gsungs// dang po phung po rnam bcad dang*// gnyis pa rnam kun mchog ldan no// rnam grol mngon du byed pa la// stong nyid dang po gtso che ste// yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa la// rnam kun mchog ldan gtso bor bzhed// stong nyid ces bya med dgag las// gzhan mi bzhed pa thal rang gzhung*// rnam rtogs gis stong ye shes la// 'chad pa chos 'khor gsum pa'i lugs// lung las dbu ma rnam gsum ste// rnal 'byor spyod dang thal rang du// grags dang sngags kyi dbu ma zhes// 'di gsum brtag pa gnyis par bshad// dang po byams pa'i gzhung las te// gzhan stong gnyis med ye shes so// gnyis pa klu sgrub gzhung las te// rang stong med par dgag pa'o// gsum pa gsang sngags bla med las// bde stong zung du 'jug ces bshad// ngo bo nyid med smra ba las// gzhan pa'i dbu ma pa med na// gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad du// zung 'jug ces bya 'chad mi nus// sngags kyi dbu mar gzung 'dzin gnyis// bkag nas lhan skyes nyams myong phyir// thogs med mched kyi dbu ma yang*// de las gzhan du bshad mi nus// mdor na gzhung lugs gang gang du// nyams su myong bya'i stong nyid dang*// de rtogs byed pa'i thabs gnyis ka

/gang du yod de dbu ma che// thabs la rnam pa gnyis bshad de// pha rol phyin par thos bsam dang*// tshul chen theg par dbang bskur dang*// lus kyi byed pa bcings sogs so// sngags kyi rgyud dang bstan bcos dang*// man ngag gzhung lugs so sor yang*// gnyis ka gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir// dbu ma che la rtsod pa med// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtshor yang*// mtshan 'dzin 'gog pa'i rigs pa dang*// mtshan med ye shes gnyis bstan phyir// byams pa'i gzhung lnga dbu ma che// sngags dang khyad par ci yod na// thabs la zab dang mi zab dang*// dus ring ba dang myur ba dang*// myong bya bzang ngan khyad par ro// ngo bo nyid med smra gzhung du// rigs pas gtan la gang phebs pa// de nyid myong byar bstan to zhes// gangs can 'di na dbu ma par// grags pa de kun mthun par smra// de dag de gzhung dang mi mthun// rtogs bya ci yang ma rnyed pa// de la rjes kyi shes pa yis// stong nyid mthong zhes tha snyad btags// 'di ni phar phyin rkyang pa yis// lam bgrod tshe na dbu ma che// sngags su thos bsam gyis shes pa'i// stong nyid dug can lta bar bshad// sngags pas rigs pa'i tshogs gzhung la// dbu ma chen por 'chad pa'i tshe// bstod pa'i tshogs kyi nges don dang*// sbrel nas bshad na legs par 'gyur// rgyud blar thos bsam rigs pa dang*// rigs pa'i tshogs su myong bya dag /gsal bar bshad pa med pa'i phyir// ji ltar dbu ma che zhe na// rigs pas dpyad pa'i stong pa nyid// myong byar byas na dug can yang*// myong byed rtog pa'i ngor song ba// myong ba mchog ces tha snyad 'dogs// rgyud blar stong nyid ston pa yi// rigs pa 'di la bsal bya dang*// yang dag mtha' ni zhes sogs kyis// gzhan stong tshul de gsal bar bshad// rtogs bya dri bcas de bzhin nyid// ces pa'i ming can zag med kyi// ye shes nyid la bshad pas na// dbu ma che la rtsod pa med// 'di yi rtsa 'grel thal 'gyur gyi// lugs zhes zer ba 'chol ba'i gtam// 'dir zag med ye shes la// rigs pa'i dpyad pa ci byas kyang*// don dam nyid du gnas par bzhed// thal 'gyur bas na rang stong zer// zla bas so sor rang rig gi

/ye shes mo gsham bu 'drar bshad// 'dir ni so sor rang rig gi /ye shes lam gyi mchog tu bzhed// zla bas mi gnas myang ngan 'das// kun rdzob bden zhes gsal bar bshad// rigs pa'i tshogs su ye shes kyi// myong bya dngos su ma bshad pa// 'di la 'phags dang bod yul du// rnam par rtog pa mang zhig byung*// chos grags zhi 'tsho la sogs pa// 'phags blo rang gis rang rig 'dod// legs ldan 'byed kyis rang rig pa// 'gog kyang 'phags blo rgyun mi chad// ye shes snying po 'phags pa'i blo// don dam stong nyid kun rdzob zer// mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gzhung du// shes rnam nyams su myong byar bshad// rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung dag tu// sems tsam dbu ma rnam gnyis gsungs// sems tsam pa la rnam bden rdzun// gzhung chen dag las bshad pa med// rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma la// sems tsam zer ba legs ldan dang*// zla ba'i gzhung las 'byung mod kyi// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtshor yang*// gnyis med rang rig rang gsal ba// rang gi ngo bos stong pa yi// rigs pa mi 'chad pa la dgongs// de yi rigs pa ma bshad kyang*// de la zhen pa'i rtog pa ni// rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir// spang bya nyid du bshad pa na// shes bya'i sgrib pa kun las grol// 'khor lo gsum pa'i nges don la// sems tsam pa yi lugs yin zhes// zer ba sngags gzhung mtha' dag dang*// byams pa'i gzhung lugs kun na med// yod na byams chos rnam gsum gyi// nges pa'i don de chos mchog las// gong du bgrod pa med 'gyur te// sems tsam nyid las der bshad phyir// dbyig gnyen sogs la stong pa nyid// mthar phyin med ces gsung na yang*// sgrib kun sel nus nges don mchog /med ces gsung bar mi rigs te// gsang sngags gzhung du lhan skyes kyi// ye shes nges pa'i don du bshad// 'dir yang gdod ma'i ye shes nyid// don dam dngos su bshad phyir ro// thogs med zhabs kyis drang don dang*// nges don 'byed par lung bstan pa// de yis phye ba'i nges don gyi// gzhung lugs gang yin smra bar rigs// theg chen rgyud blar 'grel zhe na// de dang byams chos rnam gsum dang*// theg bsdus sogs nas bshad pa yi// nges pa'i don gyi khyad par ci// rang stong med par dgag pa ni// bder gshegs snying po'i ngos 'dzin du// rngog lo'i man ngag las 'byung mod// gzhung chen dag nas bshad pa med// dbu ma pa la thal rang gi

/bshad pa bod du grags mod kyang*// dgag bya'i tshad dang dgag bya yi// rnam grangs mang nyung 'chad pa ni// sngon gyi dus su byung ba med// mdor na dbu ma chung ngu ni// gang zag bdag med tsam la mthun// 'bring dang chen po'i khyad par ni// rang rang 'dod pas btags pa'o// sngags su zung 'jug dbu ma cher// bshad la mi mthun med mod kyi// zung 'jug kun rdzob bden pa zhes// bshad na thams cad 'khrul bar 'gyur// rnal 'byor spyod pas gnyis med kyi// ye shes dbu ma chen por 'dod// thal rang lugs dang mi mthun yang*// sngags gzhung kun dang mthun pas blang*// slob dpon zhi zla rnam gnyis kyis// lugs 'dir 'khor 'das gnyis ka yi// rten yod pa de rtag chad kyi// mtha' las 'das pa min zhes bkag /'di yang phar phyin rkyang par ni// dbu ma che zhes 'chad dgos mod// rten de yod par rgyud bla dang*// chos kyi dbyings su bstod las gsungs// mdor na shing rta chen po yi// srol chen mang la skur mi 'debs// rnam par rtog pa kun sel ba'i// thabs mchog yod pa de dbu ma// de skad 'di yang sems dpa' che// brag dkar ba yi dgongs pa la// som nyi mang po sel don du// legs pa'i blo yis dge bar sbyar// //maṅga laṃ// // ༄// na mo mañdzu badzrā ya/ chos kyi phyag rgya dang po'i gtam// kho nas stong pa nyid mchog grub// mi rtag don ni skad cig mar// bshad pas gnas pa bkag phyir ro// byas yod kun la skad cig tu// gnas pa bkag pas chos de dag /gang du'ang gnas pa med pa'i phyir// rang rang ngo bos stong par grub// skad cig gnas med 'di las gzhan// rang stong sgrub pa'i rigs pa ni// dbu ma mchog smra rnams la// 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin no// gnas med tsam gyis de mi 'grub// ce na rgyal ba skyed ma las// ther zug gnas pa min pa'i phyir// rang rang ngo bos stong zhes gsungs// skad cig gcig tu gnas gyur na// nam yang 'jig par mi 'gyur zhes// 'dus byas skad cig par sgrub pa'i// rigs pa mchog tu byams pas gsungs// 'o na mdo las 'dus byas kyi// mtshan nyid skye 'jig gnas gsum du// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa gang gis 'chad// gnas pa med par su zhig 'jig

/ce na mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis// gnas pa rgyun la dgongs pa ste// skyes la ma 'gags dngos po ni// yod pa min zhes gsal bar gsungs// dngos po thams cad rang rgyu las// 'jig pa'i ngang du skyes shes pa// rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i gzhung las te// skye 'jig dus mnyam kho nar gsungs// bum pa skyed byed dngos rgyu de// 'jig byed rgyu 'am gzhan zhig brtag /rgyu gzhan mi ltos gzhung na gsal// gzhan min na ni dus mnyam grub// skyed pa 'jig pa dus mnyam yang*// zhig pa dus mnyam min zhe na// 'o na bar du gnas dgos pas// khyad par med phyir phyis mi 'gyur// da ltar gnas pa mi 'dod phyir// 'das dang ma 'ongs ci zhe na// 'das dang ma 'ongs btags yod du// nyan thos sde pa'i gzhung na'ang gsal// dus kyi cha shas yod min pa'i// skad cig gcig tu gnas pa ni// don dam don byed nus pa zhes// 'dod pa de yi lugs yin no// de lta yin na dngos kun la// skur pa btab pas chad pa'i mthar// ltung ba'i nyes pa yod min nam// tha snyad bden pa ci zhe na// tha snyad du yod dam par med// ces pa bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi// thabs mkhas sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa// de yin mu stegs phal la med// de nas rnam 'grel mdzad pa yi// gzhung lugs pa la 'di ltar brtag /dngos la mi rtag gis khyab dang*// mi rtag pa la dngos med dang*// rtag pa dngos pos khyab pa ni// gzhung 'grel kun na gsal bar bzhugs// bod kyi rtog ges ma slad par// drang por 'chad pa 'di bsam bya// byas yod skye 'jig gnas pa dang*// btags sogs lhan skyes rtog pa'i ngo*// ji bzhin tha snyad du yod pas// tha snyad bden par de khas len// mi rtag don ni skad cig mar// mi gnas nyid du bshad pa dang*// de don dngos por med pa ni// dam pa'i don gyi dbang du byas// mngon gyur tha snyad bden pa yi// rtags las lkog gyur don dam pa// sgrub pa dngos po stobs zhugs te// byas las mi rtag par sgrub bzhin// rgyu zhig pas ni 'bras mi bskyed// rgyu ma zhig par 'bras skyed pa// yod na don la gnas 'gyur phyir// don byed nus pa don la med// rtag pa zhes pa tha snyad de// dam pa'i don du yod ma yin// mi rtag las log gzhan sel ba// rtag par tha snyad gzhung las btags// snga phyi'i dngos po cig 'dzin pa// 'jig rten la yod rtag pa'i don// de yang tha snyad du yin gyi// dam pa'i don du mi srid pas// rtag dang dngos po thams cad kyang*// rigs ngor rang rang ngo bos stong*// rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i lugs bzang por// chos kun rang stong sgrub pa yi// rigs pa mchog de yod gyur na// thal rang lugs dang khyad par ci// snyam na de don bsam bya ba// 'gyur med yongs grub thog mtha' dang*// bral la rtag brtan g.yung drung zhes// byis pa'i bstan bcos las kyang gsungs// 'di don rgyun mi chad pa yi// dngos la rtag par bshad pa ste// dngos po de yang skad cig gis// mi rtag nyid du gdon mi za// yongs grub bden par mi 'chad pa// byams pa'i gzhung dang 'gal zhe na// sems kyi rdo rje'ang thos bsam gyi// rigs pas brtags pa'i ngor med kyang*// med par bzhag nus ma yin te// sgra rtog yul las 'das phyir ro// 'o na rang stong rigs pa la// rtsal du bton pas ci bya na// yongs grub sems kyi rdo rje la// zhen pa spong ba'i phyir yin no// zhen blo bag chags dang bcas pa// 'gog byed rigs pa'i rnam grangs gnyis// rtog ngor de yul bkag pa yis// de 'dzin 'gog pa'i rigs pa dang*// yang na 'dzin pa kun btags nyid// gcig dang du bral rigs pas so// 'di ni rnam 'grel mdzad pa yi// mthar thug dngos por smra ba zhes// chos spong nyes pa'i 'jigs bral ba// blo bzang de yis gsal bar smras// dge bas rang dang skal mnyam pa// kun kyang rgyal ba ma pham pas// legs par phye ba'i lam bzang der// 'jug pa gegs yod ma gyur cig

/ces pa gser mdog can gyi grwar// dpal ldan legs pa'i blo yis sbyar// yi ge pa ni dam chos kyi// rgyal mtshan legs par tshugs de yin// maṅga laṃ// // ༄// na mo mañdzu badzrā ya/ phyag rgya dang po'i gtam nyid kyis// phyag rgya gsum pa'ang rtogs sla ste// gang zag la sogs btags yod kyi// dngos kun mi rtag grub phyir ro// de lta na yang gang zag gi /bdag med sgrub pa'i rigs pa ni// gzhung lugs kun nas gzhan stong gi /rigs pas bshad pa de yin no// nyan thos pa rnams rang stong gi /rigs pas stong nyid kun shes kyang*// rang nyid zhi bde'i don gyi phyir// ched du gnyer nas de mi sgom// 'jig rten grags sde spyod pa yis// bdag dang gang zag tha snyad kyi// bden par 'chad mod rang lugs min// bye mdo sems tsam smra ba gsum// gang zag ces bya btags yod de// bdag ces bya ba rdzas yod ming*// mu stegs byed pas rnam grangs su// 'bad nas 'chad de rigs pas 'gog /tha snyad bden pa'i dus dag tu// chos kun bdag med khas len mod// sems can med par khas mi len// len na phyag rgya gnyis par 'gal// dngos por smra bas khas len pa'i// bdag med gnyis po gang yin yang*// rang mtshan kho nar bshad bya ste// mngon sum nyid kyis gzhal phyir ro// gsang sngags pa yi bdag sgom pa// phyag rgya bzhi dang 'gal zhe na// dam pa'i bdag ces bya ba ni// bdag med ye shes nyid la 'chad// ye shes de la ngar 'dzin pa// byas na phyag rgya'i lung dang 'gal// lha dang sngags dang phyag rgya sogs// sgrub pa'i gzhi ni rang stong gi /rigs pas rtog pa'i ngor bkag na// bskyed rim sgrub par mi nus pa// nyid phyir rigs pas de mi 'gog /ye shes de la lhar zhen na// gya nom lhar zhen ces bya ba'i// rnam rtog yin te rang stong gi /rigs pas zhen pa de khegs so// de lta na yang ye shes nyid// rang stong rigs pas mi khegs te// brjod med don dam yin phyir ro// 'di yang dam pa'i bdag dang ni// phyag rgya gsum pa 'gal zhes pa'i// log rtog 'gog pa'i phyir yin te// dam pa'i bdag gis chos kun 'grub// maṅga laṃ bha wantu//

// ༄// na mo mañdzu badzrā ya/ rgyud du dbu ma'i lta ba las// zung 'jug gong du 'phags par gsungs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pas// lta grub rnam pa brgyad ces bshad// chos kyi rje yis gsang sngags la// dbu ma las lhag med par bshad// bshad par dka' zhing 'gal ba ltar// snang ba de don bsam par bya// lta ba'i ming can rnam gnyis te// stong pa nyid kyi shes rab dang*// de dang stong pa dbyer med pa'i// ye shes nyid ces gang bshad pa'o// dang po thos bsam shes rab ste// spros bral nyid tsam rtogs par bshad// gnyis pa sgom byung ye shes te// bde stong zung du 'jug pa'o// bshad pas go dang thos pa yi// lta ba zhes bya snga ma ste// zung 'jug brjod bral zhes bya ba// phyi ma de la bzhed pa yin// bshad pas ji ltar go zhe na// dgag bya 'gog pa'i rigs pa tsam// bshad pas stong nyid go nus kyi// sgrub pa'i phyogs nas shes mi nus// zung 'jug ji ltar brjod bral na// dgag sgrub gang gi phyogs nas kyang*// 'di zhes bstan par mi nus mod// sgom pa'i thabs kyis nyams su myong*// myong bya rdzas kyis dbyer med kyang*// bde ba'i cha nas thabs dang ni// stong pa'i cha nas shes rab bo// rdzas la dbye ba med pa de// thabs kyang yin la shes rab kyang*// yin pas zung 'jug ces bya ba// sngags kyi theg pa'i khyad chos so// rnying ma pa rnams theg pa dgu// lta bas 'byed pa yin par 'dod// lta ba la yang kun rdzob dang*// don dam rnam pa gnyis su 'byed// theg pa lta bas byas pa min// thabs kyi khyad par kho na ste// thabs gzhan dag la ma reg par// rang rang thabs kyis byang chub pa'o// rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i thabs mkhas ni// bla med thabs la ma ltos par// rang rang thabs kyis gsang sngags kyi// byang chub thob par bzhed ma yin// des na theg pa che chung gnyis// re re'ang gnyis su phye bas bzhi// lta ba'ang de ltar gnyis gnyis su// phye bas rnam pa bzhi yin no// sngags la pha rol phyin pa yi// stong pa nyid las lhag med kyang*// nyams myong bde stong dbyer med la// dgongs nas lta grub brgyad du phye// de phyir thos pa'i lta ba la// theg chen rnam gnyis khyad med kyang*// nyams su myong bya'i lta ba la// khyad par yod ces bshad na 'thad// gnyis po gtso bor gang 'dzin na// mtshan 'dzin 'gog la snga ma ste// mtshan med ye shes sgrub pa la// phyi ma nyid phyir khyad par 'phags// brjod pas spros pa 'gog nus kyang*// spros bral brjod par mi nus pa// de la theg chen theg pa lngar// 'byed na mkhas pa'i dgongs pa min// rigs gsum rigs lnga rigs brgya dang*// snang tsam dbye bas 'byed ce na// 'di ni kun rdzob thabs kyi phyir// lta ba'i dbye bar rung ma yin// kun rdzob snang ba lha yin phyir// don dam dbye bar 'dod ce na// lha dang snang ba ma phyed pas// kun rdzob lta bar 'khrul pa yin// gsang sngags rnying mar smra bas kyang*// sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i lta ba la// dgu yi dbye ba ma bshad phyir// rtsod len 'brel med 'gyur zhe na// theg par 'jog byed lta ba dang*// theg pa rnam dgur 'byed pa dang*// spros pa gcod pa'i lta ba la// dbye ba med par 'chad rnams 'gal// des na thos pas go ba yi// lta ba'i mthar thug gcig las med// gcig pus pha rol phyin pa dang*// sngags kyi theg par 'byed mi nus// sngags kyi theg par 'jog nus kyi// thabs shes dbyer med lta ba yang*// rnal 'byor rnam gsum mthun pa'i phyir// theg pa so sor 'byed mi nus// mdor na theg pa rnam dgu ni// tshan ldan gzhung na bshad pa med// theg pa gsum dang bzhi dang lngar// phye ba'ang thabs las yin par 'dod// lta ba dngos po'i gnas lugs la// zhugs phyir thabs shes dbyer med dang*// bde stong dbyer med gsang sngags kyi// lta bar 'chad pa 'khrul zhe na// rigs pa'i ngo dang ye shes ngor// rang gis stong dang gzhan stong gis// khyad par du byas bde ba che// chos dbyings ye shes yin par 'dod// 'jam dpal mtshan brjod ma shes na// dang po'i sangs rgyas shes mi nus// de ma shes par sngags kyi tshul// shes min zhes gsungs padma dkar// spros bral ngo bo nyid med du// smra ba'i lugs dang rnam rdzun par// grags pa'i gzhung lugs gnyis ka las// 'byung la khyad par med dam ci// yod na dngos su 'gal ba dang*// med na 'khor lo gsum pa yi// nges don 'chad pa'i gzhung lugs kun// dbu ma nyid du thal zhe na// 'khor lo gsum pa'i spros bral las// lhag pa sngags la yod ma yin// de las lhag pa dbu ma la// yod ces thal rang smra rnams 'chad// drang po'i blo yis brtags pa na// gcig ni spros pa bral tsam dang*// gzhan ni spros bral ye shes so// snga ma'i yul can rtog pa las// ma 'das phyi ma'i myong byed ni// ye shes nyid phyir bshad pa yis// go ba'i lta bar mi 'dod do// de skad 'di ni sdom gsum gyi// bstan bcos 'chad pa'i gnas skabs na// gong ma'i lung dang 'gal dogs pa// mang po nyid phyir rgyas par bshad// maṅga laṃ// shu bhaṃ/// /

༄// na mo buddha ya/ rngog los bstan pa skyong dus su// thal 'gyur gzhung lugs ma 'gyur zhing*// rang rgyud shin tu dar na yang*// gnyis ka dag dang mthun mi bzhed// klu sgrub bzhed pa'i spros bral ni// rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i rigs pa yi// lam du drangs nas 'chad dgos kyi// 'chad tshul gzhan rnams ltar snang ngo*// kha cig snang tsam 'bad nas 'gog /gzhan dag snang ba bden med ni// rjes su dpag pa'i gzhal byar 'dod// lugs de gnyis ka rigs min te// snang ba bkag na rjes dpag gi /rten gyur gtan tshigs mi 'thad pas// spros pa 'gog pa'i thabs gzhan med// snang ba bden med rjes dpag gi /rigs pas gzhal na grub par 'gyur// sgyu ma rigs sgrub khas blangs na// rtag pa'i mtha' las 'da' ba med// rigs pa gzhan gyis de 'gog na// blo snga ma ni gnod bcas dang*// rig pa thug med 'gyur bas na// rang rgyud smra ba de mi 'thad// sgrub byed 'phen par mi nus pa'i// thal ngag tsam gyis spros pa'i mtha'// 'gog par nus pa yin no zhes// mi gnas par grags de dag smra// sgrub byed 'phen par mi nus pa'i// rtags de ltar snang las ma 'das// de las chos nyid nges pa'i blo// tshad ma min las gzhan pa med// rtags chos don gsum snang tsam du// yod kyang bden par med pa ni// sgyu ma'i don te rigs pas grub// de la sgyu ma rigs sgrub zer// 'di 'dra dbu mar mi rigs te// rigs pas dpyad bzod khas blangs pas// sman chen dug tu song ba dang*// 'dra bar lta ba'i dug gis zin// mi gnas par grags dbu mar pa// de la thal 'gyur ba zhes zer// 'di yang dbu mar mi rigs te// spros pa'i lhag ma lus phyir ro// de yi shes byed gang zhe na// khas blangs 'gal ba tsam zhig ni// gegs byed yin gyi log phyogs la// gnod byed min phyir de lus so// de nas lo chen rang gi lugs// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs gsum// gzhi ni rnam 'grel mdzad gzhung gi

/rigs pas spros pa'i tshogs kun 'gog /spros bral rtags kyis mi sgrub mod// spros pa 'gog pa'i rtags kyi tshul// rgol ba gnyis ka'i rnam shes la// mthun par snang ba'i tshad mas 'grub// rgol ba'i blo la ltos nas ni// dgag bya tsam zhig 'gog byed kyi// bsgrub bya ched du mi sgrub pa// rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i gzhung na'ang mang*// spros pa bkag kyang spros med ni// yod par bshad nus ma yin te// rmi lam yul gyi grong med na/ de zhig pa ni med de bzhin// spros pa tshad mas 'gog dgos kyang*// spros bral tshad mas mi 'jal te// med dgag mngon sum yul du 'gal// rjes dpag spros la zhen phyir ro// rjes su dpag pas stong pa nyid// 'jal yang rigs pa'i shes pa min// rjes su dpag pas drangs pa yi// spros tsam 'gog pa de rigs shes// lam ni spyod 'jug mkhan po yi// gzhung lugs ji bzhin 'dir 'chad do// don dam blo yi spyod yul du// nam yang rung ba min pa'i phyir// 'phags pa'i mnyam par bzhag ngo na// don dam 'jal ba'i blo mi dgos// 'phags blo stong pa nyid gang dang*// ro gcig nyid du ma song na// chu la chu bzhag lta bur 'gal// song na chos nyid blor mi rung*// rjes thob rnam shes ji snyed pa// chos kyi dbyings las 'byung ba ste// gang la stong pa nyid rung ba// de la thams cad rung phyir ro// 'bras dus mnyam gzhag chos kyi sku// spyod 'jug gzhung las 'byung dang mthun// de rjes ji snyed gzugs brnyan ni// 'char mdzad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// theg chen mdo sde'i rgyan dang mthun// gzhan snang sprul sku rgyud bla ltar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mnyam gzhag na// don dam snang ba'ang yod min na// kun rdzob snang ba smos ci dgos// res 'ga' me long ye shes la// rdzun snang shes bya'i gzugs brnyan ni// ma lus 'char la rjes thob dang*// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes brjod// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la// 'khrul pa'i snang ba mang 'char yang*// ye shes 'khrul par 'chad pa ni// bdag nyid che de'i dgongs pa min// gzhan gyi rnam rig la snang ba'i// sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku de ni// brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs sogs kyi// dpe yis bstan pa de yin no// mnyam par bzhag na blo med ces// gsungs mod ye shes med pa ni// 'di yi dgongs pa ma yin te// me long ye shes bshad phyir ro// kun rdzob rten 'brel sna tshogs pa// med bzhin du yang ye shes la// gzugs brnyan 'char bar bzhed pa ste// 'khrul snang zhes ni bshad phyir ro// thal rang sogs kyi bshad srol ni// gcig tu nges pa min pa yi// dbu ma'i bshad srol gsum pa ni// gangs can blo ldan bzang po yis// tsong kha ru gsum dge 'dun la// spring yig bdud rtsi'i thigs par byung*// phyi ma'i dus 'dir de yi don// shin tu bshad par dka' ba yang*// shing rta'i srol chen mtha' dag nas// legs bshad rtse mo bsdus pa ni// blo ldan bzang po'i bzhed pa ste// klu sgrub zhabs kyi dgongs par nges// zhes bya ba 'dis ni spring yig bdud rtsi'i thigs pa'i rnam par bshad pa 'khrul med du grub pa yin no// maṅga laṃ bha wantu/// /

༄// na mo mañdzu badzrā ya/ ljongs 'dir sngon byon lta ba'i cha// rang gzhung tshugs par 'chad po yi// rjes 'brang rnams la phyis byon dang*// ma 'dres bya ba 'di gdams so// de la gnyis te phyi rabs pa'i// 'dod pa thad sor bzhag pa dang*// sngon byon rnams kyi lung dang ni// rigs pa mdor bsdus bshad pa'o// dang po sngon gyi lugs rnying kun// sun 'byin mdzad po tsong kha pas// bod yul man ngag pa kun gyi// lhag mthong ngos 'dzin ltengs po yi// zhi gnas tsam la bshad pa dang*// kun rdzob 'khrul snang yin no zhes// spyod pa'i phyogs la skur 'debs mang*// dbu ma'i mdo gzhung 'chad pa rnams// rang stong zhes bya chad smra'i gtam// mang du smra zhing sngags pa rnams// btsan thabs chad stong 'ba' zhig sgom// sngags la dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i// lta ba las lhag yod ma yin// rigs pas phu thag ma bcad par// thal 'gyur lta ba rtogs mi nus// sngags kyi lta ba go chod po// thogs med mched kyi gzhung na med// thal rang gnyis la rigs pa yi// dgag bya rtsing zhib yod pa'i phyir// rang rgyud pas bshad rigs pa yis// chos nyid zab mo rtogs mi nus// chos can tshad mas grub pa la// dgag bya rang mtshan rang bzhin sogs// bkag nas de yi log phyogs kyi// bsgrub bya rjes su dpag pas 'jal// bden pa gnyis ka tshad ma yi// gzhal byar mtshungs la khyad par med// kun rdzob tshad mas mi 'jal na// bsod nams tshogs kun gang gis rdzogs// don dam tshad mas mi 'jal na// sgrib kun spong ba'i ye shes ci// des na snga rabs pa rnams kyi// kun rdzob 'khrul snang yin zer dang*// don dam zhes brjod gzhal bya las// 'das zhes bya ba de rdzun gsung*// de dag rnams la rim bzhin du// lung dang rigs pas brtag bya ba// so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis// ma rnyed don la rtse gcig pa// ltengs po'i zhi gnas yin gyur na// zhi lhag zung du 'jug pa ci// mnyam gzhag dus su sor rtog gi

/shes rab mngon du 'gyur dgos na// shing las byung ba'i me yis ni// shing nyid bsreg pa'i dpe don ci// 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes kun// sgra don 'dzin pa'i rtog pa las// 'das pa min par khas blangs te// gnas lugs don la dpyod phyir ro// dbang las skyes pa'i ye shes kyang*// rtog bcas nyid du thal 'gyur te// stong nyid nges pa'i blo yin phyir// min na lhag mthong nyid du 'gal// dbu mar zhugs pa'i bde chen gyi// shes pas stong nyid nges zhes zer// gzung 'dzin gnyis por zhugs pa yi// bde ba de dang khyad par ci// mi 'gyur bde dang zag med bde// lhag mthong nyid du 'gyur ba la// sgra don 'dzin pa'i rtog pa zhes// zer ba gzhung chen kun dang 'gal// gnas lugs kun nas sgrib byed pa'i// blo la kun rdzob ces byar bshad// ma rig gis bslad blo 'khrul na// de la 'khrul snang mi 'char ci// kun rdzob ces bya tshad ma la// 'chad pa gzhung lugs kun dang 'gal// don dam tshad mas 'jal zhes pa'i// thal rang gzhung yang rnyed dka' na// kun rdzob tshad mas 'jal zhes pa'i// phyi nang gzhung lugs shin tu dkon// 'khrul ngor bsod nams tshogs bsags pas// kun rdzob pa yi sku gnyis 'thob// gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba yi// bag chags can la sku de 'char// yum las 'dres rkang brgya rtsa brgyad// thams cad rang rang gis stong par// bshad kyi de des mi stong par// bden pas stong zhes bshad pa med// gzugs ni gzugs skyes stong zhes pa// de don de des mi stong par// de min pa yi chos gzhan gyis// stong zhes 'chad la su yid rton// de ltar 'chad de gzhan stong gi /lugs las kyang ni tha shal te// bum pa chu yis stong pa ltar// 'brel med gzhan gyis stong phyir ro// tshad mas grub pa'i don gang zhig /tshad mas ma grub kyis stong zhes// bshad pas tshad grub don de la// de 'dzin ldog pa ngo mtshar che// des na chos rnams rang rang gi

/kun rdzob pa yi ngo bo dang*// gnas skabs don dam du bzhag pa'i// ngo bos stong pa la dgongs nas// stong nyid dang po rnam bzhi bshad// bden pa gnyis ka'i ngo bo yis// stong pa 'di la don dam zhes// 'chad pa gnas skabs dbang byas te// mthar thug de yang des stong phyir// mdor na bden gnyis rnam gzhag la// 'jig rten lugs dang dbu ma yi// gnas skabs lugs dang mthar thug lugs// rnam pa gsum du gzhung las bshad// dang po chu yi zla ba dang*// nam mkha'i zla ba ji bzhin no// gnyis pa lhan skyes gang zag gi /bdag dang de med lta bu'o// gsum par kun rdzob ma gtogs pa'i// don dam logs su bzhag pa med// sa skya'i rje btsun ye shes kyi// tshogs sog chad stong sgom zhes pa// rigs pa min te gang gi phyir// yod pa'i chos shig btsan thabs su// med na chad par smras chog mod// gdod nas med pa'i gzung 'dzin gnyis// med par gsal 'debs chad pa min// gnyis med ye shes tsam zhig ni// lhag mar byas nas rnam rtog gi /spros pa med par lhun grub pa// de la dam pa'i bdag ces bshad// de yang rang stong du byas na// spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni rnam par gnas// zhes gsungs pa de gang la dgongs// thal 'gyur lugs kyi lta yul dang*// theg mchog lugs kyi lta yul gnyis// don gcig zer bas lugs gnyis ka'i// lta ba'i yul de ngos ma zin// thal 'gyur lugs kyi don dam de// med par dgag pas las gzhan med// theg pa mchog gi don dam ni// bde stong zung du 'jug la bshad// zung du 'jug pa'i ngos 'dzin la/ bde ba bden pas stong pa zhes// zer na gsang ba 'dus pa yi// don dam 'od gsal ci la zer// de yang med par dgag yin na// zung du 'jug par gang gis ldang*// thal 'gyur lugs kyi stong nyid la// zung du 'jug pa'i tha snyad med// zung 'jug lta yul mthar thug tu// 'chad pa sngags kyi khyad chos yin// thal 'gyur lugs kyi mthar thug tshe// don dam bden pa khas mi len// gsang ba 'dus par 'od gsal la// bden par mi 'chad skabs mi srid// 'on kyang spros kun bral cha tsam// lugs de gnyis la khyad par med// rigs pas phu thag ma bcad kyang*// spros bral rtogs pa'i thabs mchog yod// don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las// lhag pa'i spros bral yod ma yin// zhes 'chad pa yang de yin no// thogs med mched kyi gzhung lugs las// sngags kyi lta yul ma bshad na// gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa yi// ye shes ma bshad pa yin nam// bshad mod bden par khas len pas// khyad par shin tu che zhe na// mnyam gzhag ngo na ye shes de// spros kun bral bar gzhung gis 'chad// tha snyad tshe na sngags las kyang*// sems kyi rdo rje bden par bshad// thal rang tha snyad khas len las// dgag bya'i khyad par 'chad nus na// dgag bya phra shos rang mtshan gyi// grub par 'chad de thal 'gyur pas// tha snyad tshe na khas blangs te// 'jig rten grags sde spyod phyir ro// gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i// rtags tshul khyad par med pa la// dgag bya 'gog tshul rtsing zhib gnyis// klu sgrub kyis kyang 'chad mi nus// dngos kun yod par khas blangs na// rtag dang chad par lta bar ni// thal bar 'gyur te dngos de ni// rtag dang mi rtag nyid phyir ro// kun rdzob yod par khas blangs na// de nyid rigs pas dpyad pa'i tshe// ma rnyed par ni khas len pa// zla ba'i zhabs kyis bkag zin te// stong nyid dngos po'i 'jig rgyu dang*// tha snyad bden pa rigs pa yi// dpyad bzod nyid du thal 'gyur zhes// stong nyid tshad grub bkag phyir ro// dus rnams kun tu bden pa gnyis// tshad ma'i gzhal byar khas len na// gzugs sogs kun rdzob nyid kyang ni// grags pas yin gyi tshad mas min// don dam blo yi spyod yul du// 'gyur ba min zhes gsungs pa dang*// zla ba'i dgongs pa a ti shas// 'chad pa'i tshe na stong pa nyid// tshad ma gnyis kas mi rtogs gsungs// 'o na gang gis rtogs she na// zla ba grags pa la brgyud pa'i// man ngag nyid kyis rtogs par 'gyur// man ngag de yang gang zhe na// thog mar dngos kun gzugs can dang*// gzugs can min pa gnyis su phye// de nas dus dang rdul phran sogs// thugs pa med pa'i bar du phye// de nas ci yang ma rnyed pa// de la stong nyid rtogs pa yi// tha snyad btags so gang gi phyir// ma mthong ba nyid de mthong bar// shin tu zab pa'i mdo las gsung*// zhes pa 'di ni phyi rabs pa// kun la dpang po nyid gyur pa// shing rta chen po'i srol 'dzin ces// grags pa de yi lugs yin no// zhes gangs can du byon pa'i mkhas grub so so'i lugs snga phyi'i lta ba 'jog tshul gyi shan rnam par phye nas/

rang gi lugs mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos nyi bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan no/// / ༄// swasti/ thams cad mkhyen la phyag btsal nas// dam pa'i bdag dang snying po'i khams// kun gyis rtogs par thal zhes pa'i/ rtsod pa myur du spang bar bya// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// rang myong tshad mas rig pa'i phyir// 'gro ba kun gyis rang rang gi /snying po rtogs par thal zhe na// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// rang gis rang nyid nyams myong nas// de la nges pa 'dren pa ni// theg chen 'phags pa min la med// 'o na rang blo rang la ni// lkog tu gyur par thal zhe na// 'od gsal ba yi sems de nyid// rang la mngon sum tshad yin phyir// rang blo rang la lkog gyur du// thal bar 'gyur ba ma yin no// de la mngon sum tshad yin na// de ma rtogs par 'gal zhe na// mngon sum thams cad rang rang gi /'jug pa'i yul la tshad yin kyang*// de rtogs mdzad pa'i nges med par// rnam 'grel mdzad pas bshad pa yin// rang gis rang nyid rig min pa// rang rig nyid du 'gal zhe na// 'od gsal ba yi sems gang la// rtog dang bral zhing ma 'khrul par// song na de la mngon sum ste// de yang rang rig las gzhan med// rang nyid yul du byed pa ni// rang rig pa la spyir mi 'thad// khyad par gnyis med ye shes la// yul med rig pa'i gter las bshad/ spyir yang theg pa chen po las// so sor rang rig ces bya ba// rang nyid rig par skyes tsam las// rtog bya gzhan med pa la bshad// rang nyid rang gis yul min kyang*/ nges pa 'dren dang mi 'dren pa'i// dbye bas snying po mthong ba la// mig dang ldan mi ldan zhes bshad// snying po shes par bshad pa la// rtsod pa spang ba'i rab byed 'dis// rtog ge shes par rlom rnams kyang*// rang rig gnas la nges thob shog/

//swasti/// / ༄// thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal// nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa yi// rgyal srid skyong mdzad mi pham mgon// de'i gsung dngos smra'i lam dag tu// mthun par 'jug pa de spang bya// sngon dus rngog lo chen po yis// rgyud bla ma gtogs byams chos bzhi// mngon rtogs rim pa gtsor 'chad phyir// drang ba'i don can yin zhes gsung*// sngon nas deng sang dus bar du// byams chos thog mtha' gnyis ma gtogs// bar pa rnam gsum sems tsam gyi// gzhung lugs nyid du mthun par 'chad// phyi dus grags pa gsal ldan dag /rgyan gyi dgongs pa klu sgrub ltar// gnas kyang de 'grel sngon ma byung*// rgyud bla 'phags pa thogs med kyis// thal 'gyur gzhung du bkral zhes zer// bod 'dir byams chos 'chad tshul la// thos bsam tshul dang sgom tshul du// 'chad tshul rnam pa gnyis yod ces// chos lnga dbu mar 'grel rnams gsungs// de dag rnams la brtag bya ba// gzhan sun 'byin pa'i lung rigs dang*// rang gi 'dod pa mdo gzhung kun// dpang por byas nas sgrub pa'o// 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs don gyi// gtso bo nges pa'i don yin na// mngon rtogs rgyan gzhung drang don gyi// bstan bcos nyid du 'chad pa 'gal// 'khor lo gsum pa'i dgongs don gyi// gtso bo drang ba'i don yin na// rgyud bla'i bstan bcos nges don zhes// mtha' gcig nyid du 'chad pa 'gal// byams chos bar pa rnam gsum po// sems tsam kho na'i gzhung yin na// rje btsun mi pham mgon nyid kyis// dbu ma'i gzhung du gsungs dang 'gal// rgyud bla dbu mar nges 'gyur na// gsum po sems tsam gzhung du 'gal// nges pa'i don gyi gtso bo yi// ngos 'dzin khyad par med phyir ro// mngon rtogs rgyan gyi dgongs pa'i don// 'grel tshul klu sgrub ltar gnas na// sher phyin mdo yi 'grel lugs la// mngon rtogs rgyan dang rigs pa'i tshogs// shing rta'i srol chen rnam gnyis zhes// chen po rnams la grags dang 'gal// 'phags pa thogs med skyob nyid kyis// rgyan gzhung ji bzhin ma bkral na// drang nges 'byed par lung bstan pa// de la snying po med par 'gyur// rgyud bla'i dgongs pa zla grags dang*// mthun par thogs med kyis bkral na// mngon sum nyid la bsnyon pa'i phyir// rnam dpyod mang pos ci zhig bya// byams chos sgom lugs ltar 'chad ces// gsung pa de yis chos lnga po'i// nges don sngon byon bod rnams kyi// dbu ma nyid dang khyad par med// thos bsam lugs ltar 'chad ces pa// de yi lugs la lnga char gyi// stong nyid med dgag kho nar 'chad// byams chos bar pa rnam gsum po'i// nges don gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyi// stong pa'i med dgag nyid do zhes// 'chad pa phyis kyi gtam kho na// de nas rang gi 'dod pa ni// byams pa'i chos ni lnga char na// gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa yi// ye shes kho na dam pa'i don// yin par 'chad la khyad par med// mngon rtogs rgyan na gzhi dang lam// rnam gsum gzung 'dzin rtog pa yis// stong pa'i shes rnam nyid kho na// spang bya'ang gzung bar rtog pa dang*// 'dzin par rtog pa nyid du nges// de stong ye shes khams gsum pa'i// gnyen po nyid du bshad pa dang*// rgyun mtha'i gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi// ye shes chos sku'i dngos rgyur bshad// byams chos bar pa rnam gsum na// gang zag bdag med smos ci dgos// gzung ba chos kyi bdag med dang*// 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med kyang*// rgyas par bshad la rtsod pa med// gnyis stong ye shes ma bkag pas// sems tsam nyid du nges gyur na// rgyud dang rgya gzhung ji snyed dang*// sgrub thabs kun la'ang der thal lo// rgyud blar snying po'i ngos 'dzin ni// las nyon gnyis dang rnam smin gyis// stong pa'i ye shes nyid la bshad// mdo sde'i rgyan na'ang de kho na// la la byams chos lnga char yang*/

sems tsam gzhung du gnas so zhes// zer na legs ldan zla grags kyis// gang bshad bden na de ltar yang*// smras pas chog mod gsang 'dus dang*// dgyes rdor bde mchog la sogs pa'i// dgongs 'grel kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur// rgyas par rang rang gzhung du ltos// phar phyin theg par grub mtha' bzhi'i// rtse mor gyur pa'i dbu ma la// 'chad tshul shing rta'i srol gnyis byung*// sngags las dgongs don gcig tu grub// ces byams chos dang rigs tshogs kyi dbu ma'i gtam so sor nges pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa mi pham dgongs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༄// dbu ma'i lta khrid/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'jug pa ngo mtshar rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams ma lus pa'i// mkhyen dang brtse dang phrin las kun// gcig gyur 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs// mthu chen thob la phyag 'tshal nas// grub mtha' smra ba rnam bzhi yi// rtse gyur ngo bo nyid med du/ smra ba'i dbu ma chen po pa// rnams la rab grags lta ba'i khrid// rgyud pa'i rim pa las 'ongs pa// phyis byon gtam gyis ma bslad par// sngon byon chen po'i gzhung bzhin 'chad// lta ba'i khrid du grags pa 'di// phal cher dpal ldan zla ba nas// brgyud do de la srol rnam gnyis// a ti sha nas bka' gdams par// grags la rim rgyud gcig yin te// nyi mar grags pa'i sras bzhi las// rim par brgyud de gnyis pa'o// dang pos thog mar sems bskyed pa// byams pa'i gzhung bzhin thogs med kyis// rnam par phye ba'i srol de ltar// mdzad do de yang byang sa yi// tshul khrims le'u las gsungs pa// 'di la smon pa sems bskyed dang*// 'jug pa'i sdom pa gnyis phye nas// sems bskyed nas bzung so thar gyi// ris bdun sdom pa'i rten du bzhed// rigs pas sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i tshul// bden gnyis la 'jug gzhung las te// zhi lhag zung 'brel bsgom pa'i tshul// dbu ma'i man ngag las gsungs so// dpal ldan zla bas sems bskyed pa// rnam bcu'i thog mtha' thams cad du// sems can chos dang dmigs med pa'i// snying rje rnam gsum goms byar bshad// de phyir smon pa'i byang sems tsam// khrid kyi thog mar gzung byas nas// dngos gzhi'i rnam bzhag brgyud pa gnyis// mi mthun med phyir bsre bar bya// thog mar thos dang bsam pa yi// rigs pas mtha' gnyis ma bsal na// tshad mas drangs pa'i dbu ma nyid// mi 'byung phyir na de bsal bya// de 'og spros pa'i mtha' kun dang*// bral ba'i dbu ma zhi gnas dang*// lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba yis// ji bzhin goms par byed tshul lo// dang po ji ltar thos pa dang*// thos las tshad ma gang skyes dang*// tshad mas gzhal ba gang yin dang*// gzhal de goms pas rtogs bya ba// yin min tshul gnyis phye ba dang*// thun mong min dang thun mong ba'i// zhi gnas gnyis kyi dbye ba dang*// zhi gnas lhag mthong so so ba// nyid dang zung du 'jug pa'i skabs// 'jig rten rtog pa lhan skyes dang*// mthun pa'i tshad mas ma bslad par// gzhung bzhin shes nas dmigs pa yi// go rim bzhin du 'khrid par bya// dang po chos gcig la mtshon nas// chos rnams kun la mgo bsgre ba'i// rigs pa rang stong smra ba la// yin no de las gzhan la min// de yang bum sogs yod do zhes// rang gi 'dzin pa lhan skyes dang*// pha rol dngos por smra ba yi// phyogs snga ma de khas len na// bum pa la sogs de chos can// gcig dang du ma gang rung du// thal lo yod pa'i phyir zhes sogs// mi 'dod thal ba rgyud mar ni// 'phangs pas rgol ba gzhan de la// grags pa'i gtan tshigs khas blangs dang*// thal chos tshad mas bsal mod kyang*// dbu ma pa la khas blangs pa// med pas rgol ba gzhan de yi// rigs pas brdzi bar nus ma yin// de tshe tha snyad bden pa la// bskur pa btab ces zer ba la// rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i phyir// tha snyad bden pa'i ngor yod ces// rang rgyud sbyar yang 'gal med de// don dam dbang du ma byas phyir// kun rdzob bden par yod gyur dang*// rten cing 'brel par 'byung gyur pas// yod ma yin pa 'gal zhe na// rten 'brel don ni ltos grub dang*// de ma grub pa'i don yin par// dbu ma'i gzhung dang der 'jug pa'i// gzhung las gsal bar gsungs phyir ro// kun rdzob zhes pa sgrib byed dang*// rigs pas dpyad mi bzod pa dang*// blo yi yul du gyur la bshad// don dam de las ldog pa ste// rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i// kun rdzob yod pa ma yin no// dbu ma pa 'dis don dam pa'i// bden pa yod par khas blangs na// skabs der rigs par dpyad bzod dang*// ltos grub min pa'i chos khas blangs// bden med yod pa khas blangs tshe// bden grub kyang ni de lta dang*// bden par grub pa mi 'dod na// bden med kyang ni de lta ste// gnyis po ltos nas 'jog pa'i phyir// phan tshun spangs pa ltos grub tu// 'jog pa'i go don ma yin na// stong pa nyid las ma gtogs pa'i// rten cing 'brel 'byung khas len 'gyur// de ltar yod med gnyis yin pa// khegs tshe gnyis ma yin pa'ang*// khegs te de ma yin pa ni// de yin pa la ltos phyir ro// spros pa'i mtha' bzhi khegs pa na// spros bral tshad mas grub zer ba// min te spros la ma ltos pa'i// spros bral blo la 'char mi srid// don dam blo yi yul min par// gsungs la 'jigs par mi bya ste// rtog dang rtog med ma gtogs pa'i// blo ni yod pa min phyir dang*// nam mkha' gsal bar snang ba yi// rtog pa med sems mi srid pa// de bzhin med dgag gsal snang gi

/shes pa mkhas rnams mi bzhed do// rtog pa'i yul du gang shar ba// kun kyang don dam bden min te// rtog pa ma rig gis bslad phyir// kun rdzob bden las 'da' mi srid// rigs pa 'di dag gi skabs su// rtags dpe la sogs gang dgos pa// thams cad gzhan grags nyid yin phyir// dbu ma pa la khas blangs med// dbu ma zhes pa mtha' gnyis dang*// bral la de yi ming gis btags// dbus la'ang gnas par mi 'dod na// mtha' gzhan khas len smos ci dgos// rang lugs spros pa kun bral phyir// tha snyad bden yod gzhan gyi lugs// de phyir lam gyi mnyam gzhag tu// spros pa'i mtshan ma kun las grol// spros med chos kyi dbyings las ni// bzhengs pa'i bsod nams tshogs sog tshe// 'jig rten lhan cig skyes blo la// mthun par grags pa'i don dam bden// kun la yang dag kun rdzob zhes// ming du btags nas rnam shes la// gang snang thad sor bzhag byas nas// gnyis snang bag chags ma spangs pa// de srid byed po rnam shes kyis// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs par byed// gang shar thad sor 'jog pa dang*// 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa zhes pa// 'gal ba 'dus par mi bsam ste// rnam shes ngo na snang ba dang*// ye shes dang ni rig shes kyi// ngo na ci yang mi dmigs pa// 'gal la mi 'khrul min phyir ro// dbu ma pa 'dis 'jig rten gyi// don dam bden pa tha snyad du// khas blangs pa na de de yi// rang lugs nyid du 'gyur snyam na// ma yin tha snyad kun rdzob pa// thams cad 'khrul par 'chad phyir ro// tha snyad dus su ye shes kyis// ci yang mi dmigs par byed na// tha snyad bden pa rigs pa yis// dpyad nas 'jog par 'gyur zhe na// 'khor gsum por ni gang snang ba// de la mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa// dmigs pa med pa'i don yin gyi// rnam par shes pas rang gi yul// dmigs pa med par byed min no// de ltar yod ma yin pa yis// rtag pa'i mtha' sel med min pas// chad mtha' sel ba dbu ma yi// lugs zhes tha snyad du 'chad kyi// tha snyad du yod bden med kyis// mtha' gnyis sel zhes zer ba rdzun// rnam shes snang ba mi 'dor zhing*// gang shar de la rnam shes kyis// bden dang mtshan mar 'dzin med pa// spyod pa'i mtha' gnyis sel tshul lo// spros 'gog gzhan grags rjes dgag gis// dgag bya 'gog par 'chad byed kyi// bsgrub bya gzhal ba 'dir mi bzhed// de phyir bsam byung shes rab kyis// cir yang 'dzin pa med byed kyi// mi dmigs nyid du'ang 'dzin mi byed// de nas goms par byed pa la// zhi gnas lhag mthong so so ba// zung du 'brel dang gcig gyur tshe// zung du 'jug pa yin zhes bya// so so skye bo'i sa dag tu// kun nas nyon mongs pa dang ni// rnam byang rtog pa gang rung dang*// ldan phyir zhi lhag so so ba// rnal 'byor mngon sum du gyur nas// zhi lhag zung du 'jug ces bya// mu stegs byed dang thun mong ba'i// zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba dang*// thun mong min pa sangs rgyas pa'i// zung du 'brel ba gnyis su dbye// dang po snyoms par 'jug brgyad la// sbyor dang dngos gzhi gnyis gnyis te// sbyor la zhi gnas lhag mthong gnyis// dngos gzhi zhi gnas 'ba' zhig pa// lhag mthong zhi rags rnam pa can// kho nar zad do zhi gnas ni// 'dod la 'dun dang rnam par 'tshe// mngon du gyur pas ma bcings pa'i// rtse cig pa tsam yin mod kyang*// ngar zhen pa dang nga yir 'dzin// mngon du gyur dang mtshungs ldan phyir// zag med lam gyi rten mi rung*// lhag mthong zhi rags rnam pa can// de la'ang sbyor dngos gnyis yin te// sbyor ba gong 'og sa rnams kyi// skyon dang yon tan thos bsam pa// de de nyid la mnyam 'jog pa// nyer bsdogs dus kyi zhi gnas te// de nas dga' dang bde skyes pa// dngos gzhir son pa'i zhi gnas so// sangs rgyas pa rnams gang zag la// bdag med thos bsam gyis sbyangs nas// zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i rim pa yis// grub tshe nga dang nga yi bar// zhen pa'i 'ching bas ma bcing phyir// zag med lam gyi rten du rung*// sangs rgyas pa yi so skye yang*// lhag mthong zhi rags rnam can gyis// 'og ma'i sa la chags bral nas// gong mar skye ba'i las sog byed// 'phags pa nyan thos pa dag kyang*// zhi rags rnam pa can dag gis// khams la chags bral byed do zhes// nyan thos sde pa 'dod mod kyang*// 'phags pa thob rjes 'khor bar ni// 'phen byed las sog byed pa'i lugs// de phyir thun mong ma yin pa'i// lhag mthong bden pa'i rnam pa can// skyes nas 'phags rnams zhi rags kyis// khams la chags bral byed mi srid// theg pa che rnams gang zag dang*// chos la bdag med thos bsam gyi// rigs pas shes pa sngon song nas// zhi gnas nyid la 'jug byed kyi// mtshan nyid rig sogs zhi rags kyis// khams la chags bral don mi gnyer// lus sems shin tu sbyangs can gyi// zhi gnas mngon du gyur de nas// bdag tu 'dzin pa mngon gyur dang*// bral ba'i zhi gnas rtse gcig pa// sbyor ba'i lam gyi mnyam bzhag tu// skyes pa de yang zung 'brel te// lhag mthong rnam par rtog pa dang*// mtshungs par ldan phyir zung 'jug min// lhag mthong dang ni zhi gnas kyi// dbye ba so sor mi phyed pa// de nas zung du 'jug pa ste// mthong ba'i lam nas mngon du gyur// thal 'gyur ba ni thos pa'i dus// rigs pa'i bsgrub bya khas mi len// bsam byung gis kyang 'di de zhes// gzhal bya nyid du zhen mi byed// rgol ba gzhan gyi blo ngor yang*// de de nyid la grags pa yi// rigs pas dgag bya 'gog pa dang*// khegs la thos bsam zhes su brjod// de ltar khegs pa'i rgyu de nyid// de dang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba yi// rnam par rtog pas ma dkrugs par// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal nyid// rtse gcig gyur pa'i zhi gnas dang*// bshad ma thag pa'i thos bsam gyi// shes rab spel mar goms byed pa// de la zhi lhag so so ba'i// skabs dang dpyad bsgom zhes bya dang*// zhi lhag ngos 'dzin ting 'dzin dang*// shes rab nyid la 'jog ces bya// de nas ting 'dzin shes rab kyang*// chos kun rang rang gis stong pa'i// stong pa nyid dang ro gcig par// gyur la zung 'jug zhes su brjod// rang rgyud pa dag thos pa yi// rigs pas bsgrub bya sgrub pa dang*// bsgrubs pa de nyid rjes dpag gi

/gzhal bya yin par khas len mod// gzhal bya de yang rten 'brel gyi// rtags las yod pa'i mtha' bsal nas// spros bral nyid du thag bcad pa// de nas zhi lhag zung du sbrel// zla bas 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag du// blo yod min par bzhed pa yi// 'thad pa yul dang yul can kun// stong pa nyid du ro gcig phyir// zhi 'tsho rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum// rang rig nyid du khas len cing*// legs ldan rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung*// 'gog mod mnyam bzhag blo mi 'gog /mnyam bzhag dus su spros pa'i tshogs// ci yang gzigs pa med nyid las// gzhan pa'i spros bral rtogs tshul ni// thal rang gzhung las gsungs pa med// mnyam par bzhag la blo med tshe/ rjes shes gang las 'byung shes na// ji srid gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi /bag chags ma spangs de srid du// bag chags de las yang dag pa// min pa'i kun rtog ngang gis skye// rdzogs sangs rgyas ni mnyam bzhag las// nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i phyir// gzhan snang ma gtogs rang rgyud kyi// shes bya'i mkhyen tshul 'dir ma bshad// shes par bya la ma ltos pa'i// shes byed med cing sangs rgyas par// shes bya'i bud shing zad pa'i phyir// shes blo med ces zla bas gsungs// gzugs sku'i snang ba gang 'char ba// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs dbang gi /gzhan snang yin kyang rgyud gzhan gyis// bsdus pa skabs 'dir mi bzhed do// 'di ltar 'chad pa zla grags dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas la skur 'debs zhes// rje btsun grags pas gang gsungs dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas la ye shes ni// yod med spros pa las 'das zhes// 'jigs med paṇa chen gyis gsungs pa// snga ma zla ba'i sngags gzhung gi /dgongs pa nyid dang phyi ma ni// zla ba'i rigs gzhung nyid la dgongs// phar phyin theg pa'i skabs 'dir ni// gang zag dang ni chos rnams la// so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis// dpyad pa sngon du ma song ba'i// zhi gnas srid mod lhag mthong ni// rnam dag srid pa ma yin no// de phyir mos pas spyod pa'i sar// gnas lugs tshol ba'i sor rtog dang*// rtsal bas gang du'ang ma rnyed pa'i// ngang las g.yo med zhi gnas dag

/thun re bzhin yang spel mar ni// rnal 'byor nyid du byed ces pa// dbu ma'i man ngag gzhung gi ni// dgongs par pu to ba yis bshad// man ngag pa rnams gzung 'dzin gyi// sems rnams kun gyi ngo bo de// gang du gnas zhes tshol byed kyi// shes rab gzhan gyis btsal ba na// 'od gsal ba las gang du yang*// ma rnyed ngang du mnyam 'jog pa// zhi lhag zung 'jug yin zhes gsungs// lugs 'di dag la go rim bzhin// bod rnams dpyad dang 'jog sgom zer// gnyis ka la yang rigs pa yi// dpyad pa sngon du song dgos kyang*// dngos gzhi'i dus su dpyad 'jog gi /dbye ba nam yang yod ma yin// rigs pa de yang rang stong dang*// gzhan stong rigs pas phye ba dang*// mnyam par bzhag yul ma yin dang*// med par dgag pa'i dbye bas phye// lugs gnyis pa la gzhung lugs pas// rigs pas gtan la ma phab pa'i// kun rdzob bsgom byar song zhes dang*// lugs dang po la man ngag pas// yon tan rten du mi rung ba'i// nam mkha' bsgom byar byas gsungs mod// gnyis ka'ang rang gzhung rnam dag phyir// gang 'dir dpyad pa mi dgos mod// gzhan dag mnyam gzhag dngos gzhi'i tshe// bdag med pa dang bden med zhes// rtog pas zhen par ma byas na// bdag 'dzin bden 'dzin gnyis ka dang*// 'dzin stangs 'gal ba med pa'i phyir// zhi gnas ltengs po tsam 'gyur gyi// bden 'dzin sa bon drung 'byin pa'i// zhi lhag zung 'jug min zhes smra// ji ltar sbrul la bzung nyes dang*// sman chen dug du song sogs kyi// bshad pa slar yang 'ongs pa'i phyir// 'di la dwang ba skye mi dgos// 'on kyang lung las lhag mthong la// thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab dang*// bsgom byung gnyis su phye ba yod// dang po rnam par rtog bcas dang*// phyi ma rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum// spang bya'i sa bon drung 'byin pa'i// gnyen po mthong sgom lam dag gi

/mnyam bzhag las gzhan gsungs pa med// de dag rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i// shes las gzhan du srid ma yin// de ltar thos dang bsam pa dang*// bsgom byung rtog bcas rtog med kyi// ngos 'dzin rgyas pa bshad zin nas// tshul bzhin goms par byed tshul 'chad// thog mar dkon mchog gsum po yi// go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i blos// yon tan mthong nas mi phyed pa'i// dwang bas skyabs 'gro rtsam par bya// de nas dkon mchog rnam gsum po'i// drung nyid dpang por gsol btab ste// yan lag bdun pa sngon 'gro bas// smon 'jug sdom pa blang bar bya// byang chub smon pa'i sems las ni// nam yang nyams pa med bzhin du// byang chub 'jug pa'i bslab bya kun// mnyan nas tshul bzhin goms par bya// de nas gang zag nyid du ni// rmongs pa bzlog par bya ba'i phyir// ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyis btags pa'i// nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa ni// yul dang bcas pa yod min par// rigs pas gtan la phab byas nas// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'am// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// dbu ma lta ba'i khrid 'di yi// sngon 'gro'i gtso 'khor de goms bya// de nas sbyin pa rnam gsum dang*// tshul khrims gsum dang bzod pa gsum// rnal 'byor blo yi rim pa yis// bsod nams tshogs la brtson 'grus brtsom// de nas nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib// drung nas 'byin byed lhag mthong gi /ye shes spros pa kun bral ba// nyid la myur du 'jug bya'i phyir// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya ste// de yang 'khor ba'i chos kun la// chags dang sdang dang rmongs pa yis// rnam par dben pas ngang gis 'grub// de tshe lus ngag sems gsum po// dam pa'i chos la thos pa dang*// bsam pas kyang ni dben dgos na// rnam par dben gzhan smos ci dgos// de ltar dben pa sngon btang nas// dngos gzhi dmigs rten gcig nyid la// g.yeng gzhan spangs te rtse gcig pas// dmigs med nyid du song ba'i tshe// de de nyid la mnyam par bzhag

/de ltar rim gyis goms pa las// ji tsam 'dod par 'jog nus shing*// lus sems shin tu sbyangs thob pa// de tshe zhi gnas grub zhes bya// der rjes rigs pa'i tshogs gzhung las// gsungs pa'i gzhan grags rigs pa yi// shes rab pha rol phyin pa las// gsungs pa'i spros pa kun bral ba// nyid las spros pa'i mtha' gzhan du// mi 'phro ba ni dngos gzhi yi// lhag mthong yin te de nyid la// ring du mnyam par 'jog nus pa// de nyid zhi lhag zung 'jug go /de yi sngon du spros bral nyid// nges pa'i bsam byung shes rab la// lhag mthong zhes bshad rgyu la ni// 'bras bu'i ming gis btags pa ste// dgos pa so sor rtog pa yi// shes rab sngon du ma song ba'i// lhag mthong med par rtogs phyir dang*// dngos la gnod byed sgra don gyi// mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog yin phyir// shes bya yongs su gcod pa yi// gnyen po nyid du goms bya min// mtshan 'dzin rigs pas bkag pa na// mtshan med nyid du zhen pa'i blo// las dang po la skye srid kyang*// de yang spros pa'i mthar yin zhes// bkag pas dug 'joms sman de nyid// dug du 'gyur bar dogs mi bya// de ltar phar phyin phyi ma gnyis// zung 'jug spros pa kun bral ba// bsod nams tshogs dang thabs gcig tu// sa bdun bar du goms byas pas// nyon mongs can gyi ma rig pa// kun gyi sa bon las grol zhing*// mthong dang bsgom pas spang bya ba'i// shes bya'i sgrib pa'i sa bon yang*// gang yang spangs pa de las grol// sa brgyad pa der mtshan 'dzin gyi// rtog pa kun las grol gyur kyang*// gnyis snang bag chags zad bya'i phyir// mtshan med nyid la ring du 'jug /de tshe bskal pa las lhag par// de la snyoms par 'jug nus mod// ha cang thal na bsod nams kyi// tshogs chen mtha' dag ma rdzogs par// shes bya'i sgrib kun spangs srid pas// sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'gog las bslong*// bslong mod rgyun gyi mtha' mar ni// mnyam par bzhag las ma langs pa'i// ngang de nyid las tshogs gnyis po// rdzogs shing sgrib kun spangs pa'i phyir// stobs sogs yon tan ji snyed la// sgrib byed kun las grol gyur cing*// dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin gyi// nor bu ji bzhin gzhan snang du// rgyun mi chad dang lhun grub pa'i// phrin las tshogs chen ngang gis 'jug

/zhes 'di bsnyengs pa kun bral ba'i// 'jigs med zla ba grags pa'i gzhung*// phyis byung rang gzo'i rnam dpyod kyi// rnam par brtags pas ma bslad par// sngon byon chen po'i gzhung ji bzhin// rgyud pa'i srol las 'ongs pa yin// de yi dge bas bdag dang yang*// rnam bshad 'di la yid rangs pa// kun kyang gnas skabs bsod nams kyi// tshogs chen rgya mtshor rab zhugs nas// mthar thug spros pa kun bral ba'i// gzhan don lhun gyis grub par shog /ces dbu ma lta ba'i khrid zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'jug pa ngo mtshar rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dngos 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa gting nas zhig pa/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel sgyu mar thugs su chud nas/ bstan pa rin po che'i khur chen zhum pa med pas 'degs pa la/ bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shākya rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi rna ba'i dbang pos ji ltar myangs pa de nyid/ rang gzo'i rtog pas ma sbags par/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos lcags mo bya'i lo khrums kyi nya ba'i dus sbyor bzang po la nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rkong ston chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'o// //shu bhaṃ/// / ༄༅// sde snod kyi chos la 'khrul pa sel ba'i gtam chos tshan bcu bzhi pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// swasti/ sde snod kyi chos la 'khrul pa sel ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzam gling bstan pa'i nyi ma ni// ba glang spyod gling nam mkha' yi// dbus kyi shing rta'i khrir zhugs tshe// rnam dpyod cha shas bsags pa'i gter/ gya gyu'i ri dwags mtshan ma can// shar gling dbus kyi mkha' la shar// de nas 'dzam gling bstan pa'i tshal// nyi gzhon gser gyis rab phye ba'i// sngon dus bstan pa'i 'dab brgya pa// blta 'dod mtshan mo'i bung ba ni// ngan rtog drag po'i gtsug rgyan gyis// rab rgyas utpal phreng ba la// deng sang 'di na dga' mgur spyod// de nas de yi de kho na// mun par byed pa'i rnam dpyod kyi// nyin byed lung dang rigs pa yi// shing rtar zhugs pa 'di shar to// gang dag klu sgrub zhabs gzhung gi

/dbu ma rigs pas 'chad zer dag /chos rnams ji snyed rten 'brel dang*// rten 'brel gang yin yod dgos pa// de yis chad mtha' rab sel zhing*// rten 'brel gang yin stong pa nyid// yin pa'i phyir na rtag pa'i mtha'// kun las grol ba yin zhes zer// de 'dra de skad dbu ma'i lugs// min no lung las 'di ltar 'byung*// rten 'brel don ni ltos grub dang*// ltos grub go don ma grub par// bshad phyir yod na mtha' dang bcas// mtha' yod rten 'brel du mi rung*// rten 'brel mtha' bral nyid phyir ro// rten 'brel mtha' bzhi las grol phyir// rten 'brel yin na yod pa dang*// med par yang ni 'gal ba ltar// yod med la sogs mtha' bzhi po// gang yang rten 'brel du mi rung*// ltos grub nyid phyir grub dgos na// shar phyogs rtag tu shar dang ni// nub phyogs rtag tu nub nyid du// thal bar 'gyur te rang rang gi /ltos sa de las de grub phyir// shar gyi phyogs gang nub dang ni// nub kyang shar gyi phyogs nyid du// thal bar 'gyur te rang rang gi /ltos sa de las de grub phyir// da ltar skyes bu'i 'dod pa yis// shar nub phyogs su gang btags pa// de de grub pa min pa yi// shes byed gzhan la ltos phyir ro// de ni pha rol tshu rol dang*// ring po dang ni thung ngu dang*// g.yas g.yon sogs la'ang snga ma yi// rigs pas brtags nas shes par bya// shar phyogs shar du ma grub na// ka bum sogs kyang rang rang du// yod pa min pas grub pa'i chos// srid pa min par thal zhe na// gang gang rten 'brel yin no zhes// khas len gyur tshe de dang de// yod pa min zhes zer ba la// ngo mtshar che ba ci zhig yod// rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba gang*// de ni stong pa nyid du bshad// 'jig rten pa dang mthun 'jug tshe// 'jig rten pa la grags pa'i chos// de kun ltos nas grub bo zhes// 'jig rten pa la gsung mi mdzad// mthun par gsungs pas dad gyur te// rang gi bstan la zhugs pa na// chos kun spros bral yin no zhes// gsungs pas spros pa'i mtha' las grol// gzhan yang de rjes 'jug pa rnams// yod la spros bral des khyab dang*// spros bral la'ang yod pa yis// khyab dang stong pa nyid kyi don// chos kun yod par khas blangs nas// med pa'i chos gzhan gyis stong pa// rten 'brel don du 'dod pa sogs// lung dang mi mthun rigs pas kyang*// mi 'grub gangs can ljongs dag tu// sngon byon kun gyi gtam dang 'gal// ces chos la 'khrul pa sel ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa las rten 'brel dang stong nyid kyi go don dpyad pa'i le'u ste dang po'o//

// ༄// bcom ldan ngag gi dbang phyug la// phyag 'tshal nas ni thogs med kyi// gzhung las 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi// don gang yin zhes bsam par bya// rten 'brel gang yin ltos grub tu// 'di pa'i gzhung las 'byung ma yin// rkyen las skyes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis// 'dus byas yin par lugs 'dis 'chad// 'dus byas ji snyed rang stong du// chos kyi grags pas rigs pas 'chad// dngos la mi rtag gis khyab pa// rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i gzhung las 'byung*// 'dus ma byas pa'i dngos po rnams// rtag par mngon pa'i gzhung las bshad// kun rdzob rang rang ngo bo yis// stong phyir rtag chad mtha' las grol// don dam pa la yod pa dang*// med sogs 'dzin pa sel dgos kyang*// don dam rgyun gyis rtag pa dang*// bden par grub pa sel mi dgos// don dam bden pa gang yin pa// mtha' bzhi'i spros pa las grol kyang*// tshad mas grub pa sel mi dgos// 'dzin pa med phyir mtha' bral grub// rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes// de la skye ba yod ma yin// rkyen la rag las stong par bshad// zhes pa'i mdo don 'dis 'chad do// lugs 'dis bden grub khas blangs phyir// bden 'dzin spong bar mi nus zhes// phyis byon tsong kha pa chen po// rjes 'brang bcas rnams mthun par smra// khyed la'ang bum sogs yod pa'i phyir// yod 'dzin rtog pa mi spong 'gyur// bden 'dzin rang gi ngo bo yis// stong par rtogs phyir sel bar sla// yul gang bden med ma rtogs par// de 'dzin sel bar mi nus na// theg mchog rtse mo'i bden 'dzin gyi// rtog pa spong lugs mi 'thad 'gyur// phar phyin pas kyang zla gnyis dang*// skra bshad bden med ma rtogs na// rab rib bsal ba tsam gyis ni// der 'dzin rtog pa mi spong 'gyur// rang rang gzhung bshad sgrib pa kun// der bshad gnyen pos mi sel na// drang nges 'byed par lung bstan pa'i// shing rta chen po de ngo mtshar// ces chos la 'khrul pa sel pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa las/

thogs med zhabs kyi stong nyid la log par smra ba sel ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // ༄༅// rgyal ba ngag gi dbang phyug la// phyag 'tshal mngon pa gong ma yi// chos gtam log par 'chad pa 'ga'// sel byed mdo tsam 'dir brjod bya// sngon byon kha cig sems tsam pa// phyi don zhal gyis bzhes zer dang*// phyi rabs 'di na gzugs sgra sogs// shes pa'i bdag nyid yin zhes zer// phyi don khas len sems tsam pa// rang tshig 'gal ba tsam gyis sel// don snang shes la der snang ba// don dang shes pa gang yin brtag /dang po rnam med rjen cher ba'i// lugs yin sems tsam pa la med// ser 'dzin shes la der snang ba// ser po yin pa bye smra'i lugs// der snang shes par 'dod na ni// gzugs sogs shes par smras chog gi /shes pa rang gi bdag nyid ces// bya ba'i tshig la nus pa med// gzhung las 'byung ba'i tha snyad ni// phung khams sum cu rtsa drug la// kun brtags rnam brtags chos nyid de// gsum gsum dag tu dbye mdzad nas// kun brtags ldog pa gzhan sel phyir// don min shes pa dag kyang min// rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin chos can// yin par gzhung las ma gsungs so// rnam brtags pa dang chos nyid kyi// dbang du byas na chos gsum gyi// rnam bzhag rgyas par gsungs pa de// sems tsam nyid yin gzhan ma yin// chos 'di'i lugs kyi bdag med gnyis// med par dgag pa tsam yin zhes// zer ba de dang dngos smra'i lugs// yin par 'dod pa gting nas 'gal// don dam don byed nus pa la// don dam bden par lugs 'di bzhed// med dgag ldog pa gzhan sel la// don dam bden pa'i tshig don 'gal// stong pa nyid dang de bzhin nyid// 'dus ma byas kyi dngos por bzhed// 'dus byas dngos kun mi rtag dang*// 'dus ma byas dngos rtag par bshad// dngos la mi rtag gis khyab pa// rnam 'grel mdzad lugs thun mong min// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang*// rang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi sku// rgyun gyis rtag phyir rtag brten zhes// lung chos phal che'i nang nas 'byung*// kun gzhi'i chos la rnam smin dang*// sa bon gnyis las med ces zer// kun gzhi yod pa'i lung gi ni// sgrub byed bde gshegs snying por bshad// bde gshegs snying po kun gzhi yi// ye shes nyid la lugs 'dis bshad// shes pa gang yin bden grub du// lugs 'di bzhed pa yin zhes zer// gzung rnam bden par 'dod pa ni// rnam rdzun smra ba'i lugs las nyams// chos 'di dngos smra'i lugs yin phyir// dngos kun bden par grub ces zer// 'dus byas ji snyed mi rtag dang*// mi rtag pa la bden med kyi// khyab pa byams chos bar pa gsum// rjes 'brang bcas pa'i lugs yin no// sems dang sems byung mtshan nyid du// rang stobs gzhan stobs zhes zer ba// dbus mtha' rnam 'byed rtsa 'grel dang*// 'gal bas khungs thub sgrub byed med// shes pa thams cad sems dang ni// sems byung nang du 'dus zhes zer// rnam shes dang ni ye shes kyi// dbye ba ma shes pas nongs shing*// theg pa chen po bsdus pa yi// gzhung dang dngos su 'gal ba dang*// dbus mthar yang dag min rtog gi

/rnam grangs 'chad pa'i skabs dang 'gal// snod kyi 'jig rten rnam bzhag dang*// dge 'dun nyi shur grags pa yi// rnam bzhag mdzod 'grel ji bzhin par// 'chad po kun gyis lugs 'di yi// thun mong min pa'i rnam bzhag ni// mkhas pa'i gsung las rgyas par slobs// zhes mngon pa gong ma'i rnam bzhag la 'khrul pa sel ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// // ༄// rgyal ba ngag gi dbang phyug la// phyag 'tshal rnam rig smra ba yi// grub pa'i mtha' la skur 'debs pa// bsal nas de don 'dir bsam bya// phyis byon grags pa gsal ldan dag /rnam rig pa dang rang rgyud pa'i// bdag med gnyis po thos bsam dang*// don spyi'i tshul gyis goms byed dang*// mngon sum mthong dang rgyun ldan du// goms byed yod par rnal 'byor pa'i// mngon sum sgrub byed rigs pa yis// 'grub mod thams cad mkhyen pa dang*// thar pa'i lam du rung min te// bdag med gnyis po ji bzhin par// rtogs pa med pas lan zhes zer// slob dpon zla ba grags pa yis// phye ba'i lam srol ma gtogs pa// 'khor lo gsum pa dgongs 'grel bcas// kun la skur ba btab min nam// skur 'debs de yang ma pham pas// rgyud blar lung bstan mdzad min nam// 'di'i shes byed rang gzhung la// skur 'debs 'byung bar mkhyen pas so// rang rgyud ces bya'i bshad srol gyi// gtan tshigs rgyal ba'i bka' las 'byung*// byams pa'i chos sogs tshad ldan gyi// bstan bcos rnams las gsal bar gsungs// spros med sgrub pa'i rigs pa dang*// der zhen pa yang 'gog pa yi// rigs tshul bsam tshe nges pa'i don// thal 'gyur ba las 'di mi ngan// gzung ba chos kyi bdag med las// lhag pa'i lta ba rnam rig pa// kun la med na byams chos kyi// sa lam kun la skur 'debs 'gyur// byams pas drang ba'i don mdzad na// thogs med kyis kyang drang ba'i don// ji bzhin sgra yi 'chad byed na// drang nges 'byed par lung ston pa'i// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa de 'khrul 'gyur// de nas rnam rig smra ba yi// grub mthar theg pa gsum char gyi// lta bas thar par bgrod pa'i lam// ma tshang med pa 'di yin no// spyir ni rnam par rig ces pa// rnam par rig las ma gtogs pa'i// bden pa gnyis po mi 'jog cing*// gnyis su shes bya thams cad 'du// rnam rig smra la sems tsam dang*// dbu mar smra ba'i dbye bas gnyis// sems tsam pas ni phyi rol don// med dang kun rdzob bden par 'chad// bag chags dbang gi der snang ba'i// rnam shes yod dang don dam bden// phyi rol don gyis stong pa yi// gsal rig dmigs par byas goms pas// rang sangs rgyas kyi lta thob ste// gzung ba chos kyi bdag 'dzin sel// lta ba de dang byang chub sems// zung du sbrel bas theg chen gyi// nges 'byed cha mthun thob par gsungs// rnam rig smra ba'i dbu ma pas// phyi rol don dang der snang gi

/rnam shes gnyis ka kun rdzob bden// gnyis stong ye shes dam pa'i don// gnyis stong ye shes rnam dag gi /dmigs par byas nas ring goms pa// byang chub sems dang zung 'brel las// sa bcu po ni mthar phyin byed// bdag med dang po ngos 'dzin pa'i// tshul la grub mtha' bzhi ga yang*// khyad par yod tshul ma bshad pas// kun kyang thar pa'i lam du mthun// ces rnam rig pa dang rang rgyud pa la skur 'debs sel ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // ༄// rgyal ba ngag gi dbang phyug la// phyag 'tshal rgyud bla'i bstan bcos su// sgro 'dogs pa dang skur 'debs pa// mdo tsam sel tshul 'dir brjod bya// sgro 'dogs pa ni sems can kun// stobs sogs yon tan kun tshang ba'i// sangs rgyas snying po can nyid du// gzhung 'dis dngos su bstan zhes zer// skur 'debs pa ni shes bya kun// bden pas stong pa'i stong pa nyid// sangs rgyas sems can gnyis ka yi// snying por gzhung 'dis bstan zhes gsungs// lugs snga ma de mdo mang po'i// dngos bstan yin mod gzhung 'dir ni// mdo yi dgongs pa 'grel mdzad nas// 'grel tshul chos gsum gsal bar gsungs// rang bzhin rnam dag stobs sogs dang*// glo bur rnam dag sgrib byed kyis// sgribs dang ma sgribs ma gtogs pa// rang bzhin ngo bo khyad med na// rang bzhin rnam dag stobs la sogs// sgribs pa kun dang bral ba dang*// dri mas kyang ni de dag la// sgrib par nus pa nyid mi 'gyur// snying po'i gtso bo stobs sogs kyi// yon tan kun dang dbyer med pa// sems can kun la yod min zhes// gzhung 'dis gsal bar bstan la ltos// shes rab pha rol phyin gzhung las// sangs rgyas sems can gnyis ka yis// rang bzhin med la rang bzhin dang*// snying po med la snying po zhes// btags nas bstan mod gzhung 'dir ni// med par dgag pa'i stong nyid la// snying por 'chad dang thogs med kyis// 'grel tshul cha shas tsam yang med// stong pa nyid kyi tshul du ni// brjod pa'i sangs rgyas snying po ni// bla med chos kyis mi stong ba'i// ye shes de la gzhung 'dis bshad// glo bur dri mas stong pa dang*// bla med chos kyis mi stong ba'i// go don glo bur dri ma dang*// bskal par 'grogs kyang dri ma de// ye shes ngo bor 'gyur mi srid// stong nyid blo dang snying rje sogs// goms pas gsal snang mched pa na// sems kyi rgyud dang dbyer med du// 'gyur zhes rnam 'grel mdzad pas gsungs// ces rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi nges don la sgro skur sel ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o//

// ༄༅// rgyal ba ngag gi dbang phyug la// phyag 'tshal yum dang klu sgrub gzhung*// zla bas 'jug par 'grel tshul la// sgro 'dogs mang zhig 'dir brtag bya// zla ba'i zhabs kyi dbu ma la// 'jug pas rtsa ba'i don 'grel tshe// rang rgyud pa dang sems tsam pa// phyogs sngar bzhag pa yin zhes gsung*// chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du// rtogs pa'i theg dman yod med tsam// ma gtogs 'jug par rang rgyud pa// phyogs sngar bzhag pa gcig kyang med// rang gi mtshan nyid rten gyur na// zhes pa de yis 'dod ces zer// rang rgyud pas ni chos rnams kun// rang rang ngo bos stong par 'dod// rang gi mtshan nyid kyi grub par// 'dod pa'i go skabs yod ma yin// dngos po don byed nus pa yi// mtshan nyid can du khyod kyang 'dod// de de yin pa sgro btags sam// yul gyi ngos nas grub par 'chad// gnyis pa ltar na khyed la 'gal// dang po ltar na dngos po de// don byed nus par sgro btags phyir// don byed nus par mi 'gyur bas// dngos kun tshad mas grub pa 'gal// stong nyid dngos po'i 'jig rgyur ni// thal ba'i nyes pa khyed la ste// rigs pas bshig na 'jig pa yi// gzugs sogs tshad grub khas blangs phyir// 'dir 'byung gzhan na med ces pa'i// gzhan de rang rgyud par 'chad pa// yin zhes zer la khungs med cing*// rang rgyud pa dag mi bzhed pa'i// 'jug par bshad pa'i stong pa nyid// 'di yin zhes pa 'jug pa yi// rtsa 'grel dag na yod ma yin// thal rang smra ba rnam gnyis po// byams pa'i gzhung gi dbu ma la// sems tsam zhes su sgro btags nas// dbu mar mi 'chad pa la mthun// gzhan dbang bden par grub pa ni// gzhung 'di'i phyogs sngar bzhag zer mod// mi bzhed bzhin du sgro 'dogs pa// de 'dra byams pa'i gzhung na med// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba yi// ye shes gzhan dbang yin zer ba// phyogs sngar bzhag nas su zhig 'gog

/byams pa'i gzhung las de ma bshad// ye shes gzhan dbang chos nyid du// 'dod pa 'gog na 'gog la rag /gzung med 'dzin pa nyid bral ba// sems tsam 'dod pa 'chad bzhin du// gzhan dbang bden grub 'dod ces pa// 'gal la mi 'khrul smra byed dam// yang dag min rtog ma yin pa'i// gzhan dbang ces pa des mi 'dod// des na gzung 'dzin gnyis med cing*// gnyis med ye shes yod ces pa// 'di nyid kho na dbu ma la// 'jug par 'chad pa'i phyogs snga ma// 'gog tshul bden pa gnyis po la// gcig yod gcig med ces bya ba// rigs pa min te gnyis ka yang*// ltos nas grub pa'i phyir zhes pa'o// gnyis med ye shes gcig pu de// gcig dang du ma dang bral bar// grub na dpal ldan zla ba yi// dgongs pa'i mthar thug de rdzogs so// sems tsam rang rgyud thal 'gyur la// rtags kyi dgag bya ngos 'dzin tshul// zhib tu re ba mang po ni// sbyar bas ches cher rtsings par gyur// chos can tshad grub khas blangs nas// dgag bya tshad mas ma grub pa// 'gog pa 'di 'dra ka ba sogs// bum pas stong par sgrub dang mtshungs// de phyir 'jug pa'i phyogs snga ni// thogs med zhabs kyis phye ba yi// srol las byung ba'i dbu ma de// grub mtha'i rtse mor bshad de'o// de yang 'di ltar brtag nus te// thogs med zhabs kyi bshad srol na// klu sgrub gzhung gi stong nyid la// chad stong nyid du rgol ba'i lan// yin mod de ltar lugs gnyis ka /dbu mar mtshungs la khyad yod min// gcig ni gtan la 'bebs tshul dang*// gcig shos nyams myong gtso phyir ro// ces dbu ma la 'jug pas dbu ma'i don gtan la 'bebs tshul la 'khrul pa sel ba ste le'u drug pa'o// // ༄// rgyal ba ngag gi dbang phyug la// phyag 'tshal nas ni zhi gnas dang*// lhag mthong ngos 'dzin phyi rabs pas// rnam par brtags pa de bsam bya// phyis byon grags pa gsal ldan dag

/shin sbyangs bde bas khyad par du// byas pa min pa'i rtse gcig pa// zhi gnas lam du mi 'gyur zhing*// lhag mthong ngo bo chos rnams la// so sor rtog cing dpyod pa'i blo// yin par lung rnams kun las
