gsal// rgan po'i gtam 'ga' 'khrul zhes gsungs// zhi gnas kun la shin sbyangs kyis// ma khyab par ni mdo rgyan dang*// mngon pa kun las btus su bshad// bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs dang*// gzugs med dngos gzhi'i zhi gnas sogs// shin sbyangs bde bas khyad par du// ma byas pa yang shin tu mang*// yid la byed dang bcas zhes par// 'jog 'tshams bde de thob la dgongs// lhag mthong ngo bo bsam byung gi /rtog par 'chad pa mi 'thad de// lhag mthong dngos ni sgom byung gi /ye shes nyid la bshad phyir dang*// sgra don 'dres 'dzin rtog pa dang*// bral ba'i rnal 'byor mngon sum kun// lhag mthong ye shes dngos min na// sgrib pa'i sa bon gang gis spong*// gzugs kyi khams na bsam byung dang*// gzugs med khams na thos bsam gyi// shes rab gnyis ka ma bshad phyir// lhag mthong ye shes med par 'gyur// rtog dpyod bral ba'i shes pa la// lhag mthong mtshan nyid mi tshang na// bsam gtan khyad par can dag dang*// dbang dang ye shes dbab la sogs// sngags kyi thabs mkhas khyad par las// byung ba'i lhag mthong mi srid 'gyur// mdo dang sgom rim sogs rnams su// lhag mthong ngos 'dzin bsam byung gi /shes rab nyid la gang bshad pa// lhag mthong dngos gzhi'i sbyor ba ste// phar phyin theg pa'i lhag mthong kun// thos bsam sngon 'gro can yin phyir// spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad po ni// lhag mthong dngos gzhi'i nyes pa rnams// sel bar byed pa'i thabs yin gyi// mtshungs ldan nyid du bshad mi dgos// rtog pa'i yul du gnas lugs kyi// don gang 'gro ba mi srid phyir// gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lhag mthong ni// rtog par 'chad pa shin tu 'khrul// don dam bden pa kun rdzob pa'i// blo'i yul min zer ba dang*// lhag mthong ngo bo rtog dpyod du// 'chad pa khas blangs 'gal min nam// thos bsam shes la brten pa yi// bdag med nges pa'i blo ji snyed// lhag mthong ngo bor khas len na// mngon rtogs rgyan las gsungs pa yi// rnam byang gzung rtog ces bya dang*// rtag 'dzin rtog pa zhes bya ba// gnyen po'i rten can rtog pa kun// lhag mthong nyid du thal bar 'gyur// btags pa tsam du bden zhes pa// kho bo'i ma ni mo gsham zhes// smra dang khyad yod ma yin te// btags pa tsam du shes gyur nas// bden par zhen pa 'gal phyir ro// po to ba yi zin bris las// thos bsam dus su rigs pa yis// dpyad nas bsgom pa'i dus dag tu// mi rtog 'ba' zhig sgom zer ba// 'brel med ting 'dzin sgom pa'i phyir// sgrib pa'i gnyen por mi 'gyur ro// zhes bshad pa de khyed cag gi

/khungs su byed pa yin mod kyi// mthong sgom lam gyi mnyam bzhag tu// mi rtog 'ba' zhig sgom pa la// nyes pa brjod na lung rigs dang*// man ngag mtha' dag chud gson 'gyur// po to ba'i gsung 'di ni// sde snod chos la ring sbyangs pa'i// mtshan nyid pa rnams sgom dus su// sngon sbyangs pa dang 'brel med pa'i// gyi na'i man ngag sgom la gsungs// yang dang yang du sems pa dang*// 'jal dang nges rtog ces gsungs pa// sems dang rtog pa thos bsam dang*// yang na sngon 'gro rjes yin zhes// 'phags dang seng ge bzang po gsung*// zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi gnas la 'khrul pa sel ba'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bdun pa'o// // ༄// rgyal ba ngag gi dbang phyug la// phyag 'tshal dpal ldan chos grags kyi// rnam 'grel dngos smra'i chos yin zhes// zer ba'i gtam de spang bar bya// dngos smra zhes pa rtag pa'i dngos// nam yang bden par khas blangs na// bden 'dzin spong ba'i gnyen po ni// mi 'chad pa la zer ba yin// rnam 'grel mdzad pas de mi bzhed// ci phyir zhe na dngos po la// mi rtag nyid kyis khyab pa dang*// mi rtag med pa'i don du bshad// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung phal mo cher// 'dus ma byas pa'i dngos po dang*// chos sku rtag par bshad mod kyi// rgyun gyis rtag pa la dgongs nas// rtag par bshad pa'i dngos rnams kyang*// skad cig nyid kyi mi rtag par// rnam 'grel mdzad pas bshad pa yin// mdor na rnam 'grel mdzad pa ni// gcig dang du bral rigs pa yis// ldog pa gzhan sel smos ci dgos// gzung 'dzin ji snyed bden med dang*// dngos la mi rtag gis khyab pa'i// rigs pas 'dus ma byas dngos dang*// rtag pa'i dngos por byas rnams kyang*// skad cig gis ni 'jig par bshad// 'o na dngos la dngos med kyis// khyab par 'gyur te mi rtag don// dngos med yin pa'i phyir zhe na// dngos dang mi rtag 'jog mtshams ni// ma dpyad pa dang dpyad pa ste// dngos po mngon du gyur pa dang*// mi rtag lkog gyur nyid phyir ro// mi rtag pa la dngos med kyis// khyab pa'ang shin tu dpyad pa ste// ltos pa med na skad cig kyang*// dngos por med ces bshad dang mtshungs// rigs pas dpyad tshe dngos po'i chos// ci yang yod pa ma yin na// rnam 'grel ngo bo nyid med du// smra ba'i gzhung dang khyad ci na// rgyan dang zhi ba 'tsho gnyis po// rnam 'grel mdzad gzhung de ltar 'dod// ces pa rngog lo chen po'i gsung*// phywa pa rnam 'grel mdzad gzhung ni// slob dpon zla ba grags pa ltar// 'jig rten grags sde spyod pa yi// dbu ma nyid du gnas zhes zer// ngo bo nyid med smra ba dang*// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtsho yi// srol chen 'byed pa'i slob dpon rnams// gzhung lugs phan tshun 'chol pa med// gnyis med ye shes thos bsam gyi// rigs pas dpyad pa'i ngor med kyang*// mnyam bzhag sgom byung ye shes kyi// myong bya nyid phyir don dam bden// 'jigs med chos kyi grags pa ni// grub pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i tshe// ngo bo nyid med smra ba yi// grub mthar 'jug dgos ma yin no// zhes rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i ring lugs la 'khrul pa smra ba sel ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa ste brgyad pa'o//

// ༄// rgyal ba ngag gi dbang phyug la// phyag 'tshal nas ni spyod 'jug gi /gzhung don log par sgro 'dogs pa// 'ga' zhig drang pos 'dir dpyad bya// phyis byon grags pa gsal ldan 'ga'// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la// thogs med lugs dang zhi ba lha'i// ngos 'dzin khyad par med ces gsungs// 'o na thogs med gzhung dag tu// byang chub smon pa'i sems btang ba// rtsa ba'i ltung bar bshad 'gyur te// zhi ba lha yi der bshad phyir// gzhan yang don dam blo yi yul// min na lung rigs dang 'gal zer// 'o na don dam ngos 'dzin ci// bden pas stong pa nyid ce na// gzhan sel spyod yul du byed pa'i// rtog pa med blo mi srid cing*// sgra dang rtog pa'i yul gang yin// don dam bden pa nyid du 'gal// des na rigs pas dpyad bzod pa'i// blo med phyir na kun rdzob las// ma gtogs chos gzhan yod ma yin// de phyir blo kun kun rdzob nges// bden pa gnyis su 'chad min nam// zhe na gzhung 'dir stong pa nyid// rdzun par bshad pa snyon mi nus// rdzun na don dam bden pa 'gal// rnal 'byor gong ma'i blo khyad kyis// 'og mar gnod tshul 'chad pa na// nyan thos sems tsam rang rgyud pa'i// bdag med go chod min zhes gsungs// de dag so so'i gzhung lugs su// thar lam nges par ma bstan phyir// sangs rgyas chos su mi rung zhing*// phyag rgya bzhi dang 'gal bar 'gyur// de la don dam rnam gnyis te// rnal 'byor pa dang 'jig rten pa// rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis// 'og ma bden par 'dod de la// gong ma'i rigs pas dpyad mi bzod// 'o na 'og ma'i don dam la// rigs pas gnod par 'gyur zhe na// 'jig rten pa yi ngos mthong zhing*// sgyu ma lta bur min pas 'dir// rnal 'byor pa dang 'jig rten rtsod// rnal 'byor can 'gas bdag med gnyis// dam pa'i don gyi bden 'dod cing*// sgyu ma lta bur min pas 'dir// rnal 'byor gong ma pa dang rtsod// ji ltar mthong thos shes pa dag

/'dir ni dgag par bya min te// zhes gsungs phyir na kun rdzob kyi// bden pa tshad mas grub ces gsung*// 'o na gzugs sogs kun rdzob kyang*// grags pas 'grub kyi tshad mas min// zhes gsungs pa dang mi 'gal lam// de don gzugs sogs yod nyid kyang*// grags pas 'grub kyi zhes par nges// gzhung 'dir rang rig bkag pa'i don// gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus chos thams cad// yod pa bkag nas gnyis med kyi// ye shes gcig pu khas len pa// de la brtag pa mdzad yin gyi// tha snyad du yang rang rig dang*// rang gsal zhes bya'i brda tsam ni// 'gog par mdzad pa ma yin no// de yang gzhan gyis ma byas par// rang nyid rig par skyes tsam la// rang rig pa zhes brda byas kyi// rig bya rig byed gnyis mi 'byed// bai ḍūrya yi sngon po la// rang sngo'i tha snyad byas pa bzhin// de nas gzung 'dzin gnyis po dang*// gnyis med ltos nas grub pa'i phyir// gcig yod gzhan med ga la srid// bden grub bden med kyang de bzhin// gang phyir lung las zhes sogs su// chos kyi bdag med ma bstan na// thar lam med par bshad ces zer// de don dman pa'i thar pa'am// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid la zer// phyi ma ltar na 'dod pa mthun// dang po ltar na nang 'gal te// chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs kyang*// nyon mongs spangs par bshad pas so// mngon par bshad pa'i nyon mongs la// dgongs zhes zer na de spangs phyir// thar pa nyid du gdon mi za// lugs 'dir bden 'dzin nyon mongs su// bzhed ces zer na shes sgrib ci// gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags so// she na sems tsam pa yis kyang*// 'di 'dod phyir na thal 'gyur ba'i// thun mong min pa'i grub mthar 'gal// gzhung 'di'i lugs la thar pa ni// mi gnas myang 'das kho nar nges// skabs der blo dang chos rnams kun// stong pa nyid du ro gcig phyir// yul dang yul can gnyis su med// dmigs dang bcas pa'i sems yod na// yang dag mtha' las ldang gyur te// stong pa nyid dang bral ba'i phyir// 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhin// dmigs med phyir na chos sku las// ldang mi srid kyang gzhan gyi don// dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin gyi// nor bu ji bzhin rgyun mi chad// ces spyod 'jug mkhan po'i gzhung don la log par sgro 'dogs pa sel ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o//

// ༄// rgyal ba ngag gi dbang phyug la// phyag 'tshal byang sems sdom pa la// shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis byung ba// de'i ngos 'dzin brtag par bya// 'di la rje btsun na sa skya pas// de gnyis lta ba tha dad pas// cho ga yang ni tha dad yin// zhes gsungs pa la rgol ba 'ga'// dbu sems gnyis kyi khyad par ni// lta ba so so bas 'byed kyi// sems bskyed sdom pa'i ngos 'dzin gyi// mtshan nyid gcig tu nges shes zer// 'o na smon pa'i sdom pa dang*// 'jug pa'i sdom pa so so yi// mtshan nyid dang ni 'thob tshul dang*// gtong tshul so so'i bslab bya dang*// rtsa ba'i ltung ba gcig tu 'gyur// 'dod na srol 'byed gnyis po yi// gzhung nas 'byung ba kun dang 'gal// rtsa ba'i khyab 'brel ci zhe na// thogs med gzhung na smon sems kyi// sdom pa'i rnam gzhag ma gsungs la// bslab spyod gnyis las de gsungs phyir// yin mod lta ba'i khyad par las// de ltar 'byung ba ci zhe na// gzung ba chos kyi bdag med tsam// lta bar byas pa'i sems tsam pas// 'jug pa'i sdom pa ma blangs na// rang sangs rgyas su nyams par sla// 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med pa// lta bar bya ba'i dbu ma pas// smon pa sems bskyed tsam gyis kyang*// theg chen chos las nyams pa med// de la kha cig 'di skad du// rgyan dang byang chub sems dpa'i sa// dbu ma'i gzhung lugs yin gyur na// sems bskyed sems tsam lugs su 'gal// gzhan yang 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi// sdom pa dbu sems gnyis ka la// thun mong nyid phyir sems tsam gyi// lugs su 'chad pa ci zhes zer// byang sa nas gsungs cho ga de// sems tsam kho na'i lugs yin zhes// 'chad kyang 'jug pa'i sdom pa de// sems tsam lugs su des mi 'chad// byang sa'i lta ba mthar thug pa// dbu mar nges kyang sems bskyed kyi// cho ga gnas skabs sems tsam pa'i// lta ba de dang sbyar nas bshad// rgyan dang byang sa nas bshad pa'i// sems tsam lta ba gang yin pa// gzung ba chos kyi bdag med pa'i// lta ba las gzhan bshad pa med// gzhung de dag nas gsungs pa yi// 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med pa// cho ga gnyis po'i khyad 'byed kyi// sems tsam lta bar sa skya pas// 'chad na de las khrel ba dang*// ngo tsha'i gnas kyang gzhan yod min// des na sa skya'i lugs 'dzin zhes// skad gzengs mthon pos smra de dag

/mkhas par 'dod na rgyas par slobs// bag zon byos la mdzangs par smros// ces sems bskyed kyi sdom pa'i rnam bzhag shing rta'i srol tshul gnyis las byung tshul sa skya pas bshad pa la log par smra ba sel ba'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// // ༄// ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// bdag dang bdag med ngos 'dzin la// sgro 'dogs skur 'debs ma bsal na// bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'khrul 'gyur phyir// de don gang yin bsam bya ba// mu stegs byed pa gang zag dang*// bdag sogs rdzas yod kho nar smra// sangs rgyas grub mtha' smra ba bzhi// btags yod kho nar 'chad la mthun// chos kyi bdag yod smra ba kun// chos de rdzas su yod par 'dod// btags pa'i chos dang gang zag kun// bdag dang bden zhes 'chad ma yin// btags yod nges pa'i blo dang ni// bdag dang bden par rtog pa'i blo// grub mtha' gcig la lhan cig tu// gnas pa'i go skabs med phyir ro// bdag gnyis med smra'i tshul 'di la// ngo bo nyid med du smra ba// ma gtogs grub mtha' smra ba bzhi// bdag med don dam bden par 'dod// de med tshul la rnam gnyis te// rigs pas gtan la phab tshul dang*// dngos po'i chos su gnas pa'o// dang po ldog pa gzhan sel phyir// dam pa'i don du yod ma yin// don dam don byed nus phyi ma// dam pa'i don du 'chad pa yin// nang pa'i grub mtha' smra kun kyang*// gang zag bdag med tshul der mthun// chos kyi bdag med gong nas gong*// zab cing rgya cher 'chad pa'o// btags par yod pa'i chos rnams kun// ngo bos stong par kun gyis 'chad// dper na ldog pa gzhan sel dang*// rgyun dang rags pa sogs lta bu// rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med dang*// shes pa skad cig cha med pa// rang gi ngo bos stong pa la// gzung ba chos kyi bdag med dang*// 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med zer// shes rnam bden pas stong pa yang*// 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med ces// byams chos rjes 'brang bcas te 'chad// chos dbyings ye shes rigs pa yis// dpyad pa'i ngo na ma grub kyang*// ye shes ngo na grub ces pa// sngags kyi tshul la grags pa yin// ngo bo nyid med smra lugs la// kun rdzob ma gtogs chos gzhan med// stong nyid don dam bden zhes pa// yang dag kun rdzob 'jog skabs so// de ltar rang lugs gzhag byas nas// phyis byon grags pa gsal ldan dag

/nang pa'i grub mtha' smra kun gyi// chos dang gang zag tshad grub byed// dgag bya'i ngos 'dzin khyad par gyis// bdag med pa la rtsing zhib byung*// nyan thos pa dag phung po dang*// sems tsam smra bas kun gzhi dang*// rang rgyud yid kyi rnam shes dang*// thal 'gyur ba'i nga tsam la// bdag dang gang zag skyes bur 'dod// dgag bya'i khyad par go rim bzhin// rtag pa gcig bu rang dbang can// rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod dang*// rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pas// stong la gang zag bdag med zer// btags par yod pa'i chos gcig la// bden grub rigs pas khegs gyur na// de yi rigs pa kha spos pas// chos kun bden med nges zhes 'chad// bdag dang gang zag tshad grub pa// chos kyi phyag rgya bzhi dang 'gal// bdag dang gang zag yod med la// phyi dang nang pa rtsod byed kyi// gzhi gcig yod par mthun grub nas// bden par yod med la ma brtsad// gang zag bdag med 'chad pa yi// gzhung lugs kun na gang zag nyid// 'gog par mdzad kyi yod ma bshad// gcig dang du bral rigs pa dang*// rtags don bdun gyis btsal ba na// gang ma rnyed par gsungs pa de// bdag dang gang zag la 'chad kyi// yod par gsungs pa 'ga' yang med// gang zag yod pa ma yin phyir// las 'bras rten gyur ci zhe na// las 'bras btags pa'i yod nyid dang*// kun rdzob nyid du khas blangs nas// las byed pa dang myong ba po// tha snyad bden pa'i dbang du byas// gang zag rang mtshan gyis ma grub// sus kyang shes sla thal 'gyur ba'i// khyad chos min te btags yod ni// rdzas su med par kun gyis shes// zhes bdag dang bdag med kyi ngos 'dzin la log par smra ba sel ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// // ༄// ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// de nas tshad ma'i spyi skad 'ga'// log par smra la mang dag tu// mngon par zhen pa de spang bya// tshad ma'i mtshan nyid mi slu bar// bshad kyang bod bsdus mdzad po yis// bden pa'i don rtogs zhes su 'chad// de don gcig ces deng dus 'khrul// gzhung 'grel rnams las der ma bshad// bcad dang rtogs pa don gcig ces// 'dod pa de yang gzhung na med// sel ba gsum gyis ngos 'dzin dang*// rang mtshan sel bar 'chad pa 'khrul// 'gal 'brel 'chad la gzhung bshad kyi// dri ma tsam yang 'dir mi snang*// rtog pa'i chos kun gzhan sel du// 'chad pa'i rnam bzhag ma shes pas// rang mtshan mthar thug dgag sgrub kyi// dngos rten nyid du 'dod pas nongs// bsdus pas mdo sems bkag rjes su// rang lugs rnam med rjen cher ba// mdo sems lugs zhes gsal por smra// mtho yor mir zhen pa dang mtshungs// don snang rtog med shes pa la// gang snang phyi rol don dang ni// bum sogs 'dzin pa'i rtog pa la// der snang don spyi yin par 'dod// 'di 'dra gzhung las ma bshad kyang*// de la 'dra len byas nas su// don snang shes pas don dngos su// rtogs par khas len byed pa dang*// sngor snang shes la der snang ba// sngon po'i mtshan gzhir khas len phyir// 'di 'dra grags pa'i gzhung na med// sngon po sngor snang dbang shes kyi// dmigs rkyen yin par sems tsam pas// 'dod ces zer ba gzhung dang 'gal// shes pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i// gzugs sgra sogs kyi bshad pa ni// sngon byon kun gyi lung na med// dmigs rkyen rnam bzhag phyi rol gyi// don sgrub byed pa'i rigs pa dngos// lhan cig dmigs nges ngan 'gog gi

/rigs pa dngos yin zer ba rdzun// tshad 'bras rnam bzhag phal che ba// gzhung 'grel kun dang mi mthun pa// rang sor sbyar ba'i tshig mang pos// 'khrul par bshad pa kho na yin// tshul gsum rtags kyi rnam bzhag dang*// bsgrub bya dang ni sgrub pa'i ngag /dam bca' ba dang thal 'gyur sogs// gang gis 'gog dang gang la 'god// de der song ba'i dus dang ni// so so'i mtshan nyid gzhung bzhin du// 'chad pa po dang 'chad shes pa// 'dir 'byung lugs las gzhan na med// ces tshad ma'i spyi skad la log par rtog pa sel ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// // ༄// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// deng sang thub pa'i gsung rab kyi// rkang pa rnam gsum nyams gyur nas// gcig tsam lus pa rtsod ldan dus// de yang thal phyir zhes grags pa'i// rtsod tsam lhur len mchog du byed// gang des chos kyi grags pa'i lugs// dri mar bcas pa 'dir bsam bya// dam bca' 'jog dang de sun 'byin// lan 'debs pa dang de lan dang*// rtags bsal 'khor gsum ngos 'dzin dang*// rgyal dang pham pa'i tshad ma sogs// log par bshad pa kho na yis// legs par bshad pa'i mig nyams pa// mtshan mo rgyu ba'i blo can dag /skad gzengs mthon por smra ba yod// thog mar dam bca' 'jog pa'i tshe// yin na de min bud ces pa// 'di 'dra sun 'byin brjod pa'i tshig /yin gyi dam bca' 'jog lugs min// sun 'byin brjod tshe dam bca' ba// gang yin rtags su mi 'god par// dngos kyi ma nges tsam 'phen pa// 'di 'dra phyir rgol tshar bcas gnas// yin te 'khor gsum tshang ba yis// sun 'byin 'phen rgyu yod bzhin du// rtags la khas len med pa dang*// khyab pa tshad mas ma nges pa'i// sun 'byin brjod pa yin phyir ro// lan 'debs tshe na khyab pa med// byas pa'i tshe na 'bud pa tsam// lhur byed pa ni tshar bcad gnas// yin te khyab pa sgrub pa yi// rigs pa ston rgyu yin pa la// kyer 'bud tsam zhig byas pa na// dngos skyon 'phen rgyu med pa ni// rtags chos tha mi dad pa dang*// thun mong min pa'i ma nges dang*// lhag ldan 'ga' la'ang yod phyir ro// rtags ma grub kyi lan btab pas// de min par ni khas blangs zhes// rgol ba gnyis ka mthun pa ni// gzhung las bshad pa'i log phyogs te// rtags dang chos can gnyis po yi// ngo bo so sor med pa dang*// shes 'dod med dang gzhi rtags kyi// 'brel la the tshom za la'ang*// rtags ma grub kyi lan thebs phyir// gtan tshigs tshad grub byed pa'i tshe// de de yin par thal zhes pa// tshar bcad pa yi gnas yin te// thal 'gyur 'phen pa sun 'byin gyi// tshul yin sgrub pa'i tshul ma yin// dngos ma nges kyi sun 'byin la// 'dod lan btab tshe de min par// thal zhes zer la de bzhin te// 'dod lan rtags su bkod byas nas// sun 'byin brjod dgos yin phyir ro// khyab pa yod med dngos kyi skyon// 'phen rgyu yod med la byed dang*// rtags grub ma grub sgrub nus dang*// sgrub mi nus la byed zer dang*// bsal ba'i go ba ma shar bas// thal chos nyid la 'chad pa dang*// chos can la ni rtsod gzhi dang*// shes 'dod chos can gnyis las med// gang yang min par shes bya rtsam// zer dang khyod ces bya la sogs// zer rgyus phongs pa'i ngal ba yis// gzhung lugs 'grib pa ma tshor ram// rtags bsal khyab pa rnam gsum po// 'khor gsum yin zhes zer ba dang*// gsum po gang la lan btab kyang*// dngos 'gal song ba rgyal ba'i tshad// yin zhes zer la kha 'cham mod// 'di 'dra rigs pa'i gzhung na med// chos can steng du rtags khas blangs// khyab pa tshad grub thal chos la// khas blangs pa dang tshad ma yis// bsal ba ston rgyu byung ba'i tshe// 'khor gsum tshang ba'i brda 'chad mdzad// de las log rtogs ldog pa'am// bsgrub bya nges pa'i tshad ma skyes// de la rgyal pham tshad du 'jog

/la las bum pa rtag pa dang*// mi rtag gnyis kar khas blangs dang*// gnyis min par yang khas blangs pa// de la dngos 'gal bud tsam gyis// rgyal dang pham par mi 'gyur te// rtsa ba'i dam bca' ma nyams shing*// spobs pa bcom par ma byas te// phyogs gcig sgrub par ma byas shing*// gcig shos nyams par ma byas phyir// gzhan yang sgrub dang sun 'byin pa// rgol ba gang gi byed las yin// rgol ba gang la nam gyi tshe// bkod pas rtags dang sgrub ngag dang*// bsgrub byar song ba'i dus gang zhes// dris na deng sang rtog ge ba// kun la 'chad rgyu yod min kyang*// thal phyir skad gzengs mtho ba dang*// rkang lag sdabs pa'i sgra skad kyis// ston pa bzang bar khas len pa// dus dang blo gros gron du song*// der song tsam gyis sdig po che// skyed par byed pa ma yin kyang*// gsung rab kun la blta ba'i mig /phyogs glang grags pa'i lugs bzang po// nyams par byas pas sdig pa lci// bstan la ma zhugs skye bos ni// bstan pa 'jig par nus ma yin// gzhung lugs 'dzin par khas blangs nas// de nyams byed pa'i lung rigs la// nan ltar lhur byed klog pa pa// rnams kyis slar yang bag yod byos// zhes chos la 'khrul pa sel ba'i gtam zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa las/ sgrub pa dang sun 'byin gyi tshul la byis pas log par rtog pa sel ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// // ༄// thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal nas// 'dul bar gtogs pa'i mdzad pa ni// brda tsam gyis kyang phan thogs mod// sel nus 'khrul pa bsal bar bya// gzhi gsum zhes pa 'dul ba yi// bslab pa'i gnas rnams kun gyi gzhi// dbyar gnas pa las dgag dbye sogs// yon tan rgya che gting zab 'byung*// khyad par dgag dbye'i mdzad pa las// gso sbyong byas pa'i go chod pa// gcig pur ma zad phyir bcos kyi// skabs nas 'byung ba'i nyes pa kun// sel zhing yon tan ji snyed 'byung*// dgag dbye spro bzhin ma grub na// dge 'dun dben gyi nyes pa dang*// ltung phyir sogs kyi rtsod 'phel zhing*// spro bzhin bshags pa'i phyir bcos dang*// nan tur 'chags par mi 'gyur zhing*// de chags pa las 'byung ba yi// yon tan rnams kyang 'byung mi 'gyur// rgyu med 'bras bu mi 'byung phyir// dbyar med dgag dbye ga la 'byung*// phyi dus gangs can ljongs 'di na// char chu che ba'i dus yol nas// dbyar gnas khas blangs byas pa'i tshe// dgag dbye dgun gyis dkyil du 'byung*// dbyar zla 'bring po'i tha snyad la// lung khungs 'chol ba yod srid kyang*// ras chen tshol dang 'jog dus dang*// lha babs dus dang 'khru dus sogs// dus kyi khyad par ma mthun zhing*// mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dbyig gnyen gyis// dbyar nyi ldog dus gsungs dang 'gal// rang gi tshul khrims mchog 'dzin zhing*// gzhan la khyad bsod byed pa dag

/rtag tu nyin zhag bzhi bcu lngar// dbyar gyi khas len nges pa can// phyi ma'i dbyar gyis tha snyad ni// nam yang yod ma yin pa byed// nyin zhag bzhi bcu zhe lnga yi// dbyar gnas sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs// de 'dra'i khas len 'chags mi 'gyur// de ma chags na de yi ni// phan yon rnam bcu ga la srid// nya dang stong gi gso sbyong la// dus kyi dpyad pa zhib mor gsungs// rgyu skar mkhan gyi tshes las kyang*// nyin zhag gcig gi snga ba ni// dus rnams rtag tu byas pa'i phyir// nya shi'i gso sbyong 'chags mi 'gyur// gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa zhes pa// gnam stong tshe na mi chags pa// nyi shu dgu la byed ces zer// 'di 'dra thos kyang rna ba 'gebs// zhag bdun dbyar gyi byin brlabs dang*// bzhi bcu'i gnang ba ster ba dang*// byin gyis brlab pa'i khyad par la// bag med gyur pa de spongs shig /ces 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi cho ga la log par smra ba sel ba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// // ༄// rtsod pa'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas kyi// chos la zhugs pa shin tu dkon// zhugs pa bas kyang mkhas pa dang*// mkhas pa rnams dpyod ldan pa dang*// dpyod ldan rigs pa shes pa dang*// rigs pa lung gi rjes 'gro bar// sbyangs pa de dag shin tu dkon// lung rigs smra ba bstan pa'i mtshor// rnyog pa char bzhin bab pa la// bzod na bstan la gus ma 'gyur// des na sangs rgyas bstan pa la// gus dang ston la dad gyur na// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa yi// dri ma rigs pa'i chu yis khrus// yid ches lung gis byi dor byos// de ltar bstan dang ston pa la// phan btags lan du ldon byed pa// de la 'jig rten skyong pa bzhis// dus rnams kun tu bsrung zhing skyob// ces chos la 'khrul pa sel ba'i gtam zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa 'di ni/ sems dpa' brag dkar ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bgyis nas/

dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// sngags la 'jug pa'i mun pa sel bar byed pa'i chos kyi sgron me gzhung tshan bcu bdun pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag bgyis nas// sngags kyi dbu ma zhes bya ba// logs na yod pa min no zhes// log par bsam pa de bsal bya// sngags kyi dbu ma zhes bya ba// logs su bshad par nus min na// sngags kyi theg pa zhes bya ba// logs su bshad nus min par mtshungs// ci phyir zhe na theg pa yi// gong 'og khyad par lta ba dang*// thabs mkhas zab dang rgya che dang*// de las gzhan pa nyid kyis 'byed// lta ba'i 'chad tshul rnam gnyis te// thos bsam rigs pas sgro 'dogs pa// bcad pa las byung shes rab dang*// goms pa las byung ye shes so// sgro 'dogs gcod tshul rnam gnyis te// phar phyin theg pa'i rigs pa dang*// sngags kyi thabs mkhas khyad par las// byung ba'i rang byung ye shes so// snga ma de la'ang rnam gnyis te// klu sgrub zhabs kyi rigs tshogs las// gsungs dang byams chos rjes 'brang dang*// bcas pa dag las byung ba'o// snga ma shes rab pha rol phyin// ji bzhin sgra yis bshad pa dang*// phyi ma ji bzhin min pa'i sgras// pha rol phyin gzhung bshad pa'o// lugs dang por ni thos bsam gyi// rigs pas sgro 'dogs gang bcad pa// de nyid nyams su myong bya ste// ngo bo nyid med smra rnams bzhed// lugs phyi mar ni thos bsam dang*// nyams su myong bya mi mtshungs te// yul can shes rab rtog pa dang*// rtog med nyid kyis 'byed phyir ro// ngo bo nyid med smra ba ni// rigs pas dpyad tshe thos bsam dang*// goms bya'i yul du ma dmigs pa// tsam la mi mthun med par bzhed// phar phyin theg pas 'tshang rgya ba// nyid la lta ba 'di tsam gyis// chog par ngo bo nyid med du// smra ba'i gzhung rnams phal cher mthun// byams pa'i chos las gzung 'dzin gyi// chos rnams stong par rtogs rjes su// gnyis med ye shes de kho na// rtogs byar bzhed pas sngags dang mthun// de la kha cig 'di snyam du// lugs 'dir chos kun bden med du// rigs pas gtan la ma phab phyir// sngags dang mthun pa med ces zer// sngags gzhung thun mong min dag na// lta bas nyams su myong bya ba// byams pa'i gzhung dang mi mthun par// bshad pa 'ga' yang yod ma yin// gzung 'dzin kun btags rang stong du// gtan la phebs pa de nyid kyis// rnam rtog ma lus khegs pa'i phyir// rigs pa gzhan bsam dgos min no// de phyir pha rol phyin pa yi// gzhung lugs kun nas don dam pa// dpyod phyir rigs pa las gzhan du// lta ba rtogs pa'i thabs mi 'chad// rigs pa de la rang gzhan gyis// stong tshul rnam pa gnyis bshad mod// gnyis ka yang ni dbu ma yi// gzhung du lung bstan mdzad par mtshungs// de ltar de bshad pa las ni// byung ba'i dge bas rang byung gi

/shes dang shes bya'i gnas kun la// rab mkhas mkhas pa'i gnas thob shog/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ de ltar phar phyin theg pa yi// dbu ma'i tshul gnyis shes gyur nas// de nas sngags kyi theg pa yi// dbu ma'i tshul lugs 'dir bshad bya// de la rnam bzhag dngos dang ni// rtsod pa spang tshul gnyis kyis 'chad// dngos la lta ba gang yin dang*// de rtogs pa yi thabs mkhas so// lta ba bde stong zung 'jug gi /ye shes nyid ces 'chad mod kyang*// de yi ngos 'dzin 'chad pa na// gzhan dag gzhan du 'chad 'di ltar// bde ba bden pas stong zhes dang*// yul can bde ba chen po dang*// yul gyi stong nyid sbyor zhes dang*// sbyor tshul gzung 'dzin rgyang chad du// snang ba med phyir chu la ni// chu bzhag bzhin du sbyor zhes zer// 'di 'dra phyis 'byung gtam yin phyir// rgan po'i lugs 'dzin rnams kyis spangs// yul can rang byung ye shes kyis// yul yang de nyid rtogs pa la// gnyis med dang ni zung 'jug dang*// rang rig pa yi dag pa zhes// 'chad kyi myong bya'i stong pa nyid// med dgag nyid la bshad pa med// lta ba de la'ang rjes mthun dang*// mtshan nyid tshang ba gnyis bshad nas// de la lta dang grub mtha' dang*// mtshon byed dpe dang mtshon don zhes// 'chad do de yang thos bsam dang*// bsgom byung rtog pa'i blo dag ni// lta bar sngags nas gsungs pa med// des na rjes mthun lta ba yang*// rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i rig par// 'chad mod ji srid mthong ba'i lam// mngon du ma byas de srid du// grub pa'i mtha' dang mtshon don gyi// ye shes nyid du bshad pa med// lta ba'i ngos 'dzin 'di lta bu// byams chos phyi ma'i gzhung dag na'ang*// yod phyir sngags kyi dbu ma zhes// logs su 'chad pa mi 'thad do// snyam du dogs na rgyas bshad pa// sngags kyi dbu ma'i lta ba ni// bde dang stong pa zung 'jug gi

/ye shes nyid la bshad pa'i phyir// pha rol phyin par 'di mi 'chad// zung 'jug de la gzhi lam dang*// 'bras bu'i dbye bas gsum bshad pa// de las gzhi yi zung 'jug gi /tha snyad med kyang don tsam zhig /pha rol phyin la'ang yod do zhes// 'chad na'ang 'gal ba yod min te// sngags su lhan skyes ye shes la// bde bar bshad dang don mthun phyir// de bzhin de la sangs rgyas kyi// ye shes zhes kyang kun nas bshad// stong pa'i ngos 'dzin ye shes la// 'chad pa ngo bo nyid med du// smra ba'i lugs la yod ma yin// de phyir rnam rdzun dbu ma nas// sngags kyi dbu mar 'jug pa bde// de lta bas na rnal 'byor gyi// dbang phyug rnam rdzun lta ba nas// rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mas// sngags kyi dbu mar 'jug pa mdzad// lam 'bras bde stong zung 'jug gi /rgyu dang rang bzhin byed las gsum// phar phyin theg par 'byung mi srid// rgyu ni sngags kyi thabs zab mo// rang bzhin bde ba chen po dang*// byed las 'pho ba'i chags spong ba// dbu ma gzhan las 'di ma bshad// lam gyi bde stong zung 'jug la// dpe don dbye ba gnyis 'chad pa// de tshe dpe yi ye shes ni// gang phyir 'byung ba che bde ba// zhes sogs skabs nas bstan pa yi// tshor ba bde ba nyid yin phyir// sngags kyi lta ba dngos min kyang*// 'di med don gyi ye shes la// 'jug pa shin tu dka' bas na// sngags kyi thun mong min pa yi// thabs kyi thog mar 'di bsgrub bya// lam gyi bde stong zung 'jug dngos// 'gyur med bde chen rnyed pa nas// yin phyir sa thob dgos mod kyang*// zhib tu phye na sa thob la// las rlung stong dang brgyad brgya pa// phrag gcig 'gag dgos yin pa'i phyir// 'gyur med bde chen stong dang ni// brgyad brgya phrag gcig brnyes pa dgos// de phyir 'gyur med bde ba che// brgya phrag gcig tsam thob pa nas// tshes kyi zla ba ji bzhin du// don gyi ye shes rim gyi 'phel// gnas skabs de ni bsgom byung gi

/ye shes med na mi 'byung phyir// sbyor ba'i lam du shes par bya// gnyis pa sngags kyi dbu ma de// rtogs pa'i thabs zab gang zhe na// bla med theg pa'i dbang byas tshe// dbang bzhi po dang de sngon du// song ba'i lus kyi byed bcings dang*// lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*// rang byin brlabs pa'i rim pa dang*// gzhan rkyen las dang ye shes dang*// phyag rgya chen mo'i rim pa yis// bsgrub bya dbang po'i rim pa yis// myur bul rim bzhin rtogs bya ba// yin mod dbang la ma ltos par// lta ba 'di yod ma yin no// thabs lam de dag so so yi// byed pas dpe yi ye shes ni// thog mar skyes pa de dag kyang*// shes te mi nyams 'phel bya'i phyir// rjes thob dus su phar phyin gyi// dbu ma'i rigs pas brtag dpyad nas// nyams su len pa'i thabs dag ni// lam 'bras chos su gsal bar gsungs// de tshe rtog dpyod mkhan po ni// rtog pa yul dang bcas nyid phyir// lta ba'i ye shes dngos min kyang*// gzung 'dzin rtog pa 'gog byed pa'i// thabs su rigs par gsungs pa yin// rigs pa de las brjod bral gyi// ye shes mngon du gyur pa na// bdag tu lta ba la sogs pa'i// gzung 'dzin zhen pa kun khegs phyir// don gyi ye shes skye ba la// gegs byed yod pa ma yin no// de sbyar ba las gang skyes pa'i// rnam dkar bcu drug cha shas can// mar ngor gyur pa med dus der// rdzogs sangs rgyas blo'i yar ngor byon// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal nas// sngags kyi dbu ma logs shig tu// bshad la rtsod pa spang pa ni// legs par shes nas brtag par bya// de la rnam gnyis rgol ba dang*// lan gyi rim pa de bshad pa// rgol ba snga phyi ji snyed pa// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// lta ba gcig par mi 'chad na// don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// zhes sogs kun gyi 'dod pa 'gal// pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las// lhag pa'i lta ba yod na ni// lta de spros bcas nyid 'gyur zhes// rang gi gzhung du 'don dang 'gal// ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba// des mdzad rgya gzhung tshad ldan du// a ti sha yis mdzad de na// sngags la rab tu mi gnas las// lhag pa'i lta ba yod na ni// lta de spros bcas slob dpon rmongs// zhes sogs bshad dang 'gal zhes zer// lan la thun mong gnod byed dang*// thun mong min pa'i sgrub byed dang*// so so'i gzhung don de bshad pa'o// 'o na rtogs byed shes rab dang*// rtogs bya'i yul yang gcig go zhes// 'chad na de dag so so yi// ngos 'dzin gang dang gang yin 'dri// yul can spros bral rtogs blo dang*// yul ni spros bral la 'chad na// yul dang yul can mtshan nyid pa// yin nam btags pa bar chad byed// pha rol phyin na de lta bu'i// yul dang yul can mtshan nyid par// bshad pa cha shas tsam yang med// sngags su lta dang lta yul ni// rang gis rang rig dngos su 'chad// lung der ma zad rigs pa yang*// med par dgag pa'i yul can ni// rtog pa nyid las ma 'das phyir// sngags su lta ci phar phyin du'ang*// rnam par byang ba'i rtog pa ni// spang bya nyid du byams pas bshad// lhag mthong ngos 'dzin sor rtog gi

/shes rab nyid la bshad do zhes// phyis byon gtam las byung mod kyang*// thos bsam shes rab lhag mthong gi /ngos 'dzin dngos su bshad mi rung*// thun mong min pa'i sgrub byed ni// thal rang gzhung du lta ba'i tshe// rang rig ye shes lan brgyar bkag /sngags su lta tshe de bkag na// lam gyi gzhung shing kun nyams so// ci phyir zhe na chos dbyings kyi// ye shes ma gtogs gsang sngags su// nyams su blang bya'i chos gzhan ni// ci yang gsungs pa med phyir ro// gsum pa so so'i don bshad pa// tshul gsum sgron ma'i lung don ni// 'khor lo gsum par gang bshad pa'i// phar phyin lta ba'i yul la dgongs// kha cig der bshad lta ba yang*// med par dgag pa kho na zhes// zer dang sems tsam gzhung yin zhes// 'chad pa dngos su 'gal ba ste// med par dgag la don dam du// 'chad pa dngos smra'i gzhung na med// thal rang gzhung gi stong pa nyid// mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /sus kyang rtogs pa med do zhes// a ti sha'i gzhung las 'byung*// sngags kyi lta ba'i yul gang de'ang*// de ltar bshad na rgyud sde dang*// rgya gzhung kun dang mi 'gal lam// sa lo'i bshad pa rjes thob tu// spros pa 'gog pa'i rigs pa la// tshul gnyis khyad par med do zhes// 'chad pa gzhung de nyid na gsal// ci phyir zhe na gzhung der ni// des na bshad pas go ba yi// thos pa'i lta ba gcig nyid yin// zhes sogs gsungs kyi nyams myong gi /lta la khyad par med bshad na// gong ma'i gzhung lugs kun dang 'gal// lam 'bras chos su rigs pa yis// dpyad pa'i stong nyid bsgom byung gi /nyams su myong byar byas gyur na// dug can lta ba yin par gsungs// spros pa 'gog pa'i rigs pa la// shing rta'i srol chen gnyis byung ba// byams pa'i chos nas gzung 'dzin gyi// spros pa bkag nas gnyis med kyi// ye shes myong byar 'chad pa dang*// thal rang gzhung du chos thams cad// rang nyid rang gis stong bshad nas// bsgom dus myong bya gzhan mi 'chad// de phyir spros bral ngos 'dzin yang*// chos dbyings ye shes la 'chad dang*// med dgag nam mkha' lta bu la// 'chad pa'i srol chen gnyis byung ngo*// rje btsun sa skya pa rnams ni// phar phyin theg pa'i bshad pa na// don dam bden pa blo yi ni// yul las 'das zhes lan brgyar 'chad// rdo rje theg pa'i bshad pa na// don dam bden pa rang rig pa'i// ye shes nyid kyi myong byar 'chad// gzhan gtam dbyangs su blang mi bya// ye shes rdo rje'i bshad pa yang*// spros pa 'gog pa'i rigs pa ni// dbu ma las lhag gsang sngags na// med ces 'chad pa kho na ste// dbu ma'i tshul gnyis ma gtogs pa'i// spros 'gog rigs pa gzhan med kyang*// thabs mkhas khyad par gzhan zhig gis// lta ba rtogs zhes gzhung der bshad// mnga' bdag rgyal sras mai tri pas// thal rang gzhung gi dbu ma la// bla ma'i ngag gis ma brgyan pa'i// dbu ma 'bring po yin zhes gsungs// de yi shugs la des brgyan pa'i// lta ba dbu ma chen por grub// de skad 'di ni phyi rabs pa'i// gsang sngags pa kun lta ba'i tshe// gzhan zer kho na dbyangs su ni// len pa spang phyir grub pa'o//

//shu bhaṃ// // oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag byas nas// pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags la// lta bas rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshe// 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag byung*// dang po rnal 'byor spyod mdo de// bar pa ngo bo nyid med gzhung*// phyi ma theg pa kun gyi mchog /yin zhes dgyes pa rdo rjer gsungs// lta bas rim 'jug mi dgos pa'i// tshul la'ang rnam pa gsum mthong ste// rnal 'byor spyod nas gsang sngags la// 'jug dang ngo bo nyid med nas// der 'jug pa dang thog ma nas// sngags kyi lta ba la 'jug pa'o// tshul dang po de birwa pa'i// gzhung bzhin rim gyis 'jug pa dang*// gnyis pa zla grags la sogs pa'i// gzhung bzhin rim gyis 'jug pa dang*// int+ra bhu ti sogs gzhung bzhin// cig char nyid 'jug gsum pa'o// gsum pa 'di yi dbang byas tshe// dbang bskur sngon du ma song bar// lta ba rtogs thabs gzhan mi 'chad// longs spyod brlabs dang byed bcings dang*// 'khrul 'khor bla ma'i byin brlabs sogs// de rtogs pa'i thabs yin mod// dbang bskur sngon du ma song ba'i// de 'dra de las khams 'dus dang*// rnam rtog rags pa tsam khegs pa// srid mod sngags kyi lta ba ni// rnam dag rtogs pa'i thabs ma yin// de la kha cig 'di snyam du// 'jug tshul dang po de 'thad na// de rjes dbu ma bstan par bya// zhes gsungs pa de ma'i thad do// snyam na 'di lan mgo mtshungs dang*// rnal ma gnyis kyis bshad par bya// mgo mtshungs ngo bo nyid med du// smra ba'i gzhung la ma zhugs par// sngags la rim 'jug mi rung na// skal ldan cig char pa yis kyang*// gzhung de thog mar tshol dgos sam// yang na rnal 'byor spyod pa pa// skal par ldan pa mi srid 'gyur// ye shes bden grub khas blangs nas// gsang sngags lta ba khas len pa// 'gal zhes zer na lta ba la// khas len med pa mnyam bzhag dang*// khas len rjes thob shan 'byed tshe// yin pa'i khyad par mi phyed par// smra ba mang po de ngo mtshar// ye shes don dam bden gyur kyang*// de la rigs pas dpyad pa'i tshe// rigs ngor dpyad pa ma bzod pa// nyid kyis de la mtshan 'dzin 'dor// rtog dang bral ba'i bsgom byung gi

/nyams su myong byar dmigs pa'i phyir// ye shes dam pa'i don yin zhes// gsang sngags pa dag de ltar 'don// de phyir rnal 'byor spyod pa dang*// ngo bo nyid med smra nas kyang*// sngags la 'jug pa shin tu bde// dang pos nyams su myong bya dang*// gnyis pas mtshan 'dzin 'gog pa'i tshul// rgyas par bshad pa yin phyir ro// zhes bya ba 'di dgyes rdor dang*// dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs par grub// de yi dge bas rdzogs sangs rgyas// de dang de nyid grub par shog/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal nas// 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya ba// 'di la so so'i mtshan nyid dang*// dbyer med go don bsam par bya// 'khor ba rgyu dang ngo bo dang*// nges byed tshad ma brtag bya dang*// mya ngan 'das la'ang de bzhin du// gsum tshan gnyis kyis bshad par bya// dang po rgyu dang bdag po dang*// de ma thag pa'i rkyen gsum ste// dmigs rkyen 'dir mi 'chad pa yi// rgyu mtshan sgo nas shes par bya// 'khor ba'i rgyu rkyen don dam par// kun gzhi'i ye shes nyid yin te// chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs par// thog ma'i rgyu gzhan yod min phyir// kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa ni// kun rdzob pa'i rgyu rkyen te// de yang bag chags 'jog byed dang*// des bzhag pa yi bag chags dang*// de dag rnam par smin pa ste// gsum ka'ang 'khor ba'i bdag rkyen no// bag chags rnam par smin pa yi// rnam shes snga ma de dang de// de ma thag pa'i rkyen du bzhag /der ma 'dus pa'i dmigs rkyen ni// theg pa chen por mi 'chad de// 'dzin pa'i rnam shes las gzhan pa'i// 'dzin cha yod pa min phyir ro// phyogs kyi glang pos bshad pa yang*// gsum por ma 'dus yod ma yin// ngo bo bdag dang phung sogs su// snang ba'i rnam rig gang yin pa// phye na gzhi lam 'bras bu yi// dbye bas dngos btags gsum du bshad// gzhi ni so so skye bo dang*// lam ni 'phags pa'i rjes thob dang*// gsum pa sangs rgyas ye shes la// khams gsum rnam pa can snang ba// gnyis po gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi

/bag chags ma spangs de srid pa// gsum pa bag chags kun spangs phyir// cir snang dag pa kho na'o// gzhi lam 'khor ba gzugs sogs dang*// mig sogs dbang po bshad de ni// gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags ni// rmi lam byung phyir ma dag pa// mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyu rkyen ni// kun gzhi'i ye shes las gzhan med// bdag rkyen zag med sa bon dang*// de ma thag rkyen shes snga ma// 'di la dmigs rkyen mi 'char ste// gzung dang 'dzin pas dben phyir ro// ngo bo gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi// shes pa rang rig rang gsal ba// phye na gzhi lam 'bras bu yi// dbye bas rnam gsum mtshan nyid pa// gzhi ni rang bzhin rnam dag gi /ye shes lam ni glo bur gyi// dri ma phyogs gcig gis dag pa// 'bras bu rdzogs sangs rgyas ye shes// nges byed tshad ma 'khor ba dang*// myang 'das gnyis la so sor dbye// 'khor ba nges byed kyi tshad ma// theg pa chen por mi 'chad de// lugs der 'khrul snang gzung 'dzin dag /kun nas khegs pa nyid phyir ro// spyir yang ma rig gis sprul pa// mtha' dag tshad mas mi 'grub ste// sprul byed ye shes kyis 'gog phyir// khyad par ye shes tshogs bsags pa// sngon du song ba'i lam rim la// 'khor ba tshad mas mi 'grub ste// 'grub na tshogs bsags pa de nyams// gzung 'dzin gnyis las ma gtogs pa'i// 'khor ba yod pa ma yin zhing*// gzung 'dzin gnyis po mi 'gog pa'i// ye shes tshogs sog sngags la med// ji srid nges don khas len pa// de srid mya ngan 'das pa yi// 'jal byed tshad ma khas blang bar// sngags kyi gzhung lugs kun mthun te// theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag kun// gnyis med ye shes rang gsal ba// de nyid myong bar mtshungs phyir ro// gnyis pa dbyer med theg pa che// thun mong ba dang de min pa// thun mong ba yang rtogs bya dang*// rtogs byed thabs kyi bshad bya ba// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// 'di nyid rang bzhin myang 'das phyir// 'di la 'khor 'das gnyis su med// gnyis med pa de dbyer med dang*// zung du 'jug pa'i don du shes// rtogs bya de rtogs byed pa yi// thabs ni thos dang bsam pa dang*// 'jig rten pa yi bsgom pa ste// de goms pa las de mngon 'gyur// gal te dbyer med mya ngan las// 'das pa gcig pur 'chad byed na// 'khor ba'i chos la bskur btab pas// dbyer med go bar dka' zhe na// 'khor ba yod par khas blangs tshe// de gnyis dbyer med shin tu 'gal// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'am// mya ngan 'das pa 'khor bar 'gyur// thabs kyi zin dang ma zin pa'i// dbye bas 'byed pa yin zer mod// 'khor pa thabs kyis ci zin yang*// mya ngan 'das par 'gyur ba dang*// mya ngan 'das pa thabs sngugs kyang*// 'khor bar 'gyur ba mi srid do// dung gi kha dog ser snang tshe// dkar ser gnyis su dbyer med te// dkar po las gzhan ser po ni// tshad mas dmigs pa min phyir bzhin// 'khor ba mi dmigs pa 'di ni// mya ngan 'das par khyod kyis bzhad// zhes pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis// thub la bstod par gsungs pa dang*// rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can dang*// rmongs med mya ngan 'das pa zhes// thub pa nyid kyis ma gsungs sam// ji srid rab rib ma bsal ba// de srid dung de ser por snang*// rab rib bsal bar gyur pa na// dkar po las gzhan snang ba med// de tshe dkar ser gnyis med dang*// dbyer med pa dang zung 'jug tu// bshad par bya yi gnyis sdebs pa// zung du 'jug pa'i don ma yin// rigs pas kyang ni 'di 'grub ste// 'khor ba rigs pas dpyad pa na// ma rnyed pa de med pa'i don// yin no ci phyir 'khor ba ni// rnam shes chos las ma 'das phyir// mya ngan 'das pa rigs pa yis// dpyad tshe rigs ngor ma rnyed mod// med par bzhag nus ma yin te// rnam shes yul las 'das phyir ro// de ltar phar phyin theg pa dang*// thun mong 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi// mtshan nyid dbye ba 'di bshad pas// sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog/

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ces// rnam par grags pa'i mtshan gzhi dang*// de rtogs pa'i thabs bshad bya// dang po dngos dang dbye ba dang*// dbyer med 'jog tshul gsum gyis bshad// dang po gsal stong zung 'jug ces// bshad pa de yin skabs 'dir ni// e waṃ dgyes pa rdo rje dang*// bde mchog bsam mi khyab la sogs// rnam grangs bcu bzhir bshad de yin// gsal dang stong pa re re ba'i// ngos 'dzin de yis de mi mtshon// zung 'jug rnam kun mchog ldan gyi// stong nyid kho na e waṃ mo// phye na gzhi lam rnam gsum gyi// dbye bas gsum du 'chad nus mod// 'dir ni dbang sogs las rtogs pa'i// lam dus zung 'jug nyid ngos 'dzin// de phyir lam skor thams cad kyi// thog mar lta ba nyid nas 'chad// gzhi yi dus kyi zung 'jug de// rtogs byed thabs mkhas dang bral na// 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang kun gyi rkyen// byed par 'gyur ba la dgongs nas// lhan skyes nyi shu rtsa bdun bshad// 'khor 'das gnyis po zung 'brel ba// 'khor 'das gnyis med mtshan gzhi zhes// rmongs pas brtags pa'i gtam mang po// ngo sor byed te spangs par bya// de phyir e waṃ 'di kho na// myang 'das dngos yin 'khor ba'i yang*// gnas tshul 'di las gzhan du med// snang tshul kun kyang de las byung*// dngos nga dngos po med pa nga*// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs de dang*// e waṃ 'khor ba zhes bya ste// e waṃ mya ngan 'das pa nyid// zhes gsungs pa de mkhas pa las// mnyan par bya bo gzhan las min// gnyis pa dbyer med don bsams pa// gsal dang stong dang zung 'jug dang*// 'khor dang 'das dang dbyer med pa'i// ngos 'dzin mkhas las nyan par bya// gsal ba gzhi dus snang phyogs dang*// lam dus bskyed rim sogs gsal ba// stong pa gzhi dus chos thams cad// rang rang ngo bos stong pa dang*// lam dus bskyed rim sogs snang ba// de yang de nyid kyis stong pa// zung 'jug gzhi dus chos thams cad// gdod nas yod ma myong ba'am// gnas lugs gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa// gang la bshad kyang mi 'gal mod// lam dus skyed rim sogs gsal ba// mtshan 'dzin rnam rtog gis stong pa// nyid la 'chad kyi rang stong du// bshad na rim gnyis spangs par 'gyur// lam dus su yang sbyang gzhi dang*// mthun par 'khor ba'i snang ba dang*// de yang rang gis stong pa dang*// gang snang rtog pas dben pa ste// gsum tshan gnyis po rim bzhin du// 'jug pa sel ba'i lam dang ni// chags pa gcad pa'i lam nyid dang*// byang chub chen po'i lam zhes bya// bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i skabs su yang*// stong gzugs phyag rgya che gsal ba// byang chub chen po'i lam dngos zhes// lam 'bras chos las gsungs pa yin// stong gzugs de la 'khor ba yi// gzugs su snang dang rnam byang gi

/gzugs su snang ba gnyis ka yang*// mya ngan 'das su dbye ba med// de nas de rtogs pa yi thabs// rgyas par bshad na dbang dang ni// de dang 'brel ba'i byin brlabs dang*// rjes gnang lus kyi byed bcings dang*// bla ma'i rnal 'byor longs spyod kyi// brlabs sogs thabs mkhas bgrang yas dang*// dbang yang bzhi po re re las// byung ba'i zung 'jug gong nas gong*// 'phel la lta grub brgyad sogs bshad// thog mar bla mas bstan pa yi// lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ces// gsungs pa bum dbang dang 'brel ba// yin no de la skye tshul gsum// skal ba bzang la bum dbang tsam// bskur bas grub mtha' bsnyogs pa dang*// 'bring la dpe yi ye shes dang*// dman la thos pa'i lta ba tsam// skye bo de dag gong nas gong*// 'phel ba'i rim pa 'dir brjod bya// dpe dang thos pa'i lta ba tsam// thob des bskyed rim goms byas pas// du sogs mtshan ma mthong ba na// zung 'jug byang chub chen po'i lam// mngon du gyur pa de nas ni// rim gyis grub mtha' slebs de nas// bum dbang sa drug mthar son pa// de tshe gsang dbang las byung ba'i// rang byin brlabs pa'i thabs mkhas kyis// bde stong zung 'jug mngon gyur pa'i// sa bzhi po la rim bslabs pa// de tshe gsum pa'i dbang las kyang*// bde stong lhan cig skyes thob pa'i// sa gnyis po la bslabs zin nas// nges par nyer rgyus mtshams sbyar ba'i// sa phyed po yis rdzogs sangs rgya// yang na rgyu yi dus nyid du// gsang ba'i dbang yang bskur ba las// thob pa'i rlung dang gtum mo yi// rnal 'byor bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*// zung du 'brel bar ma goms na// bum dbang rkyang pas sa drug po// mngon du byed pa dka' ba'i gnas// ci phyir zhe na las kyi rlung*// stong dang brgyad brgya tshan pa re// 'gags zhing 'gyur med bde ba yang*// de 'dra re re thob pa la// sa dang po sogs thob pa yi// tha snyad 'dir yang mdzad phyir ro// bum dbang tsam las zung 'jug gi

/lta ba rtogs pa'i gang zag kyang*// don dam dpyod byed rigs pa la// bslab sbyangs sngon du song ba dang*// ma song ba yi dbye bas gnyis// dang pos rtogs bya'i lta ba la// bdag tu rmongs pa mi srid kyang*// phyi mas rang gi rtogs don la// chos dang gang zag gi bdag tu// rmongs pa rnam par bzlog bya'i phyir// bum dbang bskur ba'i rjes thogs su// nyams su len pa'i thabs gsum bshad// gsum po rnal 'byor spyod pa yi// lung dang mthun pa kho na ste// snang ba sems dang sems sgyu ma// sgyu ma rang bzhin med pa la// slob tshul gsum gyi sgo nas ni// thog mar gzung dang de nas 'dzin// bkag nas gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi// ye shes brjod pa kun bral ba// zung 'jug nyid du bstan phyir ro// skabs 'dir mi shes pa rnams ni// snang ba sems sogs su sgrub pa// lta ba rtogs byed thabs yin zer// 'o na phar phyin theg pa dang*// lta ba'i rtogs tshul khyad par ci// dpe dang rigs pa de dag las// zung 'jug rtogs par 'chad na ni// zung 'jug rjes dpag tshad ma yi// gzhal byar khas blangs byas min nam// byed na man ngag dang bral ba'i// phyi rabs gzhan gyi 'dod pa ltar// tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs kyis// dpyad pa sngon du ma song bar// lta ba rtogs pa med zer ram// de 'dra sngags kyi lung na med// la la 'dir bshad rten 'brel gyi// rtags de rigs tshogs nas gsungs pa'i// rten 'brel nyid la dgongs zhes zer// der bshad ltos grub rten 'brel la// 'dir bshad rten nas skyes pa yi// rten 'brel nyid du gang bshad pa'i// khyad par de yang shes par bya// bum pa'i dbang bskur don 'chad tshe// snang ba sems su rtogs 'chad kyi// sems nyid rdzun par ma bshad pas// zung 'jug ji ltar rtogs she na// rigs pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i tshe// phung po lnga po mi dmigs par// bshad pas gzung 'dzin gnyis med dang*// rdo rje slob dpon dbang dus su// dam tshig gsum gyi de kho na// bla mas bshad dang slob ma yi// goms pa dus gcig nyid gyur pas// 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba// phal cher mngon du 'gyur zhes so// de ltar 'di ni phyi dus kyi// 'chad byed blo la 'char dka' zhing*// de nas nyan pos mi shes pa// mang phyir rgyas par bshad 'di las// dge ba rang sems 'od gsal dang*// dbyer med nyid du 'dres gyur pas// 'bras bu'i e waṃ nyid gyur cig/

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// 'khor 'das dbyer med bsdus don dang*// dgos pa'i don dang rtsod spangs rnams// rim pa bzhin du bshad bya ba// 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya ba// pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags kyi// bka' dang bstan bcos so so dang*// shing rta'i srol chen gnyis kyis bshad// don gyi ngos 'dzin de nyid la// bod la grags pa'i tha snyad ni// rdzogs pa che dang phyag rgya che// sdug bsngal zhi bar byed ces grags// klu sgrub zhabs kyi rigs tshogs su// chos kun ngo bo nyid med du// ro gcig pa la der brtags 'dis// sngags kyi dbyer med der ma sleb// byams pa'i gzhung du chos dbyings kyi// ye shes nyid las gzhan med la'o// ming 'dogs de kun thams cad la// rtogs byed thos bsam rigs pa dang*// sngags kyi thabs mkhas las rtogs tshe// thun mong thun mong min par bzhag /rtogs par byed po'i khyad par gyis// rtog pa sgra don 'dzin rig dang*// bde gsal mi rtog par skye ba'i// khyad par nyid kyis bzang ngan dang*// lta ba dug can yin min dang*// tshe gcig pa la sgrib pa yi// sa bon spong nus yin min dang*// mngon sum min dang yin par phye// dgos don phar phyin theg pa yi// lta ba ye shes tshogs sog dang*// sgrib pa'i sa bon spong kho nar// 'chad kyi bsod nams tshogs su min// sngags su bsod nams tshogs rnams kun// zung 'jug ye shes nyid las ni// gzhan du bshad nus min pa'i phyir// lta ba'i ngo bo nyid du 'dus// sngags kyi nyams len dngos gzhi yi// thog ma lta ba nyid nas 'dzin// de nas rtsod pa spang bshad pa// chos kyi dbyings sam zung 'jug las// ma gtogs chos gzhan yod min na// bsod nams tshogs dang thabs kyi cha// kun la bskur pa btab ce na// sngags su bsod nams tshogs sog pa// thams cad chos dbyings ngo bor ni// bskyed nas gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi

/ngang las dbye ba med par bsgrub// sngags kyi bsod nams tshogs sog kun// rlom tshod don dam bden pa ste// mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa gsum// stong nyid ye shes las bsgrubs bzhin// phar phyin theg pa'i bsod nams tshogs// ji snyed kun rdzob bden pa ste// lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas// bcos ma nyid dang thun mong ngo*// der yang 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i// shes rab nyid kyis zin ces pa// gnyis snang 'khrul pa rtog med la// gang snang thad sor bzhag byas nas// rtog pas mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa// de 'dra de la de skad du// brjod do mnyam bzhag rtog med dang*// rjes thob yang dag min rtog gi /ngang nas bsod nams tshogs sog pa// de la thabs shes zung 'brel zer// zung 'brel gnyis su yod pa ste// zung 'jug gnyis su med pa'o// kun rdzob yod pa ma yin na// bsod nams tshogs sog mi 'grub pas// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la// bskur pa btab par 'gyur zhe na// kun rdzob chos kun med pa dang*// kun rdzob nyid du yod pa yi// khyad par shan ma phyed pa las// smra ba ngan pa de dag byung*// sangs rgyas sa na ma rig pa// med phyir kun rdzob bden mi mnga'// gzugs sku kun rdzob bden zhes pa// gzhan snang kho nar lung las gsungs// des na kun rdzob du yod pa'i// bsod nams tshogs chen bsags pa las// kun rdzob nyid du sangs rgyas pa// kun rdzob pa can rnams la snang*// don dam sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// de la ye shes yod med du// 'byed pa rang stong gzhan stong gi /srol chen dag las byung mod kyang*// sngags su don dam chos kyi sku// rang stong nyid du bshad pa med// sngags su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// gtso bo longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// yan lag bdun dang ldan pa ste// 'di nyid don dam chos kyi skur// 'chad kyi kun rdzob bden par min// zhal phyag mtshan dpe la sogs pa// kun rdzob pa dang cha 'dra bar// gang snang de kun ye shes las// grub phyir kun rdzob bden pa min// longs sku 'og min kho na las// gzhan du g.yo ba med ces dang*// sa bcu pa las gzhan dag la// snang ba med ces 'chad pa ni// phar phyin theg pa kho na'i lugs// sngags su rnal 'byor pa rang nyid// gang du rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i sa// 'og min stug po bkod nyid dang*// gang snang sangs rgyas las gzhan med// sngags su bsod nams tshogs bsag gi

/bya byed las gsum ji snyed pa// ye shes nyid du ro gcig na// gzhan dang 'brel med 'gyur zhe na// theg pa chen po'i lung kun na// chos rnams thams cad snang tshul dang*// gnas tshul gnyis su so sor 'byed// kun kyang gnas tshul ye shes su// ro gcig pas na don dam pa'i// sems can nyid kyi don mdzad pas// bsod nams tshogs kyang rdzogs par bshad// de lta min na lam dus su// sa bon dang ni phyag mtshan las// 'od zer 'phros pas sems can kun// sangs rgyas sa la bkod byas nas// tshur 'dus pa las rnal 'byor pa// rang nyid sangs rgyas de dang der// rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes khas len pa// 'bras bu lam byed ma yin nam// 'o na rnal 'byor pa gcig pu// rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe sems can kun// rdzogs sangs rgyas par thal ce na// de'i lan du gang snang kun// rang sems tsam las ma 'das kyang*// rgol dang phyir rgol rgyud gcig par// thal ba'i lan du chos grwa yi// rgyud gzhan grub pa gsungs dang mtshungs// snang ba'i tshul la'ang ma rig pas// rnam par bslad la snang ba dang*// ting 'dzin ye shes phyogs gcig tsam// skyes la ji ltar snang ba dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la// ji ltar snang ba gang yin pa'o// ma dag snang ba ji snyed pa// de dang cha 'dra ji snyed cig /rnal 'byor pa la'ang der snang ba// kho nar ma zad ting 'dzin gyi// dbang las sna tshogs snang bar 'gyur// der snang rnam par shes pa dang*// ye shes 'dres la snang ba'i phyir// dag la ma dag pa'i snang ba// yin no rdzogs sangs rgyas blo la// snang tshul snga ma de dag dang*// cha 'dra de snyed de las gzhan// ye shes kho na'i dbang nyid kyis// grangs las 'das pa snang bar gsungs// snang ba de dag ji snyed pa// rang rang snang mkhan sems nyid las// gzhan du yod pa ma yin te// yod na gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan 'gyur// rdzogs sangs rgyas la gang snang ba// de kun rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur kyang*// sems can gzhan la gang snang ba// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa ma yin no// rdzogs sangs rgyas la mi snang ba'i// chos gzhan yod na khong kun mkhyen// min par thal zhes zer ba'i lan// ma dag snang ba'i gzung 'dzin gnyis// yod par lung las ma gsungs so// rdzogs sangs rgyas la dmyal ba pa'i// snang ba sangs rgyas ye shes su// 'chad pa ha cang thal zhe na// de ltar snang ba gzhan stong du// lung las gsungs pa 'dir byon to// 'o na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// sems can rang rgyud pa dang ni// 'brel pa med pa'i sems can la// chos gsungs pa dang phan btags pas// 'gro la ji ltar phan snyam na// don dam pa yi sems can nyid// gtso bo yin gyis kun rdzob pa'i// sems can sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs// de phyir gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud// thams cad rang bzhin rnam dag gi

/ye shes nyid la bshad bya ba// legs par bslabs nas shes par bya// de ltar gang bshad 'di nyid ni// pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags pa'i// lam la rnal 'byor byed kun gyi// nyams su len dang bshad bya'i chos// yin no 'dir bshad dge ba yang*// bstan pa'i snying po thos pa dang*// bsam dang goms par byed pa la// gegs byed med pa mthar phyin shog/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swa sti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// shes rab pha rol phyin pa dang*// klu sgrub zhabs kyi gzhung lugs la// dgongs 'grel shing rta'i srol gnyis byung*// 'jigs med dpal ldan chos skyong dang*// thal rang gzhung gi mdzad po ste// kun kyang sngags la 'jug pa yi// thos bsam lta ba rnam dag dang*// sngags las gsungs pa'i thabs mkhas kyis// de yi lta ba rtogs rjes su// gol sa gcod pa'i rigs pa la'ang*// srol gsum po la bzang ngan med// gsum las thal rang chos thams cad// rang stong nyid du gtan la 'bebs// srol 'byed dang pos klu sgrub kyi// lta ba'i mthar thug zung 'jug dang*// der zhugs nas ni gsang sngags kyi// lta ba'i mthar thug kyang der bzhed// rje btsun sa skya pa rnams ni// thal rang gzhung gi stong pa nyid// thos bsam bsgom pas gang rtogs pa// chags pa gcod pa'i lam du bzhed// lam de'i lta ba mthar thug dus// dug can yin pa'i shes byed kyang*// lam gyi dngos gzhi'i dus su ni// med dgag nam mkha' lta bu nyid// yul du byed pa'i yul can blo// rtog pa nyid las ma 'das shing*// phung po rnam bcad stong nyid de// lta dang sngags dang stobs sogs kyi// yon tan bsgrub pa'i gzhir mi rung*// de yi gzhir ni rnam kun gyi// mchog ldan stong nyid dgos phyir ro// lam 'bras chos su gsungs pa yi// byang chub chen po'i lam zhes pa// chags gcod lta ba sngon song ba'i// zung 'jug de la bshad pa yin// zung 'jug de yang lam dus su// snang stong dang ni gsal stong dang*// bde stong gsum du 'byed mod kyi// lta ba'i dngos gzhi gsum pa nyid// gsum po shes bya thams cad la// khyad med bzhugs pa la dgongs nas// don gcig zhes dang rtogs byed kyi// thabs kyi dbye bas bzang ngan bshad// klu sgrub zhabs kyi rigs tshogs su// dngos bstan zung 'jug ma bshad kyang*// bstod pa'i tshogs dang sngags gzhung du// gsungs zhes mkhas mchog shanti pas// klu sgrub kyang ni bzhed pa yi// bden pa gnyis po 'dir bshad ces// bshad de 'jigs med chos skyong gi

/dgongs pa nyid du gsal ba yin// zla ba grags pas gang bshad pa'i// stong nyid chos skyong zhabs sogs kyi// thugs su ma chud ces gsung mod// dpal ldan brtse ba chen po yis// chags pa gcod pa'i lam nyid dang*// rje btsun che des mtha' bral du// gtan la phebs pa'i lta bar bshad// de yang rdo rje gur nyid las// bdag tu lta ba tshol rnams kyi// bdag zhen bsam pa bzlog pa'i phyir// stong pa rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs// zhes pas chags gcod lta ba dang*// de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes// thabs kyi bde ba'i sdom pa ste// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa ni// zung 'jug byang chub chen po'i lam// 'di la chos skyong zhabs kyis ni// rigs tshogs sems tsam du bkral zer// 'o na rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid kyis// don dam rnam nges mdo der yang*// sher phyin dgongs pa sems tsam du// bkral ba yin nam der 'dod na// dbu ma rang nyid mdzad po yis// sems tsam gzhung du 'grel mdzad na// grub mtha'i go rim 'chol ba dang*// rnam rig tsam las ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan med pa sems tsam pa'i// grub mthar 'chad na sngags gzhung kun// sems tsam nyid du thal ba dang*// rang rgyal bse ru lta bus kyang*// sems tsam rtogs phyir chos dbyings las// chos gzhan med de rtogs par 'gyur// de sbyar ba las skyes pa'i dge /chos skyong ngo bo nyid med kyi// dbu mar zhugs zhes 'chad pa'i gtam// phyogs zhen can de spang phyir bsngo// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag byas nas// chos skyong zhabs kyi lam 'bras dang*// shin tu spros pa med pa yi// man ngag gzhung du thal rang gi /dbu ma'i rigs pa ma bshad par// byams pa'i gzhung gi rjes zhugs pa'i// dbu ma'i rigs pa de kho na// rgyas par bshad pa nyid yin phyir// chos skyong zhabs kyi dbu ma yang*// sems tsam yin zhes 'chad mi rung*// thal rang gzhung gi dbu ma ni// legs ldan 'byed dang zla grags kyis// gsal bar mdzad pa'i sngon ma byung*// chos skyong zhabs kyi dbu ma ni// mdo dang rgyud dang man ngag gi

/gzhung chen kun na gsal ba'i phyir// khungs med dbu mar bshad mi rung*// lugs de slob dpon zla grags kyis// rgyas par bkag pa ma yin nam// zhe na lugs de'i stong nyid kyang*// nim pa'i shing las rgun 'brum gyi// dpe dang chu shing snying po'i dpes// rgyas par bkag pa ma yin nam// 'o na 'gal la mi 'khrul ba'i// khas len nus par 'gyur zhe na// zla ba'i zhabs kyis legs bshad pa'i// stong nyid las gzhan sngags lugs kyi// stong nyid ngos 'dzin mi 'chad pa// chos skyong zhabs kyi thugs ma chud// kun btags las gzhan chos ji snyed// ngo bo nyid kyis mi stong bar// 'chad pa legs ldan zla sogs kyi// thugs la shong ba ma yin no// 'o na gnyis ka mi 'thad par// khyod kyi khas blangs byed nus sam// zhe na gnyis po mi 'gal bar// shes nas 'chad pa'i tshul 'di ltar// thal rang lta ba'i 'chad tshul tshe// 'phags pa'i mnyam par bzhag ngo na// chos rnams rang rang gis stong phyir// yul la 'jug pa'i blo yod min// rig bya rig byed gnyis med pa// so so rang rig zhes byar btags// mnyam par bzhag las bzhengs pa'i tshe// ji snyed 'jal ba'i ye shes dang*// bsod nams tshogs chen bsog pa yi// rnam shes yod par khas len pa// 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las// langs pa'i rjes thob ji bzhin no// de ltar bskal pa grangs med gsum// bsgoms pas rdzogs sangs rgyas mthar phyin// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi sku// stong pa nyid du ro gcig mod// yid bzhin nor 'dra sogs kyi dpes// gzugs sku phrin las lhun gyis grub// gzung 'dzin rtog pa kun bral ba'i// gnyis med ye shes rang rig pa// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i sa kun tu// rgyun mi chad pa chos skyong gi /gzhung yin sngags kyi lam zhugs tshe// kun btags ngo bo nyid med dang*// yongs grub yon tan kun gyi gzhir// med mi rung ba nyid du 'chad// lugs de gnyis ka lta ba'i tshe// rnam par rtog kun 'gog mtshungs mod// khyad par rnam rtog rang ngo nas// 'gog dang yul gzhan bkag pa yi// sgo nas rnam rtog 'gog pa nyid// bud shing med na me med pa'i// dpe yis bstan pa gang yin dang*// gzung med 'dzin pa nyid med ces// mthun par gsungs pa de yin no// lta bas spros pa bcad pa yi// 'bras bu khyad par med mod kyang*// bsgom pas nyams su myong bya'i dus// rang rig ye shes khas len pa// 'di ni phar phyin theg pa'i tshe// srol 'byed gnyis kyi khyad par ste// sngags su dpal ldan zla bas kyang*// gnas lugs sems kyi rdo rjer bzhed// de ltar de 'chad byed po yi// lhag bsam zla ba ltar dkar bas// rang gzhung la gzhan chos kun la// skur 'debs byed po'i mun sel shog/

/shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag byas nas// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa'i tshe// lta ba'i rang gzhung tshugs bshad pa// de la rtsod pa spang bar bya// slob dpon zla bas gang bshad pa'i// stong nyid las gzhan stong pa nyid// go chod sngags kyi gzhung lugs la// yod pa min ces zer ba dang*// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid// stong nyid med dgag la 'chad dang*// phar phyin lta ba las lhag pa// sngags la med par sa skya pas// bshad ces zer dang sangs rgyas la// ye shes med pa zla grags kyi// dgongs par 'chad na sangs rgyas dang*// slob dpon nyid la skur 'debs zhes// sa skya pa yis 'chad zer ba// de dag rim bzhin spang bar bya// thal rang gzhung du ma grags pa'i// stong pa nyid ni go chod po// yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid kyi// 'khor lo gsum pa'i mdo dang ni// gsang 'dus dgyes pa rdo rje dang*// dus kyi 'khor lor gang gsungs pa// byams pa'i chos dang byang sems kyi// 'grel pa skor gsum dag nas 'byung*// de dag ye shes du 'chad phyir// stong nyid ngo bo min zhe na// stong pa nyid la rang rang gi /ngo bos stong dang gzhan zhig gis// stong pa'i dbye ba gnyis 'chad pa// chos 'khor bar mtha'i dbye bas phye// phung po rnam bcad stong nyid dang*// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid zhes// gnyis su 'byed pa 'jam dpal gyis// lta ba'i dbye ba 'chad las gsungs// bde stong zung 'jug la sogs par// 'chad pa'i tshe na stong nyid kyi// ngos 'dzin bde dang gsal ba dang*// snang ba nyid la'ang bshad pa yin// de ltar min na khyod kyis ni// zung 'jug ngos 'dzin gsal bar smros// chos kyi dbyings dang don dam dang*// stong pa nyid dang gnas tshul zhes// ming gi rnam grangs gang bshad pa// chos dbyings ye shes las gzhan med// ngo bo nyid med smra gzhung du// gnas lugs don dam la sogs pa// med la der sgro btags pa tsam// yin gyi don dam khas mi len// sngags la'ang de ltar mtshungs she na// sngags kyi bsod nams tshogs sog kun// gzung 'dzin gnyis stong ngang nyid las// ma g.yos bzhin du byed pa'i phyir// don dam bden pa las gzhan med// sngags su chos kun kun rdzob zhes// 'chad pa gzhung na yod ma yin// ngo bo nyid med smra gzhung du// kun rdzob ma gtogs chos gzhan med// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid kyi// ngos 'dzin mdo sngags gnyis nas gsungs// mdo nas sbyin sogs chos rnams la// kun rdzob don dam gnyis phye nas// don dam nyid du gang 'chad pa'i// rnam byang chos rnams ji snyed pa// rnam kun mchog ldan stong par bzhed// dper na rgyud blar don dam pa'i// sems can byang sems sangs rgyas kyi// ngos 'dzin chos nyid kho nar bshad// sngags su'ang de ltar 'chad nus mod// stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo yi// ming can de la der 'chad do// de las gzhan pa'i med dgag ni// bde dang ji ltar zung du 'jug

/yul can bde ba chen po yis// yul gyi stong nyid de rtogs pas// bde stong zung du sbyor zhes pa'i// srol 'di khyed las sngon ma byung*// med par dgag pa'i yul can gyi// bde ba rtog pa las ma 'das// sa skya pa yis bshad pa'i don// pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las// lhag pa'i spros bral sngags na med// yod na sngags kyi lta ba ni// spros pa can du 'gyur zhes dang*// spros bral 'chad tshul yod med sogs// yul gyi spros pa kun bral dang*// de dang de las sogs 'dzin pa// yul can spros pa kun bral ba// dbu mar spros bral dang po dang*// sngags su spros bral phyi ma bshad// gnyis ka'ang mthar thug don gcig ste// rnam rtog 'gog pa'i dgos phyir ro// zhi ba lha dang zla ba'i zhabs// gnyis kas rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sar// ye shes med par gang 'chad pa// 'khor lo bar par gang bshad pa'i// chos kun rang rang ngo bo yis// stong pa'i tshul de ma nor bar// 'chad na tshul de bshad dgos so// ci phyir zhe na chos rnams kun// rang stong nyid du khas blangs nas// de yi yul can ye shes kyang*// der mi 'dod pa ci yi phyir// ye shes de yang rang stong du// 'dod na shes de yod par 'gal// rdzogs sangs rgyas la bskur 'debs su// 'gyur ba min pa'i shes byed ni// chos kun rang rang ngo bo yis// stong pa nyid las g.yo med par// gzhan snang dpag bsam shing ji bzhin// phrin las lhun gyis grub phyir ro// de skad 'di ni ma sbyar na// sngags kyi bsod nams tshogs sog pa// kun rdzob kho nar dogs gyur pa// spang ba'i phyir ro 'di sbyar bas// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// bsod nams tshogs chen khyad par dang*// rdzogs pa'i tshul dang 'bras dus kyi// dbye ba bde blag rtogs par shog/ //shu bha// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// sngags kyi lta ba'i mthar thug ni// bde stong zung 'jug ces bya ba// de yi ngos 'dzin 'dir bshad bya// bde dang stong dang zung 'jug pa// rnam pa gsum du thog mar dbye// bde ba de yang rdzogs rim gyi// dbang du byas na rnam gsum ste// rang byin brlabs dang gzhan rkyen las// byung dang zag pa med bde ba// snga ma gnyis po lus tshor te// zag med bde la lus sems gnyis// lus bde rang gis rang stong la// stong pa nyid du bshad byas tshe// chags pa gcod pa'i lam dang ni// kun tu rmongs pa'i gnyen por bshad// lus bde rnam rtog gis stong pa// stong pa nyid kyi ngos bzung tshe// stong pa de la'ang med dgag dang*// ma yin dgag pa'i dbye bas gnyis// dang po chags pa gcod pa ste// gnyis pa zung 'jug rjes mthun pa// chags pa gcod pa'i tshul gnyis ka

/shing rta'i srol las byung mod kyang*// chags gcod rkyang pa 'chad pa'i tshe// rang stong tshul de bzung bar bya// bde stong so sor ngos bzung nas// tshul bzhin goms par byas pa na// zung 'jug nyid du lhun gyis grub// de tshe zag pa med bde ba// de la rjes mthun mtshan nyid pa// rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// dang po mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes// gnyis pa don gyi ye shes so// dpe don gnyis ka zung 'jug las// gzhan du bshad par mi bya ste// rtog dang bcas pa'i lta ba des// don gyi ye shes mtshon mi nus// dpe don gnyis po re re la'ang*// rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa dang*// zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'o// gnyis po 'gal ba ma yin te// dbang la ltos dang ma ltos pa'i// dbye bas spyi dang bye brag go /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa ni// yul la khyad par med zhugs pa// thos bsam sbyor mthong sgom gsum po'i// rim gyis phar phyin pas rtogs tshe// spyi yi don du bshad pa yi// rang bzhin lhan cig skyes tsam nyid// de tshe rtog bral ma 'khrul pa// rnal 'byor pa yi mngon sum nyid// yin phyir de la dpe dang ni// don gyi dbye ba mi 'thad do// rang byin brlabs dang dbang gsum pa// las byung lus tshor bde ba ni// rtog dang bral bar gang skyes tshe// dpe dang don gyi dbye bas gnyis// dpe ni slar bzlog srid pa ste// don ni grub pa'i mthar son pa// dpe de tsam ni mu stegs la// yod pas de nyid rtogs zer zhing*// shes de nyid la rjes thob tu// bdag tu rmongs shing rtog par byed// kun tu rmongs pa de bzlog phyir// bde ba chos dang gang zag gis// stong pa gnas skabs gnyis par bshad// thos bsam rigs pas bdag med pa// shes pa'i sangs rgyas pa la ni// gsang sngags thabs las skyes pa yi// dpe'i ye shes bzlog mi srid// gong ma'i dbang nyid las byung ba'i// lhan skyes dga' bar mtshan btags pa// de yang tshig gi bzhi pa yis// rtog bral nyid du ngo sprod byed// ngo 'phrod gyur kyang goms pa yis// 'gyur med bde bar ma son pa// de srid dper yang mi rung ngo*// 'gyur med bde ba'ang stong brgyad brgya// phrag tshan bcu gnyis su phye nas// bcu gnyis pa dang sbyor ba'i phyir// phrag tshan dang po'i cha shas kyi// 'gyur med stong dang bdun brgya po// dpe yi ye shes nyid dang ni// sbyor ba'i lam dgu don mi za// rnam par rtog dang ma bral ba'i// lus tshor bar pa gang skyes kyang*// ye shes nyid du mi rung zhes// grub pa'i gzhung las ji skad du// dbang po gnyis sbyar bde ba ni// de nyid yin zhes skye ngan smra// de yi bde ba bde chen du// rgyal bas ma gsungs zhes bshad do// rang byin brlabs pa'i rim pa yis// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung*// ji tsam 'gags tshe der rgyu ba'i// rnam par rtog pa dang bral phyir// gsum pa'i dbang las bde thob pa// de tshe 'gyur med bde ba yang*// rlung 'gags pa dang grangs mnyam pa// mngon du byed la nus thob 'gyur// 'gyur med bde ba gcig tsam zhig

/rnam par rtog dang bral ba'i phyir// bde stong zung 'jug cha shas gcig /yin no lus tshor bde pa ni// bden pas stong pa bde dang stong*// zung du 'jug pa'i don yin zhes// phyis byon rnams kyi smras pa de// khungs las byung ba ma yin no// gzhan du thabs shes zung 'jug las// ma gtogs chos gzhan gang du btsal// zag med bde ba chen po yis// stong nyid yul du byas pa na// bde stong zung du 'jug go zhes// smra la khungs yod ma yin te// lung rigs kun dang 'gal phyir ro// shes dang shes bya gcig zhes pa// ci la zer ba khyod kyis smros// shes pa shes bya'i ngang du ni// chu la chu bzhag bzhin zer mod// shes pa rang stong ngang du ni// de ltar song na shes yod min// stong nyid shes par ro gcig na// stong nyid slar log gyur min nam// des na rnam rtog kun bral pa'i// zag med bde ba lhur byos shig /de sbyar phyi ma'i dus 'dir ni// sngags kyi zung 'jug lta ba ni// mun pa'i mal du gnyid log pa// snga bar nam langs byed por shog /shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// gsang sngags dngos gzhi'i nyams len ni// lta ba ma 'khrul ba rtogs pa// nges par sngon du 'gro dgos te// de ma rtogs par de byas na// tshe gcig la ni tshogs gnyis po// ji bzhin rdzogs par dka' ba dang*// rim pa gnyis kyi nyams len kun// kun rdzob thad sor bzhag pa la// rung ba min pa nyid phyir dang*// ye shes yin phyir chos rnams kun// don dam nyid las ma 'das phyir// de yang thog mar kun rdzob chos// rang stong nyid du shes zin nas// don dam chos kun nga yin zhes// de las rim gnyis chos kun spro// don dam de la mtshan 'dzin gyi// rnam par rtog pa 'gog don du// rjes kyi rig shes rtog pa yis// de yang stong pa nyid du byed// rtog ngor don dam stong nyid du// gtan la phebs pa tsam gyis ni// gnas lugs 'gog par nus min te// rtog pa'i yul las de 'das phyir// de yang thog mar gang zag gi

/dbang byas gzung 'dzin rnam gnyis dag /stong pa nyid du shes dgos te// mu stegs chos las dbye bya'i phyir// gang zag min pa'i kun rdzob kyi// chos 'ga' stong pa nyid shes pa// grangs can la sogs mu stegs kyi'ang*// chos nas bshad pa nyid phyir ro// nga dang gang zag yod min na// rgyud du nga las ma rtogs pa'i// chos gzhan yod pa min zhes dang*// nga las chos kun 'byung zhes pa// ci zhes dogs na don dam pa'i// nga la dgongs te gsungs pa yin// don dam nga ni nga med la// bdag tu lta ba yin no zhes// shes rab pha rol phyin las gsungs// kun rdzob bdag med don dam pa'i// bdag yod nyid du khas blangs na// kun rdzob las ni don dam pa// shin tu dbang btsan nyid kyi phyir// bdag yod nyid du khas blangs 'gyur// dper na kun rdzob du yod pas// yod mi dgos shing don dam par// yod na yod dgos ji bzhin no// zhe na chos 'khor gsum pa las// dam pa'i bdag de ma nyams par// nyams len byas pas 'bras dus su// bdag dam pa yi pha rol tu// phyin pa 'byung zhes gsal bar gsungs// de bzhin gtsang bde rtag gsum la// sbyar nas rgyas par gsungs yod pa// des kyang rdo rje theg pa yi// nyams su blang bya'i mtshan nyid shes// gang zag kun rdzob tu med cing*// dam pa'i don du song zhes pa// de 'dra'i khas len phyin ci log /dbu ma'i lung dang 'gal zhe na// kun rdzob chos kun med pa dang*// kun rdzob tsam du yod pa yi// dbye ba mkhas pas phyed gyur na// snga ma'i lan de gdon par sla// rigs pa'i shes pas kun rdzob chos// dpyad mi bzod par shes 'og tu// don dam rigs pas dpyad bzod pa// dbu ma'i lung dang 'gal zhe na// kun rdzob chos kun sgra dang ni// rnam rtog rnam shes kho na yi// yul phyir de ngor ma dmigs pas// de med pa yi go chod kyang*// don dam pa ni de dag gi

/yul las 'das phyir rnam shes kyi// yul du de ma dmigs pa yi// de med par ni 'jog mi nus// bskyed rim rtog pa'i yul nyid phyir// ye shes kyi ni tshogs bsags pas// rtog pa'i yul kun stong nyid du// byas pa don med 'gyur zhe na// bskyed rim sgom par byed dus kyi// rtog pa'i yul du gang song ba// de yi cha nas bskyed rim gyi// nyams su myong bya rnal po min// don dam ye shes rang mtshan las// rten dang brten par gang bsgrub pa// de nyid gsal ba mthar phyin tshe// don dam pa dang bskyed rim dngos// de nyid rnal 'byor las dang po'i// rtog pa'i yul du mi rung phyir// las dang po pas bskyed pa'i rim// bsgom pa med par 'gyur zhe na// las dang po yi bskyed pa'i rim// bsgom pa'i rtog pa 'khrul gyur kyang*// 'jug pa'i yul la mi slu ba// tshad ma nyid du mkhas pas bzhed// kun rdzob ma gtogs chos gzhan ni// yod min pa de thal rang gi /dbu mar grags kyang sngags la min// don dam ma gtogs chos gzhan ni// yod min pa de gsang sngags la// grags kyang thal rang dbu mar min// kun rdzob gang yin yod min du// khas len gnyis ka'i lugs yin kyang*// kun rdzob las gzhan don dam ni// khas len pa dang mi len pa// sngags dang thal rang dbu ma'i gzhung*// de ltar legs bshad me chen gyis// ngan rtog bud shing kun bsregs nas// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i lam chen por// 'jug la gegs byed med par shog/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// gsang sngags lam gyi tshe gcig la// bsod nams ji ltar rdzogs pa'i tshul// shes par dka' ba 'dir bshad bya// spyir ni bskal pa grangs med por// rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin pa// ji srid ma byas de srid du// yang dag mtha' mngon byas gyur na// chad pa'i myang 'das su lhung ba'i// dogs dang bcas pa bsam bya ba// shes rab rkyang pas sgrib pa kun// spong la tshegs yod ma yin yang*// de las logs su bsod nams tshogs// ji ltar rdzogs pa yin snyam na// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs// zung du 'jug pa rnam gsum po// thog mar so sor ngos zin nas// skabs 'dir zung 'jug nyid kyis rdzogs// ci phyir zhe na 'di'i skabs kyi// bsod nams tshogs ni ye shes kyi// tshogs las nam yang g.yo med phyir// tshogs gnyis ngo bo gcig tu 'dus// gang la tshogs sog bya yul dang*// gang gis tshogs sog byed po dang*// ji ltar tshogs sog bya gsum ka

/don dam dbang du byas phyir te// don dam dbang byas rnal 'byor pas// don dam pa yi sems can la// dbang bskur ba sogs phan 'dogs kyis// rang gi rgyud la tshogs chen rdzogs// de yang phyi nang bskyed rim gyis// zhing sbyang ba dang sems can smin// ye shes tshogs las ma langs par// snang bcas bskyed rim de goms pas// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par// gzugs sku 'char ba'i smon lam 'grub// ma dag snang ba gzhir byas nas// sbyin sogs bskal par bsgrub dgos pa// chos kyi dbyings nyid gzhir byas pa'i// sbyin sogs skad cig gcig gis 'grub// chos dbyings nyid kyi chos dbyings la// sbyin dang bzod sogs med snyam na// mchod po mchod yul mchod rdzas gsum// stong pa nyid du ro gcig pa// don dam pa'i mchod pa zhes// sngags las gsungs pa ma yin nam// de de go chod po min zhes// snyam du dogs pa 'ga' yod na// 'o na mchod pa bsang sbyang sogs// byas pa'i dgos pa ci yin soms// de lta na yang kun rdzob kyi// mchod rdzas dgos med thal zhe na// 'o na mchod rdzas mi dmigs par// byas pa'i dgos pa ci yin smros// mchod rdzas bden med du sems kyi// mchod rdzas med par byed min zhes// zer na phyi rabs lha min gyis// brtags pa'i dbu ma de byon to// kun rdzob pa yi sems can la// phan dang gnod pa byas pa las// dge dang sdig pa nyid 'gyur gyi// chos kyi dbyings la phan gnod med// snyam na chos dbyings las gzhan pa'i// sems can med pa gsang sngags su// ma zad phar phyin pa yi yang*// 'chad pa min nam de bsam bya// de 'dra lta ba'i dbang byas pa// yin no snyam na gsang sngags kyi// bsod nams lta ba'i ye shes dang*// zung du 'jug par ma gsungs sam// phar phyin du yang 'khor gsum po// mi dmigs ngang nas byed snyam na// yin mod rnam shes ngo na ni// gang snang thad sor 'jog pa yin// sngags su'ang de ltar byed snyam na// rnam shes yul gyi chos rnams kun// stong pa nyid du thag bcad nas// ye shes rdo rje nga yin zhes// ring du goms nas nga las gzhan// 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i// chos kun yod ma yin pa ni// gsang sngags lam du 'chad de ci// gzhan yang kun rdzob rang stong du// bshad na rgyang 'phan dang mtshungs zer// rgyang 'phan pa yis don dam pa'i// las dang rgyu 'bras 'dod dam ci// sngags kyi bsod nams tshogs bsog de// don dam bden par ming btags kyang*// phar phyin lugs kyi kun rdzob las// gzhan du song ba med snyam na// pha rol phyin pas ma brtags pa'i// don dam sngags kyi theg par bshad// phar phyin pa rnams ma rig pas// brtags pa'am dpyad mi bzod pa la// kun rdzob zhes zer gsang sngags su// de las bzlog pa ye shes tshogs// yin no bsod nams tshogs chen kyang*// ma rig gnyid kyis ma dkrugs shing*// rnam shes yul las 'das pa'i phyir// de yi byed pas klags mi brnyed// de skad sbyar bas gsang sngags dang*// pha rol phyin pa'i bden gnyis kyi// rnam par dbye la ma rmongs pa'i// shes rab klong yangs de thob shog

/shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// rang bsrung ba dang bgegs gzhom pa'i// bsrung 'khor bya byed las gsum gyi// nges pa'i don gang bshad bya ba// byed po 'khor lo rtsibs bcu ni// gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ye shes la// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi// mtshan du btags pa de nyid do// bya ba'i yul ni rang nyid la// gnod par byed po bgrang yas kyis// gnod pa'i bya ba sna tshogs su// snang ba'i rnam rig gang yin pa'o// rnam rig de dang bsrung 'khor gyi// byed po ye shes rdo rje yi// rnal 'byor rang gi shes rgyud kyi// tshogs pa gcig tu gnas pa ste// bar chad med pa'i lam dang ni// ngos skal spang ba'i dri ma bzhin// gnod bya rang gi shes rgyud las// gzhan na de yis de mi 'joms// gnod byed rang gi shes rgyud las// gzhan du yod pa ma yin na// thams cad shes rgyud gcig pa dang*// rgyud gzhan grub pa'i lung dang 'gal// zhe na gnod par byed po yi// ngo bo kun rdzob don dam gnyis// don dam pa ni gnas skabs su// rnal 'byor rang las rdzas gzhan du// bshad kyang gnod byed ma yin te// don dam rang rig rang gsal ba// dge ba'am lung ma bstan pa yis// rang la gnod pa 'gal phyir ro// rnal 'byor rang gi ngo bo yang*// kun rdzob pa dang don dam gnyis// kun rdzob mi dmigs par byas nas// don dam gnod byed ngo bor gcig /gnod byed kun rdzob pa de yang*// rnal 'byor rang la mi snang ba// gzhan gyi don la mi gnod cing*// snang na rang gi sems dri ma// las ni rang sems dri
