ma de// rang sems ye shes rdo rje yis// bsal nas gnod par byed po yi// dngos po sangs rgyas zhing du skyel// gnod byed ngo bo don dam pas// rang la gnod pa byed pa yi// kun slong dang ni bya ba'i las// ji ltar yod pa yin zhe na// de la de yod ma yin yang*// rnal 'byor rang gi kun rdzob pa'i// dngos pos dmigs pa'i rkyen dang ni// las kyi bdag po'i rkyen byas nas// gnod byed shes rig snga ma yis// de ma thag pa'i rkyen las ni// rang la gnod pa sna tshogs su// gsal bar mngon pa de byung ngo*// de phyir dgra gnyen du snang ba'i// rnam rig snang mkhan rang gi dngos// de las logs na dgra gnyen gyi// don dam ngo bo las gzhan med// don dam ngo bo rnal 'byor pa'i// dgra dang gnyen du 'gyur ma yin// de sbyar ba las bsrung 'khor gyi// bya byed gnas la gdeng thob nas// rang la chags dang gzhan la ni// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi gyur cig

/shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti/ rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa las// 'bras bu'i rdor 'dzin bzhengs pa'i tshe// gnyis po shes rgyud gcig gyur na// pha bu shes rgyud gcig tu 'gyur// pha bu'i khyad par med snyam na// yab kyi zhal zhugs dri za de// 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin nyid du// bzhengs pa min nam rgyud tha dad// yin na mngon rtogs tshar gcig pu// rnal 'byor shes rgyud mi gcig pa// gnyis kyi nyams su myong bya'i phyir// ha cang thal bar 'gyur zhe na// 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin nyid du// bzhengs pa'i dri za rnal 'byor pa// rang gi bar do yin pa'i phyir// rgyud gzhan nyid du thal ba med// rang gi bar do rang nyid la// ji ltar 'jug pa yin zhe na// rang gi skye ba snga ma yi// bar do rang la mi 'jug kyang*// skye ba phyi ma 'dzin 'gyur gyi// bar dos lus gzhan mi 'dzin par// rang nyid chos skur sangs rgyas pa'i// zhal du zhugs nas gzugs kyi sku// sgyu ma'i tshul gyis bzhengs byas nas// dag dang ma dag zhing rnams su// la lar snod bcud sbyong ba dang*// la lar sbyangs zin tshul gyis rol// de tshe kho nar ma zad kyi// dkyil 'khor gcig tu gang shar ba'i// gzhal yas khang dang lha rnams kun// rnal 'byor pa'am gtso bo yi// lha de kho na'i shes rgyud las// gzhan du bshad par bya min te// rnam rol ji snyed rnal 'byor pa// rang gi ye shes su 'du ba// rdo rje slob dpon zhes bya ba'i// de kho na nyid du bzhed do// gzhi yi dus su'ang rnam shes la// gang snang rnam par shes nyid du// 'du bar ma shes rnal 'byor pas// sngags kyi nyams len ji ltar byed// zhi ba lha dang zla grags kyis// rang rig bkag dang 'gal zhe na// rang nyid yod pa ma yin na// rang gis rang nyid ji ltar rig /zhes sogs spros pa gcod pa'i tshe// yin gyi tha snyad du ma yin// bde stong zung du sbyor ba'i tshe// stong nyid ye shes ma yin na// phyag rgya chen mo ji ltar 'thad// yin na rang gis rang rig go

/de skad 'di yang rnal 'byor pa'i// nyams len ngo na rang gzhan kun// rdzas gzhan nyid du zhen pa dang*// rnam shes dang ni ye shes kyi// rnam rol las gzhan snang ba yi// rten 'brel sna tshogs yod do zhes// byis pas btags pa'i gsang tshig kun// spang bar bya ba'i phyir yin no// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag byas nas// kho bos sngags dang byams pa'i chos// 'chad tshe chos dbyings ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan yod pa min zhes dang*// ngo bo nyid med du smra ba'i// gzhung 'chad tshe na kun rdzob las// ma gtogs chos gzhan yod min pa// de tshe kun rdzob kyang med pas// yod na don dam bden no zhes// sa skya'i grub mthar thag bcad tshe// yid la bsam pa gzhan byas nas// smra mkhas ne tsho'i dbang po 'ga'// grub mtha'i 'dzin lugs gtsang ba dang*// mi gtsang so sor 'byed dgos zer// de yi shes byed dris pa na// ma dag lus sogs kun rdzob kyi// bden pa tshad mas ma grub na// rgyu 'bras chos la bskur btab zer// snang gsum 'chad pa'i lam 'bras pa// gtsang ma rnams la 'di skad 'dri// rdzogs sangs rgyas la dag pa yi// snang ba las gzhan mi 'char na// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs phyir// ma dag snang ba med par 'gyur// 'khrul snang dang ni las snang zhes// 'chad na de dag ci la zer// ma dag sems la gang snang ba// de las gzhan pa'i don yod na// 'khrul par mi 'gyur de med na// kun rdzob phal cher bkag pa'i phyir// bsod nams tshogs sog ma 'khrul lam// 'gro drug las snang ji snyed pa// 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa'i// rtog med nyid phyir mngon sum gyi// tshad mar 'chad pa gsar byung gi /chos yin sa skya'i chos na med// mi la chur snang yod ces pa'i// lam 'bras 'chad pa 'ga' med dam// don dam byang chub sems sgom pa// med par dgag pa'i stong pa nyid// bsgom byar 'chad pa'i lam 'bras pa// grub mtha' gtsang ma 'ga' med dam// bsgom de gzhung bshad thams cad na// dug can lta bar ma bshad dam// lam 'bras pa la phar phyin las// lhag pa'i lta ba yod dam med// med na lta grub brgyad bshad pa'i// khyad par grub mtha' gtsang mas smros// yod na phar phyin spros bral las// lhag tshe spros bcas 'gyur ba ci// lam 'bras pa la don dam pa'i// bden pa'i ngos 'dzin yod dam med// med na sngags gzhung kun las nyams// yod na de'i mtshan gzhi dri// bum pa bden stong la sogs pa// gsar byung chos kyi gtam smra ba'i// spros pa'i mtha' kun bral ba dang*// gsal stong zung 'jug la sogs pa// zer na mtha' bral med dgag la// sngags kyi don dam par 'chad pa// rgyud gzhung kun las gsal bar bkag

/gsal stong sogs kyi mtshan gzhi ni// dris tshe chos gzhan gsal ba sogs// dgag bya bden grub kyis stong zhes// gsal byung chos de dbyangs su len// 'di ni gzhan stong tha shal zhig /yin mod khyod kyang de 'dod dam// 'khor 'das dbyer med ci la zer// 'khor ba tshad mas grub gyur na// de tshe mya ngan 'das mi 'grub// 'khor ba tshad mas ma grub na// kun rdzob bden la bskur pa btab// rgyud las 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi// mtshan gzhi e waṃ nyid la bshad// e waṃ ngos 'dzin lam 'bras pa'i// grub mtha' gtsang ma rnams kyis smros// ye shes tshogs bsog byed pa'i tshe// bshig nas stong nyid sgom pa dang*// btsan thabs sgom pa rnam gnyis bshad// bshig nas bsgom pa'i dgos pa ci// rigs pas dpyad pa'i stong pa nyid// dug can lta bar mi 'gyur ram// ye shes tshogs kyi stong pa nyid// ngo bo nyid med smra lugs sam// sngags lugs gzhan zhig yod dam 'dri// dang po ltar na chos rnams kun// rang rang ngo bos stong pa la// mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nyid nas// rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char ba 'gal// phyi ma ltar na kun rdzob kun// rang rang ngo bos stong pa dang*// don dam gzhan gyis stong pa las// gzhan med khyod kyang de 'dod dam// sngags kyi don dam gnyis med kyi// ye shes rgyu 'bras ngo bo yi// stong las gzhan du bshad pa med// thal rang gzhung gi stong pa nyid// 'di dang mthun par 'chad nus pa// min no phyis byung gtam skad dang*// mthun par khyed kyang 'chad byed dam// sngags kyi sgrub thabs tshogs gnyis po// mtha' dag don dam bden par nges// med par dgag pa'i stong nyid las// gzhan pa'i don dam bden med ces// zer ba gtsang ma'i grub mtha' 'am// pha rol phyin pa'i stong pa nyid// rnam grangs pa'i don dam dang*// spyi'i don dam gsang sngags kyi// don dam rnam grangs min pa'i dang*// sbas pa'i don gyi don dam zhes// nged kyis grub mtha' gtsang mar 'chad// la la bden grub khas len pa// dbu ma'i grub mtha' min zhes zer// bden dang bden par grub pa yi// khyad par zla ba grags pa'i gzhung*// 'chad po gsar byung rnams kyi gtam// sngon byon sus kyang bshad pa med// kun rdzob bden pa tshad grub tu// smra ba lo brgya tshun chad kyi// gtam yin sngon rab rgya bod du// grags pa sus kyang bshad pa med// khyed cag grub mtha' gtsang ma ni// phyis byung gtam dang sres nas 'chad// kho bo cag ni gzhung chen dang*// bstun nas gong ma'i gzhung lugs 'chad// 'di na grub mtha' gtsang ma ba// la las gzhan gzhung 'gog pa na// chos kun bden med du zhen pa// chad pa'i lta ba yin zhes dang*// bden grub chos 'ga' khas blangs na// rtag pa'i lta bar song zhes smra// ngo bo nyid med smra gzhung du// bden zhen rtag par lta nyid phyir// lugs der rnam grangs min pa yi// don dam bden pa mi bzhed mod// gang du don dam bden 'dod pa'i// gzhung der don dam bden grub bzhed// 'on kyang der 'dzin rtog pa ni// mtha' dag spang bya nyid yin phyir// chos kun spros dang bral bar grub// spros kun bral ba'i kyai rdo rje// gnas lugs nyid du sngags pas 'chad// bden med zhen blo chad lta na// dbu ma'i rigs pas chos rnams kun// bden grub bkag pa'i rjes dpag dang*// rigs shes chad lta nyid du thal// chad lta 'bad nas sgrub byed pa'i// dbu ma'i rigs tshogs de ngo mtshar// gzhung lugs chen po dpyis phyin pa// med par rtag chad lta ba yi// ngos 'dzin skad gsang mthon por ni// smra mkhas de dag gad mo'i rgyu// chos 'ga' bden par grub nyid du// dus rnams kun tu khas blangs nas// rigs pas bshig tshe de med par// zhen pa'i shes rab chad lta yi// ngos 'dzin yin no chos rnams kun// gdod nas bden par grub min pa// de la der zhen gnas lugs dang*// mthun phyir ci zhig chad par lta// de bzhin kun rdzob chos rnams kun// gdod nas yod ma myong ba la// yod pa min zhes smras pa'i tshe// thar pa'i lam gyi gnad 'chug zhes// byis pas brtags pa'i smra mang po// rgan pos dbyangs su len mi 'tshal// de skad 'di ni phyogs 'ga' la// sdang bas ma yin phyogs gzhan la// chags pas ma yin mdo rgyud la// rmongs pas ma yin rnyed pa dang*// bkur bsti'i phyir min lugs gzhan gyis// 'chal gtam dbyangs su blangs pa min// yin no gti mug chen po yis// gti mug sel bar byed pa dang*// chags pa chen pos chags pa yang*// thams cad sel byed zhe sdang ches// zhe sdang kun sel 'di springs pas// kun kyang chos skur ro gcig shog/

/shu bhaṃ// // ༄// swasti/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag byas nas// sngon gyi chos lugs dam pa ni// rna ba'i lam du ma gyur pas// bdag la rtsod pa de bsal bya// de la kha cig 'di snyam du// lha dang sngags kyi bsgrub pa'i gzhi// don dam bdag yin zhes zer ba// 'di 'dra grangs can lugs yin te// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba yi// shes rig rtag pa gcig pu ste// dam pa'i bdag dang skyes bu dang*// 'khor 'das kun gyi byed pa por// 'dod pas de dang mtshungs she na// de mtshungs min pa'i shes byed kyi// lung dang rigs pa 'dir bsam bya// lung ni lhan cig skyes pa dang*// grub mthas rnam brtags bdag gnyis kyis// stong pa'i rang rig ye shes la// dam pa'i bdag ces ji skad du// de bzhin nyid dag dag pa'i bdag /bden par smra zhing tshig mi 'gyur// ces dang bdag med srog gi bdag /thob pa sangs rgyas dag pa'i bdag /ces dang bdag dang bdag med kyi// spros pa zhi ba dam pa'i bdag /ces dang ye shes tshogs sog tshe// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje ni// nga dang bdag tu sgom par gsung*// rigs pa grangs can shes rig gi /bdag de gang zag skyes bu dang*// ngar 'dzin rtog pa'i gzung bya dngos// za ba po yin yon tan dang*// bya ba gang yang mi byed dang*// thar pa thob pa'i gnas skabs su// gzung 'dzin spros pa kun bral ba'i// shes rig tsam du gnas shes zer// rang lugs dam pa'i bdag de ni// ngar 'dzin la sogs rtog pa ni// kun gyi yul las 'das pa dang*// bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs// yon tan kun dang dbyer med cing*// rdzogs sangs rgyas de sku gsum dang*// phrin las lhun gyis grub par bzhed// 'di nyid dri ma dang bcas tshe// rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs dang ni// rgyu yi rgyud dang sangs rgyas kyi// snying po dang ni 'khor 'das kyi// chos rnams kun gyi gnas dang ni// rang bzhin sangs rgyas zhes byar gsungs// dam pa'i bdag ces brda btags kyang*// rtog pa'i yul du mi 'gro zhing*// rtog med shes pas bdag nyid du// sgro 'dogs byed pa mi srid phyir// bdag med pa ni dam pa'i bdag

/dper na bden pas stong pa la// don dam bden pa zhes byar btags// dam pa'i bden zhes brda sbyar kyang*// bden pa min pa ji bzhin no// dam pa'i don gyis bdag yin phyir// bdag med nyid du 'gal zhe na// 'o na don dam bden yin na// bden pa med pa nyid du 'gal// bdag tu 'jog dang bdag med par// 'jog pa'i gnas skabs mang mod kyang*// byis rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir// dam pa'i bdag de bdag min zhes// khas blangs pa na rtsod las grol// ces dam pa'i bdag la rtsod pa spong ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa sngags la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// snyan rgyud kyi sbas don la 'khrul pa spong pa mthu stobs dbang phyug gi dgongs pa rnam nges chos tshan bcu gcig pa bzhugs so// ༄// na mo gu ra we/ lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang las// snang ba rnam gsum zhes bshad pa// gang de gzhung 'di'i mdor bstan te// gzhi lam 'bras gsum bstan phyir ro// gzhi ni ma dag de bzhin nyid// lam ni nyams snang ye shes te// 'bras bu sangs rgyas de bzhin nyid// gsum ka'ang chos dbyings ye shes so// ma dag snang ba zhes bya ba// ma rig pa dang gzung 'dzin gyi// bag chags dbang gis snang ba ste// 'khrul pa'i snang ba kho nar bshad// 'khrul snang sems su thag bcad na// gzung ba yul du med par go /sems snang sgyu mar thag bcad na// 'dzin pa'i dri ma 'khrul par shes// gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa yi// shes pa rang rig rang gsal ba// 'di ni rang bzhin lhan skyes te// ma dag dus su rgyu yi rgyud// lta ba 'di goms byas pa las// rgyu rgyud dri mas dag pa na// rnam shes yul du ma dag pa'i// snang ba ci yang 'char mi nus// nyams kyi snang ba zhes bya ba// nyon mongs las dang bag chags dang*// rnam smin mthu las ma yin par// rnal 'byor dbang gis snang ba ste// 'di la mi 'char yod ma yin// 'char byed blo ni ye shes te// dpe dang don gyi dbye bas gnyis// rnam shes yul du 'di 'char na// ma dag snang ba las ma 'das// 'dir yang snang ba ye shes dang*// der snang sgyu mar thag bcad pas// gzung bya'i yul dang de 'dzin la// mngon par zhen pa'i dri ma spong*// nyams snang 'di ni chos gzhan gyis// stong pa yin te sa sogs su// snang yang de yis stong par bshad// gzhan gyis stong yang ye shes kyi// ngo bo nyid du 'chad nus sam// zhe na gnas tshul ye shes la// snang tshul kun rdzob lta bur snang*// 'khor ba'i snang ba ye shes su// bden par 'chad nus ma yin te// nus na rdzogs sangs rgyas blo la// ma dag snang bar thal phyir ro// rnam par byang ba'i chos ji snyed// ye shes de la gang shar ba// gnas tshul nyid la zhugs pa'i phyir// ye shes ngo bor khas len bya// don gyi ye shes de nyid la// chos kun gzugs brnyan tshul du ni// mi 'char ci yang yod min pa// de la rnam kun pa zhes zer// rnam kun pa de chos gzhan gyis// stong yang rang gi ngo bo ni// bde ba che las ma g.yos pa// de la stong nyid mchog tu bzhed// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid 'di// mtshan gyi rnam grangs e waṃ ste// 'di las ma gtogs 'khor ba dang*// myang 'das gang yang yod ma yin// mya ngan zhes pa mtshan 'dzin gyi// rnam par rtog pa thams cad de// de las 'das phyir e waṃ 'di// rang bzhin mya ngan 'das par bzhag

/de nyid 'khor ba dngos min yang*// de med na ni 'khor ba'i chos// mi 'byung phyir na 'di nyid la// 'khor ba tshad zhes bshad pa yin// ji srid ma rig yod de srid// e waṃ 'khor ba'i chos su 'char// ma rig zad par gyur pa na// mya ngan 'das las gzhan mi srid// e waṃ mngon du byed pa'i thabs// dbang dang rim pa gnyis yin te// de nyid gzugs su shar ba la// stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mor brjod// gnyis snang bag chags ma spangs pa// de srid ma dag snang ba 'char// 'di ni sems can kun la ste// gnyis snang bag chags yod phyir ro// gnyis med ye shes shar gyur kyang*// gnyis snang bag chags ma zad pa// de srid nyams kyi snang ba ste// rdzogs sangs rgyas la 'di mi srid// sangs rgyas me long ye shes la// 'khor ba'i gzugs brnyan 'char bshad kyang*// gnyis snang bag chags zad pa'i phyir// dag pa'i snang ba kho nar bshad// snang gsum lam gyis ma bsdus pa'i// lam 'bras chos gzhan yod min yang*// blo dman rim gyis 'khrid pa na// gsum po'i cha shas btsal nas bkri// blo dman rnams la bsod nams kyi// cha nas thog mar 'chad dgos te// lta ba blo yul 'char ba la// bsod nams tshogs pa dgos phyir ro// de yang thog mar mngon mtho'i chos// de nas nges legs thun mong ba// rjes su byang chub sems dpa'i chos// lta ba dbang bskur nas 'chad pa// dgyes pa rdo rje'i dgongs pa ste// lugs 'dir lta ba rtogs pa'i thabs// dbang bskur nyid la 'chad phyir ro// zhes pa 'di ni brag dkar ba// byang chub sems dpa'i zhal gyi ngor// sbyar ba'i dge bas rang lugs kyi// chos la nges par rdeng thob shog/ //maṅga laṃ bha wantu// // ༄// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal te// la la snang gsum 'khrid 'chad pa'i// sngon du rgyu dus dbang bskur ba// chos rje bla ma'i dgongs par 'chad// dbang gis smin pa'i rten can la// mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs// dang po'i 'khrid tshul smos ci dgos// byang chub sems la'ang bkri mi dgos// de mi dgos par grub ce na// dam pas mdzad pa'i khrid yig tu// las dang po yi 'khrid tshul las// gzhan ma bshad pa ci la dgongs// dbang gis ma smin rten can gyis// bla ma'i zhabs pad bsten par 'gal// zer mod bla ma rnam bzhi yi// rnam bzhag 'chad pa gzhung bshad yin// khrid kyi thog mar su yis 'chad// nyams snang 'chad pa'ang gzhung bshad tshe// rgyas par 'chad kyi khrid dus su// rgyu med 'bras bu gang las 'byung*// skabs der rim gnyis sgom zhe na// dam pas ma bshad pa dang 'gal// khyed la'ang dbang gis smin pa dang*// thun mong theg par sbyangs zin la// lam 'bras 'chad tshe snang gsum gyi// khrid la dgos med 'gyur zhe na// snang ba gsum gyi spyod pa la// rim gyis slob dgos ma yin yang*// gnyis med lta ba goms byas pas// snang ba gsum la zhen pa spong*// de yi 'og tu rgyu dus kyi// dbang bskur nges par dgos ma yin// de lta na yang bum dbang gi

/lta ba skyes zin ma yin na// de rtogs pa yi thabs mchog tu// bum pa'i dbang bskur blang bar bya// de nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi// lta ba'i ngo sprod rgyas par bshad// snang gsum lta ba rigs pa las// shes mod 'di ni dbang las so// la la 'di yang rigs pa yis// bsgrubs par 'chad pa rigs min te// thos bsam lta ba dug can dang*// nyams su len pa'i gnad gsum bshad// la la snang gsum gnas skabs su// don dam byang chub sems sgom pa// ngo bo nyid med smra ba yi// stong nyid sgom pa mchog yin zer// rigs pas sgro 'dogs gcod pa la// rigs pa'i lam de ches zab kyang*// sngags kyi theg par zhugs pa na// sems kyi rdo rje sgom pa mchog /ces pa rje btsun sku mched kyi// lung las gsal bar gsungs pa ltar// chos rje bla mas gzhung shing du// gsal bar bkod pa de yin no// lam 'bras pa la sems bskyed kyi// sdom pa 'bogs pa'i lugs med ces// zer ba gtam 'chal yin mod kyi// cho ga'i nges pa der ma gsungs// sems bskyed nges par mi dgos dang*// dbang skur nges par dgos pa 'gal// gzhung bshad rim dang khrid rim gyi// rnam dbye bsres nas 'chad bzhin du// gzhan la mgo 'jug dkrugs so zhes// kyal ka gtong bar ma byed cig /'dir yang rang gis gang thos pa// de kho na nyid bden yin gyi// gzhan ni gti mug ces zer ba// spang ba'i don du zhar la smras// // ༄// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// phyi rabs pa rnams gsang sngags kyi// lta ba dbu ma thal rang gi /gzhung bzhin nges par 'chad dgos zer// mtshan 'dzin 'gog tshe de lta bu'i// rigs pa bshad kyang mi 'gal mod// gang 'dir nyams su myong bya yi// stong nyid de dang mthun pa med// ci phyir zhe na lugs de yi// stong nyid mngon sum yul mi rung*// 'dir ni rang rig mngon sum gyi// myong bya zhig la lta bar bshad// thal rang gzhung gi stong pa nyid// rnam grangs pa yi don dam zhes// rje btsun mched kyis gsungs pa dang*// gzhung las kun rdzob bden par bshad// thal rang lugs kyi stong pa nyid// tshad ma gnyis pos mi rtogs pa// rang gzhung so so'i dgongs pa zhes// a ti sha yis gsal bar gsungs// phyi ma'i dus 'dir grags can dag

/yul can bde ba chen po yis// thal 'gyur lugs kyi stong pa nyid// rtogs pa sngags kyi lta bar 'chad// thal 'gyur lugs la stong nyid kyi// yul dang yul can mi 'chad cing*// rigs pas btsal na ma mthong ba// de la stong nyid mthong bar btags// phung po rnam bcad stong pa dang*// thal byung zab mo sngags lugs kyi// nyams su myong bya min zhes pa// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal lung yin// des na rang lugs 'chad pa po// rnams kyang dbu ma'i rigs pa yis// zhib mor dpyad pa ma byas na// sngags kyi lta ba mi rtogs zhes// zer ba lugs gzhan dag dang 'dres// rang gi lugs la thos bsam gyis// sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i lta ba ni// dug can nyid dang lta ba'i yul// rnam grangs pa yi don dam tsam// yin zhes bshad pa la sogs pa// rang gzhung zhib tu slobs la ltos// 'di yang gzhan gyi kha zegs tsam// lhur len byed pa spang phyir du'o// //maṅga lambha wantu// // ༄// rdo rje 'chang la phyag byas nas// kun gzhi rgyu rgyud ces bya ba// kun gzhi'i rnam shes nyid yin zhes// zer ba de dag spang bar bya// kun gzhi'i rnam shes las nyon gyi// rnam par smin pa dngos su bshad// rigs drug so sor gang smin pa// chad cing smin nas yang srid len// 'dir na brjod bya don gyi rgyud// rnam byang phyogs kyi chos kun dang*// dbyer med gzhi lam 'bras bu yi// gnas skabs kun tu chad mi srid// 'di la chos dbyings ye shes dang*// bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po dang*// rang bzhin lhan skyes ye shes dang*// gnyis med ye shes sogs su grags// 'di yi ma dag dag pa sogs// gnas skabs gsum la snang gsum dang*// rgyu dang thabs dang 'bras bu yi// rgyud gsum dag tu rnam par bzhag /'di la las dang nyon mongs pa'i// sa bon btab pas 'khor ba 'char// ma chags sogs kyis thos pa yi// bag chags bzhag pas sangs rgyas 'grub// zag bcas las kyi sa bon ni// de dang 'dres pa mi srid cing*// thos sogs bag chags rgyu rgyud dang*// dbye ba med par lhun gyis grub// nyon mongs bag chags zad pa na// de lta'i sa bon mi 'debs phyir// e waṃ zung 'jug myang 'das su// lhun gyis grub pa de bzhugs so// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa dang*// dbyer med min pa ga la srid// dbyer med ces pa zung 'jug dang*// de don gnyis su med pa dang*// gnyis med don ni gcig pu dang*// gcig pu de yang rang bzhin gyis// rnam par dag pa'i myang 'das te// dam pa'i don ni de gcig pu// la la gsal stong zung 'jug don// bden gnyis zung du 'brel bar 'chad// gsal ba kun rdzob bden pa dang*// stong pa bden med la 'chad zer// 'di 'dra lam 'bras rgyu 'dzin gyis// 'chad pa lta ci brgya lam na// thos par gyur kyang mi nyan te// nges don shin tu 'khrugs phyir ro// des na rtog pa kun bral ba'i// gsal rig bde ba chen po ni// dam pa'i don du shes byas nas// dbang las yang dag blang bar bya// kun gzhi'i ye shes zhes bya ba// lung las bshad pa med zer na// thog med dus kyi dbyings zhes bshad// gsang ba 'dus par nges don gyi// ngos 'dzin 'od gsal nyid la bshad// de la rje btsun ku mā ras// spros bral med par dgag pa la// 'od gsal la nyid du ngos bzung nas// gangs can 'di na 'phags skor gyi// 'od gsal go ba sngon med zer// de ltar 'chad tshe sangs rgyas sar// ye shes med par khas len byed// tsong kha pa yi gsung las ni// bde stong zung 'jug 'od gsal te// bde dang stong pa chu la ni// chu bzhag ltar song zung 'jug don// yin zhes 'chad par byed mod kyi// bde ba chen po spros bral du// ro gcig gyur na med dgag nyid// spros bral bde bar ro gcig na// 'od gsal ngos 'dzin snga rabs pa'i// lugs las gzhan du 'das pa med// 'od gsal med dgag tu bshad na// sgrib kun spangs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// rang don sku la shes med par// 'chad pa zla ba grags pa'i lugs// de phyir rang lugs 'chad pa rnams// gzhan zer dbyangs su ma len shig

/ces pa 'di yang rang gi gzhung*// tshugs par 'chad pa'i don du'o// //dge'o// // ༄// rdo rje sems dpar phyag byas nas// lam gyi thun bzhir dbang bzhi pos// lus la brten nas bde chen gyi// sgrib pa 'gag ces gsungs pa'i don// de yi sgrib pa rnam rtog ste// de las 'pho ba'i bag chags 'byung*// 'pho ba'i bag chags zhes bya ba// de ni 'gyur ba'i bde ba ste// lus la gnad du bsnun pa las// rlung sems dbu mar chud pa na// rnam par rtog pa dang brel ba'i// bde ba shar de bde chen nyid// de yang shes bya'i sgrib pa ste// nyon mongs zad pa'i dgra bcom dang*// gzugs kyi khams kyi rten la yang*// bde chen sgrib pa de yod phyir// 'di dag sngags la nye rgyu yis// mtshams sbyor byed tshe yum chen mo// shes rab pha rol phyin dang sbyor// de la phyag rgya che zhes bya// sgrib de 'gags nas 'tshang rgya bar// gsal bas bshad rgyud ces pa'i don// kun gzhi rgyu rgyud bde chen du// shar de longs spyod rdzogs par sgrub// de ltar 'char ba gzung 'dzin gyi// rlung sems lus su 'gags las byung*// de phyir ma dag lus 'di nyid// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i nyer len min// ci phyir zhe na bskyed rim gyi// dus su stong pa'i ngang las sgrub// rdzogs rim dus su 'gros bzhi po// ma thim bar du 'tshang mi rgya// lus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba// ma dag lus nyid yin zhes zer// zag bcas las kyi rnam smin ni// gdod nas grub par 'chad mi nus// bskyed rim dus kyi rten brten pa// ye shes snang bar 'chad bzhin du// lus kyi dkyil 'khor bems po yi// khams su 'chad pa 'di mi rigs// mdor na lugs su snang ba yi// rnam rig las gzhan lus 'ga' med// rnam rig de la glo bur gyi// dri ma'i cha dang ye shes cha// ye shes de nyid mig la sogs// chos can so so dang 'brel tshe// chos can so so'i ming mang pos// so sor btags nas rten dang ni// brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du// rang bzhin nyid kyis lhun grub pa// bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag gi

/sgron mas rim bzhin gsal 'debs byed// de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa dang*// lha rnams so so'i dag pa zhes// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa btsal ba na// de ltar 'chad las gzhan mi srid// de bzhin nyid kyi lus dkyil dang*// kun btags sogs kyi bshad pa ni// sems tsam ma gtogs dbu ma dang*// gsang sngags pa la med ces zer// sngags su ma zad theg chen gyi// bsgrub bya sgrub pa po gnyis ka /nges par de bzhin nyid du 'chad// 'di la dam pa'i bdag ces zer// rje btsun grags pas gur rgyan du// kun btags la ni gzhan dbang gi /rgyas 'debs gzhan gyi dbang de la// yongs su grub pa'i rgyas 'debs zhes// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa snang ba kun// rnam rig tsam las gzhan yod min// rnam rig ngo bo yongs grub kyis// shes bya kun la rgyas 'debs byed// rje btsun byams pas yongs grub nyid// yon tan kun gyi rten yin par// dgongs nas de ma rdzogs pa dang*// rab rdzogs shes bya'i rnam gzhag gsungs// shes pa chos 'khor bar mtha' yi// nges don lta ba smos ci dgos// rdo rje theg pa'i ye shes kyi// tshogs bsogs tsam gyi go ba yang*// ne tso'i 'don pa ji bzhin du// song ba rnams kyis mkhas pa dang*// grub pa rnams kyi gzhung chen po// khyad du gsod pa spang phyir yin// de yi dge bas bdag dang ni// lhan cig nges don lta ba yi// skal mnyam gzhan yang zung 'jug sku// sgrub pa'i gzhi la rdeng thob shog/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༄// na mo gu rā we/ bskyed rim lha yi sgrub gzhi ni// rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa ste// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i lha gang yin// bde chen ye shes nyid las sgrub// gnas tshul rang bzhin lhan skyes te// snang tshul sngags dang phyag mtshan las// lha rnams so sor bskyed pa la// sngags kyi sku zhes bya bar bshad// phyi dang nang gi mchod pa yang*// stong pa'i ngang las sgrub pa po'i// ye shes kho na sa bon gyi// rnam par gyur las bsgrubs de yin// lhan cig skyes pa nyams myong gi

/ye shes mngon du ma gyur pa// de srid rtog pa'i yul yin phyir// don dam rnam grangs pa zhes bya// dbu mar son pa'i bde ba nyid// lhan skyes ngo bor gang shar ba// de tshe rang rig pa'i dag pa// mngon du gyur phyir don dam dngos// 'di yis grub pa'i lha sku la// rdzogs rim lha dang ye shes lha// zhes bya gzhan gyi rnam rig la// sgyu ma'i 'char tshul ji bzhin no// nang gi bskyed rim sgrub pa'i gzhi// ma dag phung po nyid yin zer// 'o na 'di la dbang bskur tshe// ma dag phung po mi dmigs par// bdag dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka yang*// de bzhin nyid du byas de ci// dgyes pa rdo rjer 'bras bu yi// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku dang ni// gsang ba 'dus par dang po yi// mgon po'i sku la lus dkyil sgom// de dag ma dag lus su ni// bshad na ha cang thal bar 'gyur// phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag ces// gsungs pa rnam dag phung po lnga// gzhan du ma dag 'jig rten dang*// rdul mtshon kha dog rnam lnga dang*// tha mal chu dang me tog sogs// lha dang mchod rdzas dngos yin nam// gsang ba 'dus par sems dben gyi// ye shes de nyid sgyu ma'i sku// sgrub pa'i gzhi dang der sgrub pa// de la kun rdzob bden zhes bshad// de las 'od gsal ba dang ni// zung 'jug mngon du gyur pa'i tshe// ma dag pa yi gzugs la sogs// shul du 'jog ces bod rnams smra// 'di ni phyi rol don smra ba'i// nges pa sems la zhen pa ste// gzugs su snang ba'i rnam rig las// ma gtogs gzugs yod min phyir ro// rnam rig de nyid gnyis snang gi /bag chags can la 'char zhe na// ind+ra bhū ti btsun mor bcas// shul du lus pa ltar snang ngam// la la slob dpon klu sgrub kyis// sku tshe de la zung 'jug sku// mngon du mdzad nas rang gi lus// gzhan la sbyin par btang zhes zer// 'di mi 'thad pa'i lung rigs ni// mang po'i blo la ljen phyir bzhag

/ma rgyud pa rnams gser 'gyur gyi// rtsi las lcags la gser bzo ltar// rnal 'byor lus kyi bems po'i khams// zad nas ye shes sku byed gsung*// gzhan dag sol ba dung 'gyur bzhin// bems po shes par mi 'gyur zer// 'di yang rdul phran don smra yi// lugs yin bems por snang ba yi// rnam rig der 'gyur 'gal ba med// 'dir yang bems po'i khams zad nas// rdzogs sangs rgya bar gsungs pa'i phyir// ma dag lus kyi bems po'i khams// sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba med// ces pa 'di yang brag dkar ba// byang chub sems dpa' bskyed rdzogs kyi// gnas la dogs pa 'khrung srid pa// sel phyir legs pa'i blo yis smras// de yi dge bas rang nyid kyang*// zab mo'i gnas la rdeng thob nas// sgrub pa snying por byed pa dang*// theg pa mchog dang 'bral med shog/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༄// na mo mañdzu badzrā ya/ dgyes pa rdo rje nga nyid ces// sgom pas goms par byed dus kyi// nga de gang la bya zhe na// rgyal ba'i bka' las rnam gnyis gsungs// kun rdzob btags pa'i yod pa dang*// don dam lhan skyes ye shes so// dang po ye nas med bzhin du// lhan cig skyes dang grub mthas brtags// dang po yang dag kun rdzob dang*// gnyis pa log pa'i kun rdzob bo// 'di dag yul can dang bcas pa// kun btags nyid phyir yon tan gyi// rten du rdzogs pa min par ni// bshad pas lhag pa'i lhar mi skyed// gang zhig lhag pa'i lhar rung ba// yon tan kun dang dbyer med 'gyur// gang de bdag tu snang ba dang*// zhen pa spangs nas de lhar skyed// de ma bcad na gang zag nyid// lha der skyed pa rung ma yin// gang la bdag tu zhen yod pa// de srid de ltar mi 'char te// bdag tu zhen dang lhar snang ba// lhan cig mi gnas 'gal phyir ro// de bzhin phung sogs dri ma'i chos// yon tan rnams dang dbyer med du// rung ba min nam lhar bskyed na// lhag pa'i lha rnams spang byar 'gyur// bskyed rim rags pa rten dang bcas// ye shes las grub zer bzhin du// phra ba'i bskyed rim rten brten pa// ye shes min pa gad mo'i gnas// ji srid bems por snang dang zhen// de srid lus dkyil du mi 'char// zhen par gyur na smos ci dgos// snang ba de gnyis 'gal phyir ro// gnyis pa lhan skyes ye shes ni// ngar 'dzin yul las 'das pa'i phyir// de yis der bzung bdag min yang*// kun gyi gnas phyir bdag ces bya// bdag ma yin na don dam pa'i// bdag tu 'gal ba nyid ce na// 'di nyid bdag ces bya bar ni// 'dod pa grangs can lugs yin mod// 'di na la la sems tsam pas// kun gzhi bdag tu 'dod ces dang*// yid kyi rnam shes bdag dngos su// legs ldan 'byed kyis 'dod ces dang*// thal 'gyur ba rnams phung po la// brten nas btags pa'i nga tsam nyid// bdag tu 'dod ces smra bar snang*// 'di dag mu stegs gzhung yin no// des na chos nyid ye shes nyid// dam pa'i don gyi bden gcig pu// rnam rtog ma lus khegs pa na// lhag pa'i lhar ni lhun gyis grub// gnas tshul dam pa'i don gyi lha// de nyid rtogs pas lhar bskyed nas// gzung bya kun rdzob yin mod kyang*// goms pa rdzogs nas ye shes lha// sems bcas min pa'i don yod par// theg chen mtha' dag mi bzhed kyang*// 'di na bems po lhar sgom zhes// smra ba rgyud sde'i lugs min no// 'di na gsar byung chos smra ba// phyi rol don la zhen ches pas// gnyug ma gzhi lus sangs rgyas tshe// bems lus lhag mar bzhag ces zer// bems po ye nas yod min par// rnal 'byor ye shes kyis rtogs tshe// bems po'i snang ba sgrub pa po'i// ma 'khrul shes la 'char mi srid// 'dir yang bde stong zung 'jug las// sgyu ma'i sku de bsgrub par bya// kun rdzob sgyu ma'i sku de ni// ji srid 'od gsal du zhugs pa// mthar ma phyin pa de srid du// slob pa'i zung 'jug skur yang ni// ldang mi nus na mi slob pa'i// zung 'jug skur ldang smos ci dgos// des na bems po'i chos rnams ni// zung 'jug skur ldang ma zer shig

/ma rgyud pa rnams 'bras bu la// mtshams sbyor nus pa'i nye rgyu yi// 'ja' lus bsgrubs nas rten de la// zung 'jug mngon du byed par bzhed// 'di ni gsar byung grub mtha' dang*// bsres nas theg pa chen por yang*// phyi rol don gzhan khas len pa// rnams kyi 'khrul pa sel phyir du// legs pa'i blo yis mdo rgyud kyi// snying po bsdus nas sbyar ba yi// yi ge pa ni rab gzhung pa// blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ bha wantu// // ༄// na mo mañdzu badzrā ya/ gang 'dir theg mchog rtse mo pa// rnams ni gang shar lha sku dang*// snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*// rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes// smra la the tshom ma mchis pa// bshad 'jug so sor ma phye ba'i// dad pas rjes 'brang 'thad mod kyang*// chos kyi rjes 'brang 'dir bsam bya// dngos kun lha ru gnas pa dang*// ji ltar gnas bzhin mthong zhes pa// rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos te// bum dbang bskur ba las shes bya// rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i tshe// phung po lnga po mi dmigs te// stong pa zhes pa rang gi lung*// mi dmigs pa ni gzung ba dang*// stong pa zhes pas 'dzin med bstan// stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ zhes sogs// gzung 'dzin gnyis po bkag shul du// lhag mar lus pa'i de bzhin nyid// ye shes ngo bor gnas de'o// 'di ni dam pa'i don gyi lha// dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /de las mi skyod pa zhes sogs// kun rdzob rnam shes yul gyi lha// de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa ni// ji srid ma shes de srid du// gnas tshul dang ni snang tshul gyi// lha gang yin pa mi shes so// lha kun sgrub gzhi de bzhin nyid// gcig pur nges na lha so so// 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na// sbyang gzhi mang po'i dbang du byas// phung khams skye mched so so yi// chos nyid lha rnams su bskyed nas// bsgom tshe chos can so so yi// gzung 'dzin gnyis po zhi bar 'gyur// 'di la lha rnams so so yi// dag pa zhes ni mngon par brjod// dper na chags sogs nyon mongs kyi// gzung 'dzin gnyis med rig tsam ste// lhar bskyed pas ni nyon mongs kun// ngo bo nyid kyis zhi bar 'gyur// kun rdzob ngo bo lhar shes pas// gzung 'dzin gdod nas med par go

/ye shes gdod nas grub pa nyid// dam pa'i don du shes par nus// ji srid gzung bar zhen yod pa// de srid lhar ni mi 'char te// ji srid mir ni zhen yod pa// de srid mtho yor du mi 'char// ji srid gzung bar snang yod pa// de srid lha ru mi 'char te// dper na mtho yor du snang ba// de srid mi yi snang mi 'char// ma dag snod kyi 'jig rten yang*// rang gi ngo bos mi stong bar// zhen pa yod pa de srid du// gzhal yas khang du 'char mi srid// 'char na 'gal la mi 'khrul 'gyur// mdor na chos su snang tsam las// ma gtogs chos gzhan med zhes pa// de ni kun tu btags pa la// gzhan gyi dbang gis rgyas gdab zer// rnam rig de nyid gzung 'dzin gyi// dri mas dben par nam go ba// de ni gzhan gyi dbang nyid la// yongs su grub pa'i rgyas gdab zer// yongs su grub pa gcig pu nyid// sbyang gzhi so so dang 'brel ba// de la dngos kun gang dang gang*// rang gi lhag pa'i lha zhes brjod// dag pa dang po don dam ste// gnyis pa bskyed rim rtog pa'i yul// de yang dag pa gsum pa yis// sbyangs pas ye shes nyid du grub// rang rig dag pa zhes bya ba// rdzogs rim ye shes bde ba che// rang bzhin lhan skyes bde ba gang*// thabs kyis mngon du gyur pa'i tshe// mi 'gyur bde ba chen po ste// gnas tshul rdzogs rim ye shes dang*// snang tshul rdzogs rim lha zhes pa// gnyis ka'ang ye shes nyid kyi phyir// dam pa'i don gyi bden par bzhag /'di yang bya spyod rnal 'byor du// snang ba lha ru gsungs pa med// ces pa'i don gang bshad pa ste// grub mtha' dang po gsum dang bstun// rnam dag ces pa gzung 'dzin gnyis// rnam par dag pa'i dbang byas par// mi shes pa yi gsang sngags pa// rnams kyi dogs pa sel phyir du// sems dpa' bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi// zhal ngor sbyar bas dag pa dang*// ye shes tshogs sog la mkhas shog/

//maṅga laṃ// // ༄// rdo rje 'chang la phyag byas nas// rang gzhan rmongs pa sel don du// rgyud dang man ngag las byung ba'i// 'khor 'das dbyer med bsam par bya// dbyer med ces pa zung 'jug ste// de yang gnyis su med pa'i don// don de gnyis su med pa dang*// gcig yod pa la 'chad tshul lo// dang po pha rol phyin pa las// gnyis pa rdo rje theg par 'byung*// gcig pu de yang gang zhe na// rang bzhin mya ngan 'das par bshad// des ni shes bya kun la khyab// de las logs na 'khor ba med// ci phyir zhe na 'khor ba ni// kun rdzob tsam du bden phyir dang*// mya ngan 'das pa dus kun tu// don dam bden par 'chad phyir ro// myang 'das bden pa ma yin te// chos kun yod min phyir zhe na// 'di la 'gal ba yod min te// chos 'khor bar mtha'i khyad par las// rigs pas sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*// sgom pas myong bya'i dbang du byas// mya ngan 'das pa bden pa'i phyir// der 'dzin spong mi nus she na// mya ngan 'das pa yongs grub dang*// der 'dzin yang dag min rtog phyir// 'dzin pa kun btags spong ba yi// gnyen po yongs grub nyid du 'chad// ji srid 'khor bar 'dzin yod pa// de srid 'khor 'das dbye ba yod// ci phyir zhe na 'khrul snang kun// bden pa nyid du zhen phyir ro// mdor na 'khor 'das gnyis ka la// mtshan gzhi gcig las bshad pa med// gcig pu de yang gang zhe na// bde stong zung du 'jug pa'o// e waṃ 'khor ba zhes bya ste// e waṃ mya ngan 'das par bshad// dri mar bcas pa'i chos kyi dbyings// don dam pa yi sems can dang*// btags par yod pa'i gang zag la// kun rdzob sems can du bshad bzhin// las dang nyon mongs kyis sprul pa'i// ma dag snang ba kun rdzob kyi// 'khor bar bshad mod de'i rang bzhin// don dam 'khor ba nyid du bshad// snang tshul 'khor 'das dbyer yod dang*// gnas tshul 'khor 'das dbyer med las// 'chad pa'i tshe na snang tshul dang*// lta ba rtogs tshe gnas tshul sgom// 'khor 'das dbyer med 'chad po 'ga'// 'khor ba gang yin myang 'das dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'ang 'khor ba ste// snang ba thams cad lha yin zer// 'o na lha yang ma dag pa'i// snang bar thal te mya ngan 'das// 'khor ba nyid du 'chad phyir ro// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das yin yang*// myang 'das 'khor ba min zhe na// 'o na 'khor 'das dbyer yod du// thal bar 'gyur te gang gi phyir// gnyis po so sor nges phyir ro// mdor na 'khor 'das gnyis po la// gzhi mthun khas blangs bcas pa'i tshe// theg pa gsum gyi mya ngan 'das// 'khor pa nyid du khas blangs so// khyod la'ang de ltar thal zhe na// chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i// 'khor ba med par khas len gyi// dri mar bcas pa'i chos kyi dbyings// 'khor ba dngos su khas mi len// 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan tshang bas na// e waṃ 'khor ba zhes bya ste// zhes gsungs pa la bod skad du// 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste// 'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid// ces bsgyur snga ma btags ming dang*// phyi ma dngos kyi ming du bshad// gnod byed don dam yin phyir ro// khyad par rje btsun sa skya pas// dbyer med don bshad 'dir gsan bya// gsal ba zhes bya snang grags kun// sems las gzhan na med pa'o// sems las gzhan na don yod par// zhen na gsal ba de las gol// stong pa zhes pa gsal tsam de// 'khor ba'i chos kyis stong par bzhed// 'khrul snang las snang sems nyid du// zhen na stong pa de las gol// zung 'jug ces pa glo bur gyi// dri mas stong pa'i gsal tsam ste// gsal stong gnyis po phan tshun du// ya bral gyur na de las gol// gol bar gyur las 'khor ba dang*// ma gol myang 'das lhun gyis grub// snang ba sems las gzhan med na// gsal ba nyams su len pa shes// sems snang sgyu mar shes gyur na// stong pa nyams su longs par 'gyur// gsal stong brjod bral du goms pa// zung 'jug nyams su len pa'i thabs// gsal ba 'di la gsum 'byed mod// gtso cher 'khor ba'i chos ngos 'dzin// stong la rang bzhin glo bur dang*// rang stong gzhan stong med mod kyang*// 'khor ba'i chos kyis stong pa ste// mya ngan 'das pas stong mi bzhed// zung 'jug ces pa zung 'brel la// bshad na shin tu 'khrul 'gyur bas// stong pa'i ngos 'dzin gsal ba la// bshad pas zung 'jug dgongs pa 'grub// gsal ba zhes pa rang sems dang*// stong pa zhes pa bden stong dang*// zung 'jug ces pa bden pa gnyis// zung du 'brel la bshad pas nongs// 'khrul snang sems las gzhan med par// goms pas nyams kyi snang ba 'char// nyams snang sgyu mar goms pa las// dag pa'i snang ba 'char bar 'gyur// dag pa'i snang ba gang shar ba// zung 'jug ye shes nyid yin phyir// brjod bral don dam bden pa'o// mdor na sangs rgyas sems can dang*// mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba sogs// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos// kun la bden pa gnyis su phye// don dam ye shes yul gyi chos// thams cad dbyer med nyid du 'chad// kun rdzob rnam shes yul gyi chos// phal cher 'khrul ngor dbye ba yod// de ltar 'khor 'das dbyer med 'di// rtogs byed pha rol phyin pa dang*// gsang sngags lam gyi khyad par las// rtogs pa'i ye shes so sor skye// pha rol phyin pa'i thos bsam gyis// rtogs pa rjes dpag nyid du skye// de goms pa la mngon sum yang*// snang stong nam mkha' lta bu'am// gsal stong rig pa nyid du 'char// rdo rje theg pa'i thabs mkhas kyis// thog mar mngon sum nyid du skye// de la'ang dpe dang don gyi ni// dbye bas ye shes gnyis su bshad// rtogs pa bde stong zung 'jug ste// sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom par bshad// rang bzhin lhan skyes gcig nyid kyang*// rtogs byed thabs kyi khyad par gyis// rnam grangs rnam grangs min pa yi// don dam gnyis su 'byed pa'ang bshad// rdo rje theg par nyams myong gi

/nges don 'khor lo gsum pa yi// chos skad ji bzhin ma nor bar// 'chad mkhas rje btsun grags pa'i gzhung*// theg pa chen po'i tshul gnyis por// rigs pas sgro 'dogs chod pa'i tshul// ngo bo nyid med smra ba'i gzhung*// ji bzhin 'chad mkhas grags pa'i mtshan// dbu ma'i rig pa rang rang blos// gzhan du drangs nas gsang sngags kyi// nges don de lta'i lam nas ni// 'chad mdzad gzhan dang ma bsre shig /'di ni phyi rabs gsang sngags 'dzin// rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa// 'chad ces zer ba'i som nyi can// rnams kyi tshod dpag sel phyir du// rgyud 'grel man ngag la bltas nas// legs pa'i blo yis rigs par sbyar// lung sbyor gzhung bzhin bklags pas 'grub// dge bas rdo rje 'dzin thob shog/ //maṅga lambha wantu// // ༄// na maḥgu rā we/ rje btsun phyi ma'i gzhung 'dzugs par// khas len byed po'i mkhas pa 'ga'// kho bo cag gi rje bla mas// lam 'bras dbu zhabs dkrugs zhes zer// snang gsum thog mar rgyu dus kyi// dbang bskur mi mdzad pas dkrugs na// rje btsun chen po'i gzhung ji lta'i// khrid yig mdzad pa'ang der thal lo// skabs der dngos su ma bshad kyang*// don gyis thob pa yin zhe na// thog mar blo chos su 'gro ba'i// gdams ngag 'chad la dbang mi dgos// bla ma'i rnam gzhag bshad tsam gyis// dbang bskur sngon du 'gro dgos na// bla mar mchod brjod byas pa yi// gzhung lugs kun la der thal lo// de ltar gzhung gi go rim bzhin// gang zag gcig nyid dkri ba yi// khrid 'chad tshe na rgyu dus kyi// dbang bskur gang du bshad sa der// mdzad pas go rim 'khrugs 'gyur na// 'og tu bshad pa thams cad kyi// gong du bshad pas smos ci dgos// nyams snang rgyas par bshad zin pa'i// 'og tu bshad pas 'khrug 'gyur na// rdo rje'i tshig rkang de nyid kyis// shes byed de phyir der 'gyur ro// des na gzhung tshogs ji snyed kyis// las dang po zhig dkri ba'i tshe// nyams la spro ba skyed mdzad kyi// khrid kyi tshul du der mi 'chad// 'on kyang snang gsum gzhung tsam gyis// lam 'bras rdzogs par 'khrid nus pa'i// gang zag 'ga' la snang gsum gyi// skabs su dbang bskur don gyis thob// ci phyir zhe na nyams bco lnga// khrid kyi tshul du 'chad dgos shing*// bde bar gshegs pa'i bshad pa yang*// rang byin brlabs par 'chad phyir ro// 'di yang bshad pa tsam yin gyi// lag len khrid kyi tshul du ni// sus kyang bshad pa med pa'i phyir// dper na snang gsum khrid bor nas// rgyud gsum nyid nas bstan chog pa'i// rigs shig bshad kyang lag len du// byas na rang bzor 'gyur ba bzhin// sems skyed khrid rnams rdzogs pa'i 'og

/smon 'jug blangs pas dkrugs 'gyur na// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la// 'jug pa'i gzhung gis kyang der 'gyur// don dam byang chub sems sgom pa// sngags lugs yin phyir dbang dgos na// sngags las bshad pa'i don dam sems// mdo sde'i rgyan sogs las kyang 'byung*// la la ngo bo nyid med smra'i// don dam byang sems 'dir sgom zer// lugs 'di'i stong pa nyid la ni// don dam byang sems su mi 'chad// gzhung du rgyu dus dbang bskur gyi// thog mar 'khor 'das dbyer med bshad// rjes su bshad pas dkrugs 'gyur na// rgyud las kyang ni der thal te// dbang bskur nas ni de nyid bshad// ces dang phyi nas bshad par bya// zhes dang rje btsun nyid kyis kyang*// de ltar bshad pa yin phyir ro// chos rje bla mas lam dus kyi// rjes la 'khor 'das dbyer med bshad// rgyu lam gnyis kyi bar mtshams su// khyad kyis 'chad pas dkrugs she na// dbang bzhi po dang rim gnyis dang*// rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad la// dbyer med lta bas rgyas 'debs phyir// 'chad tshul kun kyang 'khrugs pa med// ngo bo nyid med smra ba yi// 'khor 'das dbyer med 'dir mi mkho// nam mkha' lta bur med dgag tu// ro gcig pa nyid der bshad phyir// med mi rung ba ma yin pa'i// sems bskyed sdom pa sogs 'chad pas// dkrugs na sngags kyi sdom pa'i rten// sems bskyed sdom pa dgos min nam// sa paṇa gyis mdzad de mi dgos// she na dbang gi chu bo yang*// rje btsun rtse mo man chad kyis// mdzad pa dgos de ci yi phyir// phyi yi bskyed rim goms rjes su// nang gi bskyed rim 'chad pa yi// thog mar lam dus dbang bskur ba// 'di yang dkrugs pa yin zhes zer// rje btsun chen po'i gsung las ni// 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// lus la ye shes pa bcug nas// lus dkyil sgom pa man ngag yin// zhes gsungs pa sogs shes byos la// gsung ngag rin chen 'chad pa dang*// nyan dang goms pa yod tsam mchog

/yin phyir phyogs su ltung mi 'tshal// ces pa 'di yang brag dkar ba// sems dpa' chen po'i zhal gyi ngor// sbyar bas phyogs 'dzin zhi gyur cig /ces 'di'ang 'dri po chos rgyal lo// //maṅga laṃ// // ༄// na maḥgu rā we/ lam 'bras pa phyi ma rnams kyi lta ba brtags pa'i rab tu byed pa/ kye ho/ ma dag snang ba 'khrul ngo'i chos su bshad// 'khrul ngo zhes pa med bzhin snang ba'i gsung*// yang dag kun rdzob yod smra'i lam 'bras pas// phyis byung chos kyi gtam dang ma bsres sam// gang snang sems su smra ba'i sgom chen pa// sngon byon rnams ni don snang rdzun par smra// phyi don yod smra'i phyis byung lam 'bras pas// snang tshad sems zhes brag char smra byed dam// phyi rol don yod ces pa theg chen pa// rang gi lugs su 'chad pa su yang med// phyi don khas len byed pa'i lam 'bras pas// gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan khas len byed min nam// lam 'bras lta ba thal rang dbu ma'i lugs// 'khor lo gsum pa sems tsam lugs so zhes// thag chod mgyogs par byed pa'i lam 'bras pas// zung 'jug lta ba gang nas ji ltar btsal// zung 'jug ces bya bden gnyis zung 'brel la// 'chad ces zer ba'i byis rnams mgu byed kyi// bsdus skad ngo sor byed pa'i lam 'bras pas// gong ma'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag chud gson tam// zung 'jug ces pa mnyam bzhag lta ba'i yul// mthar thug nyid du rje btsun snga mas bzhed// zung 'brel lta bar 'chad pa'i lam 'bras pas// mnyam rjes yul gyi ngos 'dzin ma nor ram// snang bzhin bden pas stong pa'i med dgag cha// dug can lta ba'i yul du gong mas bshad// thal rang lta ba smra ba'i lam 'bras pas// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid 'chad nus sam// thal rang gzhung na thos bsam ma gtogs pa// lta ba rtogs pa'i thabs gzhan bshad pa med// thal rang lta ba smra ba'i lam 'bras pas// dug can lta ba ngos 'dzin byed nus sam// btsal bas ma rnyed ci yang ma mthong la// de nyid mthong zhes thal rang gzhung du bshad// gzhung gzhan dngos smrar 'chad pa'i lam 'bras pas// rang rig dag pa gsal bar 'chad shes sam// las snang zhes pa med bzhin snang ba'i gtam// 'gro drug yul na rang snang yod do zhes// phyi don tshad grub smra ba'i lam 'bras pas// snang gsum dang po'i lta ba 'chad nus sam// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam dang rgyu 'bras sogs// bsam tshul go rim de ltar gsungs mod kyang*// 'khrid pa'i tshe na nges legs mngon mtho'i gtam// go rim bzlog nas 'chad dgos ma yin nam// rnal 'byor pa dang nyams snang zhes bya ba// gsang sngags khyad chos yin phyir dbang bskur la// nges par ltos shes zer ba'i lam 'bras pas// phar phyin theg pa'i nyams len 'chad shes sam// nyams snang mtha' dag kun rdzob bden no zhes// gzhan la khyad gsod byed pa'i lam 'bras pas// gong ma'i lung na byang chub chen po'i lam// ji skad bshad pa'i ngos 'dzin byed nus sam// byang chub lam la kun rdzob mi 'gal na// du sogs rtags bcu shar ba'i yul can blo// ma rig gis bslad shes par khas len nam// kun rdzob ces bya ma rig nyid phyir ro// gzhan dag nyams snang don dam bden no zhes// mtha' gcig kho nar smra ba'i lam 'bras pas// pha rol chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba yi// tshu rol shes pa yod par khas len tam// nyams snang khrid kyi skabs su gsang sngags kyi// thun mong min pa'i nyams rnams 'char dgos na// dag snang khrid kyi rnam bzhag 'chad skabs su// rdzogs sangs rgyas par khas len byed nus sam// rgyud gsum sgo nas bkri ba'i thog mar ni// bla mas 'khor 'das dbyer med ston ces gsungs// bum dbang kho na'i lta bar 'chad mdzad rnams// thog mar ston pa'i dgongs pa gang nas btsal// bum dbang sngon du song ba'i thog ma zhes// nges par 'chad na rje btsun gzhung dang 'gal// 'khor 'das dbyer med pha rol phyin gzhung na// mang phyir gsang sngags kho nar 'chad mi 'tshal// 'khor 'das dbyer med ces pa lta ba'i yul// de rtogs byed pa'i thabs mchog rnam gnyis gsungs// thos bsam rigs pas sgro 'dogs bcad pa dang*// dbang bskur cho gas nyams su myong ba'o// dang po thog mar rigs pa rnam gsum gyis// sgro 'dogs bcad nas brjod bral nyams myong bya// sems dang sgyu ma myong bya rnam gsum po// chos 'khor gsum pa'i dbang byas don dam cha// rten 'brel shes pa klu sgrub gzhung bzhin du// phal cher tha snyad bden pa'i dbang du byas// bum pa'i dbang las 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi// lta ba rtogs par rgyud dang man ngag las// gsal bar gsungs te sgro 'dogs ma chod kyang*// zung 'jug nyams su myong bar gdon mi za// de tshe sgro 'dogs chod par ma gyur na// rjes thob dus su rigs pa rnam gsum bsam// rigs pa'i dbang las sgro 'dogs chod zin na// rjes thob dus su nyams len gnad gsum gyis// dpe rnams dran nas lta ba'i rgyun chen po// dran dang shes bzhin stobs kyis bskyang bar bya// rigs pa ma gtogs bum pa'i dbang bskur tsam// lta ba rtogs byed min smra'i lam 'bras pas// dbang gong rnam gsum lta grub lhag ma drug

/rtogs byed yin zhes ne tso'i 'don pas smras// 'khor ba'i chos rnams tshad mas grub pa la// bden pas stong ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ces// 'chal gtam dbyangs su len pa'i lam 'bras pas// phyis byung chos kyi skad dang ma bsres sam// yod ma myong ba'i 'khor ba'i chos gsal ba// gzung 'dzin snang bas stong tshe mya ngan 'das// gsal dang stong pa tha dad ma yin pa// zung 'jug ces bya lta ba'i myong byar shes// ye shes rnam rtog dbang du song ba na// 'khor ba zhes bya 'khrul ba'i ngo na gsal// rnam rtog chos nyid dbang du song ba na// mya ngan 'das te 'khor ba dbyings su zhi// chags sogs dri ma'i chos rnams ye shes dang*// dbyer med yin zhes smra ba'i lam 'bras pas// dri ma sems kyi chos su khas blangs phyir// stobs sogs yon tan rnams dang 'bral rung 'gyur// rgyu rgyud mtshan gzhi kun gzhi'i rnam shes zhes// cha med dbyangs su len pa'i lam 'bras pas// 'khor ba rnams su nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe// rgyu rgyud chad cing 'thud par khas blangs so// phyogs su ma lhung myong tsam gsal rig ni// gdod nas grub pa'i chos dbyings ye shes te// kun gzhi rgyu rgyud 'di la 'khor 'das gnyis// tshang bar bzhugs kyang rmongs dang bral ba'i tshe// mya ngan 'das las ma gtogs 'khor ba'i cha// yod ma yin phyir gnyis su dbye ba med// rmongs pa'i tshe yang 'khor ba med bzhin snang*// 'khor ba'i chos nyid mya ngan 'das pa dang*// dbyer med pa la zung du 'jug pa dang*// kun gzhi rgyu rgyud e waṃ zhes bya ba// de nyid chos rnams kun gyi gnas lugs yin// snang gsum zin bris yi ger 'god pa pos// lhag mthong ngos 'dzin stong nyid nges blo zhes// 'chad pa 'di yang phyis byung rdol gtam ste// sngon byon bod kyi chen po kun dang 'gal// don dam byang sems sgom pa'i ngos 'dzin tu// thal rang lugs kyi stong nyid bsgom byar 'chad// mtha' bral stong nyid don dam byang sems su// 'chad pa'i gzhung lugs gang na'ang yod ma yin// rje btsun zhabs ni gsang ba 'dus pa yi// don dam byang sems shes bya glo bur gyi// dri ma rnams dang nges par 'bral rung ba'i// sems kyi rdo rje de la bzhed pa yin// zhes pa 'di yang brag dkar ba// byang chub sems dpa'i zhal gyi ngor// legs pa'i blo yis nyer sbyar ba'i// yi ge mkhan po chos rgyal lo// dge bas sangs rgyas myur thob shog/

//maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// sngags lugs kyi zab rgya'i gnad rnam par gtan la dbab pa rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa rab gsal chos tshan nyi shu rtsa gcig pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na maḥgu ru we/ yon tan kun rdzogs chos kyi sku// sgrib pa kun bral bde bar gshegs// zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan pa// khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon por 'dud// de nas byang chub phyogs mthun chos// bdun gyis lhag pa'i sum cu po// theg pa gsum dang gsang sngags kyi// lam gyi gzhung shing yin par gsungs// pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags kyi// so bdun spyi dang bye brag rnams// phal cher ming tsam mthun gyur kyang*// don gyi ngos 'dzin khyad par che// gsang sngags lugs kyi so bdun du// pha rol phyin pa'i so bdun gyi// don 'dus cig shos der mi 'du// ci phyir zhe na lugs gnyis kyi// lam gyi byang phyogs so bdun la// mchog dman yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis// 'bras la khyad par bshad phyir ro// de nas cung zad phye bshad pa// theg pa dman pa'i slob lam ni// byang phyogs so bdun gyis mthar phyin// lhag med dus su de mi bzhed// theg pa chen po'i slob lam dang*// mi gnas pa yi myang 'das kyi// gnas skabs kun tu so bdun po// tshang bar bzhugs zhes 'chad pa yin// phyogs mthun sde tshan dang po gsum// tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum dang*// dbang po dang ni stobs kyi sde// sbyor lam gnyis tshan gnyis po la// 'jog par mngon pa gong 'og mthun// mngon pa 'og mar mthong ba'i lam// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po dang*// byang chub yan lag sgom lam du// 'chad mod gong mar de las log /mdo sde'i brgyan du byang chub kyi// phyogs mthun sum cu so bdun po// thams cad mthong ba'i lam nyid dang*// lhan cig 'thob ces bshad pa'ang yod// phar phyin theg par so bdun po// thams cad mnyam par bzhag pa dang*// sgom byung nyid du 'chad pa ste// rjes thob phyogs la de mi gsal// sngags lugs byang phyogs so bdun la// skyed rim phyogs dang mthun pa dang*// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i dbang byas pa// rnam pa gnyis su bshad dgos so// dang po la yang rten dang ni// brten pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// rten ni gzhal yas khang nyid de// de yang ye shes snang ba dang*// khyad par byang phyogs so bdun zhes// thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las gsungs// brten pa rnal 'byor ma so bdun// byang chub phyogs mthun so bdun po'i// ngo bo nyid du rnam dag ces// 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos skor las// gsungs te phyi nang gzhan gsum po// sbyor tshul lung gis dpyad pa na// phyi na yul chen so bdun dang*// nang du rtsa khams sum cu bdun// gzhan ni rnal 'byor ma so bdun// sbyong byed mkha' 'gro so bdun gyis// phyi nang so bdun phrag gnyis po// sbyangs pas glo bur dri ma las// rnam grol 'khor lo sdom pa yi// lha tshogs drug bcu re gnyis po// mngon gyur dpa' bo nyer lnga po// rang rang gnas kyi rnal 'byor ma// rnams dang gnyis su med par bshad// phyi yi so bdun bshad dka' zhing*// nang gi so bdun gang zhe na// pu li ra ma la sogs pa// nyi shu rtsa bzhi po dag dang*// sgo mtshams ma yi sbyang gzhi brgyad// gzhung nas gsal bar gsungs pa dang*// bde chen lha lnga'i rtsa lnga po// gzhung du gsal bar ma gsungs kyang*// don gyis 'thob pas sbas pa yi// rtsa lnga zhes bya'i tha snyad mdzad// phyi rol so bdun nyer bzhi dang*// de yi dbye gzhi bcu gnyis po// sbyar bas sum cu rtsa drug dang*// gtso bo'i gnas dang so bdun no// gzhung 'dir byang phyogs so bdun po// sa bcu nyid dang sbyor mdzad kyi// 'jig rten pa yi lam gnyis dang*// dpe med ye shes chen po dang*// sbyor ba'i bshad pa ma mdzad mod// bde chen lha lnga 'thung spyod dang*// nye ba'i 'thung gcod du sbyar nas// dpe med ye shes chen po'i sar// rje btsun grags pa'i zhabs kyis sbyar// gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa yi// byang phyogs so bdun zhes bya ba// 'khor lo sdom pa'i gzhung nyid du// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs kyi// rtsa khams de dang de dag la// gnad du bsnun pa'i rnal 'byor gyi// tha snyad gsal bar ma gsungs kyang*// rdzogs rim byang phyogs so bdun po// bde blag nyid du 'grub par 'gyur// khyad par lam 'bras gzhung bshad du// lam lnga dang ni sa bcu dang*// byang chub phyogs dang mthun chos rnams// phar phyin theg pa'i lung dag dang*// sgo bstun mdzad nas 'chad pa yi// skabs su legs par bshad pa yin// sgo bstun dgos pa ci zhe na// pha rol phyin pa pa dag ni// nged kyi lung dang mi mthun phyir// sngags la thar pa med bsam pa// de zlog phyir du lam lnga dang*// sa bcu dag dang byang chub kyi// phyogs mthun sum cu rtsa bdun yang*// 'dir yang yod ces bshad pa yin// tha snyad mthun kyang don rnams ni// ji bzhin mthun pa ma yin te// pha rol phyin pa'i sa bcu dang*// sngags kyi sa bcu mi mthun bzhin// de la dgongs nas lam 'bras su// lnga bcu la ni gsang zhes gsungs// de don pha rol phyin pa yi// lam lnga sa bcu pa la bshad// de nas cung zad phye bshad pa// rdzogs rim byang phyogs dang po gsum// khams 'dus gsum dang go rim bzhin// sbyar nas 'jig rten lam du bshad// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ting 'dzin dang*// dran pa nyer bzhag lhag mthong dang*// yang dag spong ba zung 'jug nyid// yin phyir go rim de lta'o// snang stong lam du mi 'gyur ba// de la snang stong dgrar langs dang*// de yi gnyen po zhi lhag gnyis// rnam par rtog dang 'dres spong phyir// de nas phyogs mthun lhag ma rnams// 'jig rten 'das pa'i lam dang sbyor// de yang bum dbang sa drug gi

/rtogs pa byang chub yan lag bdun// 'di yang gtso bor lta ba yi// cha nas yin zhing gsang dbang gi /sa bzhi'i rtogs pa dad pa sogs// dbang po lnga dang sbyor bar bshad// shes rab ye shes sa gnyis kyi// rtogs pa stobs lnga dag dang sbyar// bzhi pa'i sa phyed 'phags pa'i lam// yan lag brgyad dang sbyor bar gsungs// lam 'bras byang chub phyogs mthun gyi// go rim gzhan nas bshad pa dang*// mi mthun dgongs pa ci zhe na// rdzogs rim gyis zhes bshad zin mod// gzhan la'ang gcig tu nges med de// lū yi pa yi mngon rtogs su// 'bras bu'i mthar thug bde chen lha// dran pa nyer gzhag dag dang sbyar// phyogs mthun kun gyi tha mar ni// yang dag spong ba bzhi zhes bshad// phyogs mthun so bdun 'jig rten pa'i// sa dang sbyar ba der mi snang*// des na byang chub phyogs mthun gyi// don dang go rim phar phyin gyi// theg par bshad bzhin ma nges te// lam lnga dang ni sa bcu bzhin// de yi 'thad pa 'di lta ste// phyi rol dbyibs kyi tshogs lam dang*// rnam rtog sngon song grong sogs dang*// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs// rab dga' dri ma med sogs dang*// sbyar yang de don gcig tu med// 'di tsam bshad pa de yis ni// chos kyi sgo mang rab phye nas// byang chub phyogs mthun mdo sngags kyi// bshad pa dag la rdeng thob shog /'di yang sems dpa' brag dkar bas// gsol ba btab pa'i ngor byas nas// legs pa'i blo yis nyer sbyar ba'i// yi ge pa ni chos rgyal lo// // ༄// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag byas nas// rdo rje 'chang dbang grags pa'i zhabs// rdo rje bdag med mar dad nas// rdo rje'i tshig gyur rtogs dka' bas// bstod par mdzad de 'dir bsam bya// bde mchog 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma// rnams dang mthun par bstod pa dang*// dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyi nang gi /sbyong byed ji bzhin bstod pa dang*// rang gzhung dgyes pa rdo rje yi// gzhung las bshad bzhin bstod pa dang*// rnam pa gsum ste rim bzhin dbye// bde chen lha mo ma gtogs pa'i// sku gsung thugs dang dam tshig gi

/'khor lor bkod pa'i lha mo ni// sum cu rtsa gnyis su bshad pa// kun rdzob byang chub sems 'bab pa'i// rtsa ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// phan tshun dag bya dag byed dang*// rnam dag ngo bo nyid du bshad// bdag med lha mo bco lnga yang*// byang chub sems bcas rtsa gnyis gnyis// dag pa'i ngo bo nyid yin phyir// bde mchog 'khor lo'i gzhung bzhin du// bstod par mdzad pa'i 'thad pa'o// phyi ma nyi ma'i khyim bcu gnyis// rlung gi 'pho ba bcu gnyis nang*// de yi sbyong byed gzhan lha mo// gsum gyis lhag pa'i bcu gnyis dang*// gsum po'i sbyang gzhi gsum bsnan nas// sbyong byed lha mo gsum la bstod// bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*// de nyid rnam pa bcu drug gi /sgo nas lha mo bco lnga la// bstod pa 'di yang shugs las grub// 'di ni phyi nang gzhan gsum du// sbyar nas bstod par mdzad pa'o// de nas rang gzhung ji bzhin du// bstod pa phyi na zla ba yi// 'phel 'grib cha ni bco lnga re// nang na lus la byang sems kyi// 'phel 'grib cha yang de bzhin te// de sbyong byed pa'i lha mo yang*// dbyangs yig bco lnga las 'khrungs ma// phyi nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor la// bkod pa ji bzhin bsam byas na// gsal ba rab kyi mthar phyin pa'i// tshe na lha mo bco lnga 'grub// de skad 'dir yang brag dkar ba// bsod nams mtshan can des bskul nas// gser mdog can gyi chos grwa nas// phul bas thugs dgongs rnam dag shog/ // ༄// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// rje btsun sa skya pa rnams ni// pha rol phyin pas grangs med gsum// pha mthar son kyang gsang sngags la// brten pa med na 'tshang mi rgya// sangs rgyas yin ngo shes pa ni// 'og min kho nar bzhugs pa yi// yan lag bdun ldan de la bzhed// phyi dus byon pa'i tsong kha pa// rjes 'brangs bcas rnams phar phyin gyi// theg pas brgyud sbyangs ma gyur na// gsang sngags brkyang pas 'tshang mi rgya// khyad par dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i// rigs pas dpyad pa'i stong pa nyid// ma shes pa dang ma goms na// sgrib kun gang gis sel zhes gsungs// phyi dus byon pa'i lam 'bras pa// bde 'thog med par smra ba 'ga'// snang gsum khrid kyis ma sbyangs na// brgyud gsum bsgom du mi rung zer// gsang sngags rnying ma pa 'ga' ni// bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa// bcu gnyis ma chags padma'i sa// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin zhes zer// sa skya pa yi bzhed pa la// kun tu 'od kyi sar gnas pa'i// sangs rgyas sngags kyi tshogs lam du// 'jug par bzhed pa yin zhes zer// 'dod pa phyi ma 'di gnyis ka

/de yi bzhed par mi rung ste// skal ldan cig char ba zhes pa// thog mar sngags la 'jug phyir dang*// kun tu 'od sa bcu gcig par// 'chad pa lugs der med phyir ro// phar phyin theg pa'i sa bcu yi// stod du dpe med ye shes che// rdo rje'i sa dang gsum snon pa// sngon byon mar lo'i bzhed par mthun// rdo rje'i sa la slob pa dang*// mi slob pa gnyis su 'byed pa// man ngag kho na'i lugs sam ni// rgyud sde'i khungs yod bsam par bya// dpe med ye shes chen po nyid// bcu pa'i sa las 'byed dgos kyi// sa lam logs pa min zhes pa// tsong kha pa chen lugs su bshad// 'o na gnyis po gsang sngags sam// phar phyin kho na'i sa par 'dod// dang po ltar na mi 'dod pa// khas len byed pa ma yin nam// gnyis pa ltar na phar phyin las// de lta'i sa gnyis bshad pa med// des na phar phyin la med pa'i// sa ni gnyis dang gsum bshad pa// med phyir de kun sa bcu pa'i// nang tshan nyid du bsdu mi nus// dus kyi 'khor lor mi 'gyur ba'i// bde ba nyi khri chig stong po// bcu gnyis sa yis rdzogs par bshad// bcu pa'i sar ni de mi 'du// 'di rnams sa ni bcu gnyis zhes// dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud du bshad// de yang gnas sogs bcu stengs su// 'thung gcod rnam pa gnyis bshad do// de la gzhan dag mos spyod dang*// kun tu 'od kyi sa gnyis zer// ku mu ti ru rgyud rgyas pa'i// lung drangs pa dang 'gal bar dogs// thal 'gyur gzhung gi stong pa nyid// sngags lugs bde ba chen po dang*// yul dang yul can du sbyor ba// tsong kha pa chen khyad chos te// sngon gyi chos las gsal ba med// phyi dus sa skya par 'dod pa// rnams ni lugs de 'bad pas mchod// sa skya'i rje btsun thos bsam gyi// lta ba dug can yin par bzhed// yul can rtog pa ma yin pas// de yul byed pa mi rung phyir// gsang sngags bla na med par ni// nyams su blang bya'i stong pa nyid// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa zhes// rgyud dang bstan bcos kun la grags// 'on kyang de yi ngos 'dzin lugs// ltar snang rnam pa gnyis 'chad kyang*// yang dag pa ni gcig nyid las// gzhan du 'chad par nus ma yin// ci phyir zhe na pad dkar gyis// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan brjod pa// dpang por byas nas chos dbyings kyi// ye shes nyid la der bshad do// chos dbyings med par dgag pa yi// yul can de la chos dbyings kyi// ye shes nyid du 'dogs so zhes// tsong kha pa chen de ltar bzhed// chos dbyings med dgag bde chen gyi// ye shes yul du byed gyur na// sgra don dngos su 'dzin pa'i phyir// rtog pa nyid du khas blangs so// rnal 'byor yan lag drug sgom pa// la la spro ba bskyed don du// du sogs mtshan ma don dam du// ngo sprod byed pa yod mod kyi// bsam gtan sa drug gang rung la// brten pa med pa'i rnam shes kyis// chos dbyings dngos su mthong gyur na// rgya chen mngon pa'i lung dang 'gal// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid// med par dgag la ngos 'dzin pa// tsong kha pa chen rjes 'jug lugs// lung rigs man ngag kun dang 'gal// rang gzhan grub mtha' so so ba'i// rang gzugs 'char zhes dngul dkar gyi// rang mdangs me long 'di ltos la// rang gzhung tshugs par smra byos shig

/rang gzhan grub mtha' shan 'byed pa'i// dngul dkar me long zhes bya ba// brag dkar sems dpa'i bkas bskul nas// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo yis sbyar// // ༄// swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag byas nas// lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi /dgongs pas lugs gzhan ma brten kyang*// lugs 'di kho nas 'tshang rgya ba'i// lam gyi rim pa kun tshang phyir// tshe 'dir rdo rje 'dzin 'dod pas// gzhung gzhan bslab sbyangs mi dgos shing*// man ngag gzhan gyis kha mi skong*// ci phyir zhe na lam lnga dang*// sa bcu dag gis ma bsdus pa'i// thabs gzhan btsal dgos ma yin zhing*// de yang 'di nyid na tshang phyir// pha rol phyin pas kha skong ba// cis kyang dgos pa ma yin te// 'di yi lam dang bcu gsum sa// thun mong min pa nyid phyir ro// de yi 'thad pa chos 'di ru// mos shing gus la 'di 'dri ste// 'dir 'byung tshogs lam nges 'byed kyi// thar par bgrod pa'i tshogs sbyor gyi// don go chod dam mi chod 'dod// chod na gzhan la ma rag ste// 'di nas bshad pa'i tshogs sbyor gyi// rnam bzhag mtshan nyid theg pa na// gcig kyang bshad pa med phyir ro// de phyir 'jig rten 'das pa yi// sa bcu dag la'ang sbyar bya ste// 'di nas bshad pa'i sa bcu yi// don dag de na med phyir ro// pha rol phyin la mi ltos kyang*// rgyud gzhan dag la ltos byas na// gzhan la 'chad pa 'dir mi gtso// 'khrid tshul 'dir bshad kho na yis// yon tan mngon du byed phyir ro// de la dgongs nas phar phyin gyi// lam lnga dag dang sa bcu pa// rnams la 'dir bshad lam lnga dang*// sa bcu'i rnam gzhag gsang zhes gsungs// don de thugs la nyer bzhag nas// lam 'bras chos skor ma lus pa// tshang ba'i glegs bam gcig bsdus nas// gzhan la ltos pa med par bshad// thog ma nyid nas gsang sngags kyi// snod du mi rung ba rnams la// phar phyin theg pa'i gzhung chen la// bslab sbyangs mang po dgos she na// lta spyod rim gyis 'jug dgos la// gzhung 'di nyid kyi 'khrid tshul gyis// dmigs rnam rkyang bas 'dir chog gi

/tha snyad mang po shes mi dgos// gzhung 'di bshad pa dang bcas pa// gang la ston pa'i gdul bya ni// gzhung 'dir thos dang bsam pa tsam// don du gnyer la ma yin gyi// 'dir 'byung don gyi sna cig kyang*// nyams su myong bar 'dod de yin// thos bsam sngon du ma song ba'i// sgom de yang dag min zhe na// gang bsgom bya ba'i dmigs rnam de// gzhan la thos nas dran pa la// nye bar bzhag nas goms byed pa// de la thos bsam sgom zer gyi// tshad ma sde bdun ma sbyangs par// lam 'bras sgom du mi 'dod dam// gal te gzhung gzhan mi dgos kyang*// rgyud gsum gsal po ma bshad na// lam 'bras sgom pa mi shes lo// sgom pas nyams su myong ba na// gzhung la nges pa rnyed 'gyur gyi// rgyud shes nas ni sgom dgos zhes// zer ba mang mod brtag par bya// de skad 'di yang lam 'bras la// gces spras byed lo mang po zhig /rang gi gzhung du gzhan dag la// ma grags pa rnams shes phyir yin// de yi dge bas chos 'di la// mos pa rnams kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung*// klog dang 'dzin dang kun chub par// mdzad la spro ba 'phel byed shog/ // ༄// swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// dpal ldan sa skya'i bla chen dang*// de la sdang ba gzhan dag gi /lta grub bsres pa spang bya'i phyir// phyi ma'i dus 'dir lam 'bras kyi// gzhung 'grel 'chad pa nges spro ba// dag la 'bel ba'i gtam 'ga' ni// byed la skyon yod ma yin no// de la lam 'bras lta ba ni// rtogs pa'i thabs gang yin pa 'dri// thos bsam rigs pa yin zer na// de 'dra 'di nas bshad pa med// ye shes phab dang dbang skur dang*// lus gnad bcings dang byin brlabs las// lta ba rtogs pa theg mchog gi /rtse mo'i khyad chos yin par bshad// 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel du// bshad ces zer na de don yang*// dbang las rtogs pa'i lta ba de// rjes la nyams su len tshul yin// de phyir de la nyams len gyi// gnad ces grags pa'i zhabs kyis bshad// gnyis pa lta ba'i ngos 'dzin 'dri// 'khor 'das dbyer med yin zer na/

de dbyer med pa gang la bya// 'khor ba bden stong la zer na// lam 'bras skor nas de ma bstan// de la gnod byed mang du bshad// de 'dra thos bsam rigs pa yis// dpyad pa'i stong pa nyid du bshad// 'khor ba gang yin mya ngan las// 'das pa de don yin zer na// lam 'bras lugs la 'khor ba ni// don dam bden pa nyid 'gyur te// rtogs byed lta ba'i yul dang ni// mya ngan 'das par 'chad phyir ro// 'khor ba spros bral yin pa la// bsams nas de der 'chad ce na// 'khor ba spros dang bral ba nyid// mya ngan 'das pa dngos yin kyang*// de yi spros bral de yin par// 'chad po su yang yod ma yin// 'khor ba phung sogs lnga po ni// rgyal ba rigs lnga yin pa'i phyir// 'khor 'das dbyer med gsang sngags kyi// khyad chos yin par 'chad ce na// 'khor 'das dbyer med chos kun gyi// gnas lugs yin phyir khyad chos min// 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs pa yi// thabs mkhas sngags kyi zab chos so// 'khor ba kun rdzob bden pa nyid// gdod nas yod ma myong ba la// mya ngan 'das pa zhes su bshad// des na 'khor dang myang 'das dang*// dbyer med ces bya rnam gsum po'i// rnam dbye so sor phyed byas nas// dbyer med zung 'jug tu shes byos// dri ba gsum pa snang stong dang*// gsal stong bde stong zung 'jug gi /bshad pa mang po byed byed pa// de don gang yin gsal bar smros// snang ba la sogs chos can rnams// tshad mas grub cing bden pas stong*// snang stong zung du 'brel ba ni// zung du 'jug pa'i don yin zer// snang ba bden pas stong pa yi// yul can rtog pa las gzhan med// dug dang bcas pa'i rtog pa ni// lta bar bzung ba ma yin no// zung du 'brel ba gnyis bcas kyi// don yin gnyis med don min pa// de phyir zung 'jug du mi rung*// mdor na chos can tshad grub kyi// steng du tshad mas ma grub pa'i// dgag bya bkag pa'i stong pa nyid// lta ba'i yul du 'chad pa ni// phyis 'byung grub mtha'i skad yin gyi// sa skya'i bla chen de mi bzhed// rnam 'grel kun dang 'gal phyir ro// dri ba bzhi pa snang gsum gyi// ma dag snang ba gang la zer// snang mkhan rang gi blo nyid dam// de der snang ba'i yul la 'dod// gang du 'dod kyang 'khrul pa yi// snang ba nyid du 'dod pa'i phyir// mngon sum yul bcas su mi rung*// de phyir 'khrul snang ji snyed pa// med na mngon sum la bsnyon zhes// 'chad pa 'di ni khyed cag gis// mi 'dod bzhin du khas longs shig

/ma dag snang ba 'khrul snang du// mi bzhed pas na kun rdzob kun// tshad mas grub pa yin zhe na// gzhung bshad kun dang 'gal bar nges// 'khrul snang thams cad sangs rgyas nyid// yin pas 'gal ba med ce na// rang bzhin rnam dag la dgongs nas// 'khrul snang kun gyi de bzhin nyid// brtags pa'i sangs rgyas su bshad kyi// blang byar bshad pa ma yin no// lnga pa kun gzhi rgyu rgyud ces// 'chad pa'i ngos 'dzin gang la byed// kun gzhi rnam shes la 'chad na// de 'dra chos nas bshad pa med// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs ni// kun la khyab cing rigs 'dra'i rgyun// chad mi srid pa'i ye shes la// rgyud du 'chad par lung kun mthun// spyir na ye shes 'gal zla dang*// khyad par tshe 'di re re zhing*// rgyun chad 'gyur ba'i rnam shes la// rgyud du 'chad pa su zhig byung*// kun gzhi'i ye shes zhes bya ba// chos las bshad pa med ce na// kun gzhi lta zhog sems dang ni// sems byung kun la rnam shes dang*// ye shes cha gnyis rnam dbye ba// theg chen chos rnams kun gyi lugs// kun gzhi'i steng gi gsal cha de// kun gzhir 'dod pa min zhe na// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das kun gyi// gnas su bshad do shes pa de// kun gzhi min par khyod kyis shod// rnam shes 'khor ba nyi tshe'i gnas// kun gzhi'i steng gi gsal cha la// zag pa med pa'i shes rgyud ces// bshad pa thos na khyed kyis kyang*// khas len dgos pa ma yin nam// skabs 'dir kha cig 'di snyam du// bde sogs bden pas stong pa de// bde stong zung 'jug don min na// bde sogs rtog pas stong pa de// zung 'jug don du 'chad byed na// 'di 'dra gzhan stong lugs yin phyir// lam 'bras lta bar mi bzung ste// sems tsam lugs las ma 'das zer// 'o na lam 'bras la sogs pa'i// chos lugs khung ma thams cad las// gzung 'dzin gnyis med ye shes zhes// bshad pa de dag khyod kyis spongs// khyod kyis 'dod pa'i stong nyid 'di// gzhan stong nang nas tha shal te// chos can tshad mas grub pa la// dgag bya gzhan zhig dgag phyir ro// 'o na chos 'dir rjes thob tu// tha snyad 'dogs pa'i dus kyi tshe// gnyis stong ye shes khas len na// spros bral min par 'gyur zhe na// pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las// lhag pa'i lta ba med bshad pa// mnyam gzhag dngos gzhi'i tshe yin gyi// rjes kyi tha snyad 'dogs pa'i tshe// lta grub dbye ba rnam brgyad bshad// de dag kun kyang spros bral las// lhag pa'i nyams myong lta bar bshad// zhar byung spros pa ci la zer// zhe na rang gzhan lugs gnyis po// yod na spros bral yin pas khyab// ces pa tsong kha pa yi lugs// chos 'di'i lugs la yod pa dang*// med na spros dang bral bar 'gal// rang lugs spros pa rnam gnyis te// yod med la sogs mtha' rnams dang*// stong dang mi stong la sogs par// 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog ji snyed pa'o// yul gyi spros pa 'gog pa la// dbu ma'i rigs pa zab gyur cing*// yul can 'dzin pa 'gog pa la// sngags kyi thabs mkhas khyad par 'phags// yul bkag pa las yul can gyi// 'dzin pa khegs pa dbu ma'i gzhung*// 'dzin pa bkag pas der snang ba// mtha' dag khegs pa sngags kyi lugs// des na chos 'di'i lta ba ni// rnam rtog khegs pa'i ye shes so// mdor na lam 'bras 'chad pa pos// yod na rten 'brel yin dgos dang*// rten 'brel yin na yod pa sogs// nam yang khas len mi bya'o// 'dzin pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// mnyam bzhag ye shes gcig nyid la// lta ba'i ngo bor shes byas nas// grub mtha' snyogs pa'i rim zhes bya// de skad 'di ni phyi dus kyi// lam 'bras 'chad po mang zhig dang*// 'bel ba'i gtam du byas pa'i tshe// rang gzhung ji bzhin ma bslab par// gzhan la grags pa'i dbu ma yi// 'chad lugs dag dang bsres nas ni// pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las// lhag pa'i lta ba med ces pa// khungs su byas nas skad kyi gzengs// mthon por smra ba 'ga' mthong nas// rang gzhan lta ba shan 'byed pa'i// tshig ler byas 'di dge gyur cig/

// ༄// swasti/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// 'jigs bral chos skyong zhabs kyi ni// rnam thar 'chad po phal che ba// mthun par sems tsam paṇḍi ta// dbu ma par gyur yin zhes 'chad// skabs de'i dbu ma gang yin brtag /klu sgrub gzhung bzhin yin snyam na// de la rnal 'byor spyod pa dang*// thal rang gzhung gi 'chad tshul gnyis// dang po ltar na kho bo cag /de yin khyed kyi de mi 'dod// gnyis pa ltar na su la brgyud// brgyud pa med par rtogs zhes na// de yis de ma rtogs par ni// zla ba grags pa nyid kyis bshad// rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lta ba yis// sa drug 'thob pa med snyam na// rje btsun byams pa'i gzhung lugs kyi// sa lam kun la skur ba btab// gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong pa'i// sa lam rim pa yin no zhes// tsong kha pa chen bzhed mod kyi// de 'dra chos nas bshad pa med// lam 'bras chos na thal rang gi /stong nyid rtogs pa'i yul can blo// dug can lta bar bshad pas na// sa drug pa la de mi dgos// rdo rje'i tshig rkang las gsungs pa'i// lta grub brgyad kyi nang na yang*// med par dgag pa'i yul can gyi// stong nyid lta ba 'di ma bshad// zla grags bzhed pa'i stong pa nyid// med na byang chub mi 'byung zhes// gzhan zer gya gyu'i rjes 'brang nas// rang gzhung gzhan la gtod mi bya// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnam rdzun las// gzhan pa'i dbu mar ma zhugs sam// zhe na rdo rje bdag med mas// byin brlabs sngags kyi dbu mar zhugs// sngags kyi dbu ma grub mtha' yi// dbye bar rung ba min zhe na// lam 'bras gzhung gi lta grub brgyad// grub mtha' bzhi po gang nas byung*// des na skal ldan cig char ba// ngo bo nyid med smra ba yi// grub mthar zhugs pa med gyur kyang*// dbang bzhi rim gyis bskur ba las// dbang bzhi po dang rjes mthun pa'i// lta ba rim gyis snyogs gyur nas// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa// tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur// 'di ni gzhan gzhung lung rigs kyi// mtha' chod 'dra ba mang mang pos// rang gzhung tshugs par mi smra ba// rnams kyi dran pa gso phyir bsngo//

// ༄// swasti/ smra mkhas ngag gi dbang phyug la// rab dang gus pas phyag byas nas// sems can dang ni sangs rgyas kyi// ngos 'dzin gsal po 'dir bshad bya// dus 'dir sngags dang pha rol du// phyin pa pa rnams phal che bas// sangs rgyas dang ni sems can gyi// ngos 'dzin gsal po ma smras pas// pha rol phyin pa'i sems bskyed dang*// bsngo ba dang ni smon lam dang*// lha bskyed pa dang sgom pa yi// tshul la rdeng thob ma gyur to// gnyis po'i ngos 'dzin don dam dang*// kun rdzob btags pa'i yod nyid do// btags yod ces pa phung po la// brten nas btags pa'i nga tsam ste// gzhan sel tsam las gzhan med pas// gnyis po'i mtshan gzhi dngos ma yin// chos dbyings 'chad tshul rnam gnyis te// med par dgag pa'i stong nyid dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// med par dgag pa sems can dang*// sangs rgyas mtshan gzhir rung ba med// dri bcas chos dbyings ye shes ni// don dam pa yi sems can dang*// bde gshegs snying po'i khams dang ni// rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes su bshad// nyes pa kun las rnam grol zhing*// yon tan kun dang dbyer med pa'i// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni// don dam pa yi sangs rgyas so// don dam sems can gang yin pa// glo bur dri ma las grol tshe// sangs rgyas pa dang gnas gyur pa// mthar thug zhes ni brjod pa yin// bdag ni sangs rgyas nyid gyur ces// smon par byed pa'i bdag de dang*// smon pa'i yul gyi sangs rgyas kyang*// chos kyi dbyings las gzhan ma yin// ma rtags gcig pur nyams dga' ba'i// tshe na kun rdzob sems can de// kun rdzob gzugs sku'i sangs rgyas su// smon lam 'debs pa lta bur snang*// 'di la zhen pas 'jug pa zer// de ltar zhugs kyang don dam pa'i// sems can de nyid der 'gyur gyi// kun rdzob sems can der mi 'gyur// de yi 'thad pa ci zhe na// kun rdzob sems can sangs rgyas gnyis// rgyun gcig pa ni min phyir dang*// btags yod tsam las ma 'das pa// dngos por med pa nyid phyir ro// bsags pa'i dge ba byang chub tu// bsngo ba'i don gang ci zhe na// bsags pa'i dge ba chos dbyings dang*// ngo bo dbyer med nyid 'gyur phyir// chos dbyings rnam sangs rgyas pa'i tshe// bsags pa'i dge ba gzhan snang du// gzugs sku 'grub pa'i rgyu yin phyir// gzugs sku'i rigs 'dra sngon dus kyi// gang zag de la byed pa ni// nga nyid de tshe de yi dus// de 'dra zhig tu 'gyur zhes dang*// 'di 'dra zhig tu 'gyur zhes pa// dam pa'i don gyur bdag yin gyi// kun rdzob zas gtsang sras po de// spyi bo skyes su ga la gyur// de yang der 'gyur ma yin mod// de ltar shes rgyud gcig pa la// bsams nas de lta bshad pa yin// shes rgyud ces pa dam pa'i bdag

/bshad ma thag pa der 'chad kyi// kun gzhi'i nyon yid 'jug shes la// 'chad pa nam yang yod ma yin// dud 'gro'i rnam shes tshogs brgyad po// rnam smin nyid phyir mtho ris kyi// skye ba blangs tshe'ang rgyun chad na// sangs rgyas sar 'gro de mi srid// lha skyed pa na mngon byang dang*// sa bon sogs skyed gang yin kyang*// btags yod gang zag mi dmigs par// byas nas dam pa'i don gyi bdag /de bzhin nyid du rdzogs sangs rgya// chos kyi dbyings su zhugs pa de// sems can don phyir bskul ba na// smon lam dbang gis gzugs kyi sku'i// snang ba sems can gzhan la ston// re shig 'di tsam kho na ste// 'di las mang por spro nus pa// rim gyis 'chad par 'gyur ba yang*// skal mnyam kun la phan byed shog/ // ༄// swasti/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag byas nas// rang gzhan rmongs pa gsal bar bya// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas su// mdo nas gsungs pa shin tu mang*// rgyud las dngos po thams cad ni// sangs rgyas nyid du bshad pa dang*// khyad par phung po lnga po nyid// rgyal ba rigs lngar bshad pa dang*// nyon mongs lnga po ye shes lngar// bshad la rtsod pa yod ma yin// ji bzhin sgra la mngon zhe na// don ma yin pa nyid 'gyur phyir// lung dang mthun pa'i rigs pa yis// rnam par brtags nas bshad par bya// sems can rang bzhin rnam dag gi /sangs rgyas yin la mi mthun med// rang bzhin rnam dag glo bur gyi// dri mas bsgribs par kun gyi 'chad// stobs sogs yon tan yod med pa// la la dag tu rtsod pa'i gzhi// yin mod yon tan yod gyur na// dam pa'i bdag de sangs rgyas dngos// yin phyir kun rdzob sems can kun// bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can// yin mod kun rdzob sems can kun// sangs rgyas dngos su mi 'chad pa// 'di yang bshad ma thag pa yi// bden gnyis dbye ba las rig bya// glo bur dri mas bsgribs gyur pas// sangs rgyas dngos su 'gal zhe na// dpe dgu dag dang sbyar ba yi// rigs pas ma nges ston par bshad// rang sems sangs rgyas yin gyur kyang*// gang zag btags yod de min pa// de gnyis 'brel ba med pa dang*// sangs rgyas sa yi dpe dang sbyor// chos dbyings las gzhan sems can ni// dngos por yod min de bzhin du// chos kyi dbyings las ma rtogs pa'i// kun rdzob chos gzhan yod ma yin// don dam ye shes sangs rgyas tshe// kun rdzob sems can lus pa med// de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyi// chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe kun rdzob kyi// chos gzhan shul du lus pa med// bems chos kun gyi chos dbyings de// ye shes nyid du 'gal zhe na// mi 'gal 'thad pa 'di ltar bzung*// der snang sems las ma gtogs pa'i// yul gzhan yod pa min zhes 'di// theg chen spyi yi grub pa'i mtha'// dper na gzugs su snang ba yi// rnam rig ma gtogs gzugs gzhan med// rnam rig gzugs gzhan gyis stong pa// don dam pa yi gzugs su bshad// gzugs de rang bzhin rnam dag gi

/lhag pa'i lhar ni gdod ma nas// gnas pa ji bzhin gsal thebs na// gzugs snang bag chags 'gag par 'gyur// de bzhin a sogs gzung 'dzin gyis// stong pa don dam yi ge dang*// gti mug gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa'i// ye shes gti mug chen po dang*// chags sdang ngo bo rang rig cing*// rang gsal ba de chags chen dang*// zhe sdang chen por bshad pa yin// de ltar bden pa gnyis kyi ni// rnam dbye phyed
