//shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag byas nas// 'bras bu'i dus kyi dus 'khor ni// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang bzhi dang*// rdzogs rim rnal 'byor yan lag drug /bsgom pa kho nas 'grub ces pa// rgyud dang 'grel pa'i dngos bstan no// 'di yi 'thad pa 'pho ba yi// bag chags sa bon bcas pa ni// spong byed gnyen po bde ba dang*// stong pa zung du 'jug pa las// gzhan med pa yi phyir zhes pa// yin mod bsod nams tshogs chen po// gang gis rdzogs dang gang zag gi /bdag tu 'dzin pa su zhig gis// spong zhes dri ba'i lan rnams ni// mkhas pas ring du bsam bya ba// de tshe bskyed pa'i rim pa yi// dbang dang dam tshig sdom pa rnams// tshul bzhin bsrungs pa'i bsod nams dang*// kun rdzob 'dus byas chos rnams ni// rang stong nyid du goms byas tshe// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par// gzugs sku'i rnam rol rgyun mi 'chad// 'o na rnam brtags stong pa nyid// sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i lam min par// bshad pa ci la dgongs zhe na// lam dang yon tan skye ba'i rten// min kyang chos dang gang zag tu// rmongs pa sel ba'i thabs chen po// bsod nams bsags pa las byung ba'i// gzhan don gzugs kyi sku de ni// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa dngos min phyir// gang gis bsod nams tshogs de dag /rdzogs par byed po gdul bya nyid// bsod nams nyid yin sangs rgyas kyi// chos kyi sku ni bde ba dang*// stong pa zung du 'jug pas 'grub// bskyed rdzogs zung du ma 'brel bas// sngags kyi sangs rgyas mi 'grub ces// zer ba gsang sngags pa gzhan gyi// lugs yin gzhung 'dir phar phyin pa'i// byang chub sems dang gang zag gi /bdag med sngon du nges byas nas// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang bzhi dang*// rnal 'byor yan lag drug goms pas// dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phangs 'grub// zer ba lugs 'di'i bsgom chen pa// mang po'i 'dod pa yin no kyai//

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag byas nas// chos 'di'i gzhung na gang zag gis// 'dzag pa'i bde ba ma bsrungs pa// 'khor ba pa nyid kho nar bshad// de la gzhan gyis rgol ba na// dge slong 'char kas tshe de la// dgra bcom 'bras bu mngon gyur dang*// sa 'thob 'phags pa 'khor lo yis// rgyal por gyur pas gnod ces zer// lung gi dgongs pa yan lag drug /goms par byed pos lo gsum dang*// phyogs gsum bar der 'dzag pa yi// bde ba mngon du gyur srid na// dus der 'gyur med bde ba ni// stong dang brgyad brgyas sa dang po// mngon du byed pa mi srid ces// 'chad pa yin gyi gzhan min no// dgra bcom pa la de med kyang*// sa thob pa la de srid pa// 'khor bar skyes kyang 'khor ba yi// skyon gyis ma gos pa de nyid// 'dzag bde can la mngon shes lnga// med par bshad pa so skye dang*// dman pa'i slob pa la 'chad kyi// ci phyir zhe na de la ni// 'dod la chags bral dgos phyir dang*// sa thob nas ni nyon mongs pa// de yi skyon dang ma 'dres phyir// de bzhin khyim pa'i rdo rje 'dzin// med par 'gal zhes rtsod pa yang*// 'jug pa min te sa thob pa'i// 'phags la dgos pa med phyir dang*// 'phags min rdo rje 'dzin pas kyang*// lha dang chos dang sngags shes pa'i// 'du shes gsum gyis 'jug pa'i phyir// gzhan du dbang bskur bzhi pa yi// dus de nyid nas rtsa ltung 'gyur// dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsgrub pa po// byang chub sems dpas gzhan don du// srid par skye ba len pa dang*// gzhan don bsgrub pa'i grogs gyur pa'i// nyon mongs mi spong bar yang bshad// nyon mongs byang chub lam khyer ba'i// thabs chen ldan la dogs pa med// 'on kyang so so skye bo yi// dge slong sngags pas gnas 'di la// bag yod gyur pas 'dul ba yi// cho ga bzhin du bsrung bar bya//

// ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// skyes bu tshe lo brgya pa dang*// dbang po brgya pa zhes bshad pa'i// don de tshul bzhin bsam bya ba// 'byung 'jug gnas gsum tshang nges pa'i// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung*// lhag chad med par rgyu tshang ba// nyin zhag gcig gi tshad dang ni// de nas bsgres pa'i lo brgya ni// tshang ba tshe lo brgya pa'i tshad// de ltar rgyu ba'i rlung re la// zhag re bzhin yang las rlung dang*// dbu ma'i rlung de gnyis su dbye// las rlung dkyil 'khor lnga po ni// g.yas g.yon re re nas rgyu ba// dbu ma'i rlung ni gnyis ka nas// mnyam du rgyu ba de yin pa// de tshe mnyam du rgyu ba na// phung khams zad par byed pa ste// re re'i rgyu bas ma dag pa'i// phung khams bskyed par byed pa'o// zhag re bzhin yang bskyed byed kyi// rgyu ba du dang zad byed kyi// rgyu ba du zhig 'byung zhe na// nyin re re'i 'pho chen gyi// 'tshams su nga drug rkang bcas re// mnyam du rgyu bar nges bshad pa// de tshe zhag ni re re bzhin// dbu ma'i rgyu ba drug brgya dang*// bdun cu rtsa gnyis re byung bas// zhag re bzhin yang g.yas g.yon gyi// rgyu ba'i steng nas de tsam chad// dbu ma'i rgyu ba nyi khri dang*// chig stong drug brgyar longs pa na// g.yas g.yon rgyu ba'i rlung rnams kyi// steng nas de tsam zhig chad pas// zla ba'i 'phel 'grib cha re la// las rlung nyi khri chig stong dang*// drug brgya tshang bar ma dgos pas// tshes zhag gcig la yud tsam ni// phyed dang sum cus chog pa byung*// nyi ma'i zhag gcig longs pa la// dbu ma'i rgyu ba dang bcas pa'i// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung*// thams cad tshang bar rgyu dgos pas// tshes zhag sum cu so gsum na// nyin zhag so gnyis las ma byung*// de phyir tshes lo so gsum na// nyin lo so gnyis las ma byung*// bsgres pas tshes lo brgyar longs tshe// nyin lo go bdun lhag tsam byung*// skyes bu tshe lo brgya pa'i tshad// dbu ma'i rgyu ba ma byung na// nyin lo brgya yi tshad dag tu// ma longs bar du dus dang ni// dus min 'chi ba mi srid pa// yin mod zhag re bzhin du yang*// de byung bas na dus min dang*// dus kyi 'chi ba lo brgyar nges// de yi shes byed las kyi rlung*// rgyu ba'i steng nas de chad pas// zhag re bzhin yang rlung rgyu ba'i// rtsa gnyis skam par gyur pa yin// de phyir dbu ma'i rgyu ba yis// lo gsum phyogs gsum longs pa'i tshe// g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi rtsa rnams la// las rlung rgyu ba med pa'o// de phyir 'khor ba'i tshe ring po// bsgrub par 'dod pas g.yas g.yon gyi// rgyu ba rang gi gnas su bsdams// 'khor ba spangs pa'i tshe ring po// bsgrub par 'dod pas g.yas g.yon gyi// rgyu ba dbu ma'i gnas su bsdams// bum pa grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas// dbu ma'i mnyam rgyu rgyun gcod nus// de tshe dus dang dus min gyi// 'chi bas gnod par nus ma yin// de skad 'di yang brag dkar ba// byang chub sems dpa'i ngor byas nas// legs pa'i blo yis sbyar ba yis// kun kyang skal ba bzang por shog/

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu yi// dus kyi 'khor lo mtha' dag la// khyab byed 'jug pa'i dus 'khor ni// e waṃ yin no de'i rang bzhin// sgra dang rtog pa'i yul min phyir// rigs pas gzhom du med pa dang*// so so rang rig ye shes kyi// myong bya nyid dang rgyud kun la// nges pa ster phyir de'i gleng gzhi// rang bzhin gyis ni rnam dag phyir// zag med bde ba chen po ni// rtag tu phyag rgya chen mo yi// rjes zhugs phyir na zung du 'jug /'di la thog ma yod min zhing*// nam yang zad pa med pa'i phyir// skye 'jig mtha' dbus dang bral bas// rgyun gyi rtag pa nyid dang ni// ye shes nyid phyir skad cig tu// mi gnas phyir na dngos por med// e waṃ nyid las ma gtogs pa'i// shes bya gang yang yod min cing*// 'di nyid kho na sangs rgyas kyi// yon tan rnams kyi rgyu dang rten// de de kho na don dam bden// de las gzhan chos kun rdzob bo// sngags kyi grub pa'i mthar zhugs pa// la la dag ni de de la// yod dang bden par 'dzin pa yi// rnam par rtog pas de la bsgribs// rnam par rtog pa kun bral ba'i// ye shes gcig pus de nyid mthong*// mthong byed nyid kyang e waṃ ste// de las gzhan na de yod min// kun rdzob bden kun rang rang gi /ngo bos stong phyir yod min mod// don dam bden gcig rang ngo bos// stong pa min mod mtha' bzhi po// gang du bzung kyang de la sgrib// e waṃ rtog brjod kun bral ba// goms byed yan lag kun tshang bar// goms pa'i rim pas 'pho ba yi// bag chags ma lus byang gyur pa// de tshe 'bras bu'i dus 'khor lo// mngon du gyur pa zhes bya'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// e waṃ brjod bral byis blo la// 'char tshul ji lta bu zhe na// stong pa chen po yig lnga dang*// thig le stong pa yig drug po// 'dus pa'i rang bzhin e waṃ ste// dbyangs kun 'dus pa waṃ dang ni// gsal byed 'dus pa e yin no// dbyangs gsal gnyis ka'ang 'gyur med cing*// brjod byas min par 'jam dpal gyi// mtshan ni yang dag brjod las gsungs// 'di ni don dam yi ge yi// dbang byas kun rdzob yi ge ni// rtog pa dag la der snang dang*// rna ba'i dbang por grags pa'i sgra// de phyir e waṃ yi ge yang*// bden gnyis sbyar nas bshad bya ba// waṃ ni khu rdul zung du 'jug

/khu ba bde ba chen po dang*// rdul ni stong pa nyid kyi gzugs// thog mar aḥdang aṃ bzhag la// rnam bcad a yig bar du u// u ni pha rol gzhan mthong bas// wa rgyur 'gyur ba brda sprod lugs// gsal byed dbyangs med pha rol tu// drangs pas waṃ zhes bya ba grub// rnam bcad nga ro gnyis ka yang*// a la ma brten mi srid pas// a yi rang bzhin yi ge lngar// gdod ma nyid nas rnam shes dang*// ye shes ngo bor grub ces gsungs// rnam bcad dang ni nga ro yang*// gsal byed rnam 'gyur yin pa'i phyir// dbyangs gsal gnyis 'dus pa las grub// 'di la stong pa chen po'i sgras// bshad kyang rang rig gis myong phyir// rang stong ma yin rang rig gi /myong bya nyid la der bshad pa'o// thig le stong pa yig drug ni// gsal byed sde tshan rnam drug ste// 'di la'ang yi ge re re bzhin// rnam dpyad rjes su nga ro gnyis// sbyar bas bde stong zung du 'jug /'di'ang bsdu na ka sa gnyis// cig tu brtsegs pas yi ge gcig /yin te gsal byed ji snyed pa// ka sa'i bar na yod phyir ro// rgyas par phye na brgya lhag ste// gsal byed so sor dbyangs kyi ni// yi ge bcu gnyis 'jug pas so// thig le stong pa yi ge brgyar// gsungs pa de nyid la dgongs te// drug gi skad dod ṣa ṭa ni// brgya yi skad dod sha tar yang*// 'gyur ba skabs 'gar yod phyir ro// 'di yang sems dpa' brag dkar ba'i// zhal ngor sbyar te bkra shis so// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// bsgeg pa'i rdo rjes mtshan brjod kyi// gzhung 'grel sngags don rnams gzigs su// a ra pa tsa na zhes pa// stong pa chen po yig lnga dang*// wā gi shwa ri muṃ zhes pa// oṃ gyi thog mar brgyan pa ni// thig le stong pa yig drug tu// bshad do 'di yang don dam pa'i// 'jam dpal bsgrub pa'i gzhi dang ni// gnas tshul don dam 'gyur med pa// mtshon phyir sgra yi yi ger ni// rnam par rig la gang snang ba// de la yi ge zhes bshad do// 'jam dpal gyi ni mtshan brjod la// dus kyi 'khor lor bkral ba dang*// yo gar bkral ba rnam gnyis las// dang pos rtsa 'dab brgya dang ni// drug cu rtsa gnyis mtshon phyir du// tshigs su bcad pa de snyed la// nges don bshad pa lan gsum mdzad// 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan nas// ye shes sku nyid la 'dud bar// tshigs su bcad pa'ang de snyed de// de las gzhan rnams dus 'khor lo'i// rgyud kyi nges don khungs dang ni// dpang por mdzad pa yod ma yin// de phyir tshigs bcad de snyed la// 'jam dpal mtshan brjod ma tshang med// 'on kyang gong 'og sngags gnyis po// bzlas na byin rlabs che bar 'gyur// yo gar dkral ba'i lugs dag na// thog ma'i gsol gdab nas bzung ste// phan yon gong 'og sngags bcas la// tshigs bcad phyed dang sum brgya po// 'jam dpal mtshan brjod ces byar bsgrags// 'di'ang sems dpa' brag dkar bas// gsol gdab ngor byas bkra shis so//

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// dus kyi 'khor lo'i lta ba yi// mthar thug ngo bo nyid med du// gnas zhes gsungs pa mang na yang*// mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba// de nyid dbu ma pa yis rig /ces gsungs pa yi gong 'og kun// mi 'gal 'chad tshul 'di yin te// mthar thug phyag rgya chen mo ni// bsags pa'i ngo bor yod min zhing*// ri bong rwa ltar med pa'ang min// gnyis yin pa ni smos ci dgos// gnyis ka min par zhen pa'ang*// min phyir mtha' bzhi las ni grol// zhes pa gong 'og kun dang 'grig /yang na rnam shes gzhan gyi dbang*// yul dang bcas pa mtha' bzhi po// kun las grol ba sher phyin mdo// dgongs pa nges 'grel zhes bya ba'i// mdo yis bkral ba de yin no// ye shes snying po kun btus dang*// 'gal zhes zer ba byung gyur na// 'jigs med dpal ldan chos skyong gis// gzhung de rnam rig tsam du dkral// rnam par rig la zhe sdang na// rgyu sde kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur// 'di yang sems dpa' brag dkar pa'i// zhal ngor legs pa'i blo yis sbyar// // ༄༅// phyi nang gi sngags kyi nyams len so sor phye ba zab lam blang dor gsal byed chos tshan bcu gsum pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal ste// sangs rgyas pa dang phyi rol pa'i// sngags kyi nyams len khyad par la// sbyor dang dngos gzhi rjes yin no// sbyor ba ye shes tshogs sog pa// yod dang med las 'byed mod kyi// ye shes de yang gang zag gi /dbang byas gzung 'dzin gnyis med dang*// chos kyi dbang du byas pa las// chos 'ga' gzung 'dzin gnyis med pa// mu stegs byed pa rnams kyi'ang shes// dngos gzhi'i dus kyi dbang bskur tshe// ma dag phung po lnga po ni// dmigs pa med par byed pa dang*// bdag tu dmigs pa'i khyad par can// rdzogs rim dus su rang lus la// gnad du bsnun byed mu stegs la'ang*// yod pas de tshe 'dzin med kyi// rang rig ngang gi skye srid mod// bdag tu bzung bya mi dmigs pa'i// shes pa ngang gi mi skye phyir// gzung 'dzin gnyis med der mi srid// rjes kyi khyad par mnyam bzhag gi

/myong bya rang rig rang gsal ba// bdag tu dogs pa 'gog byed pa'i// rigs pa bsam dang mi bsam pa// sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs pa'i// 'khor bar mngon mtho'i rgyur gyur pa'i// bsod nams tshogs sog khyad par yang*// bdag tu zhen pa yod med de// sangs rgyas chos kyi bkar btags pa'i// phyag rgya bzhi la zhugs pa na// sangs rgyas pa yi ming thob la// der ma zhugs na de las gzhan// de phyir mu stegs bsod nams tshogs// thar pa'i lam du 'gro mi srid// bdag med rtogs blo med gyur kyang*// bdag lta'i grub mthar ma zhugs pa'i// bsod nams tshogs de thar pa yi// lam du 'gyur la 'gal ba med// bdag lta'i grub mtha' ma btang ba'i// bsod nams rang gi ngang gis ni// thar bar mi 'gyur smos ci dgos// bsngos kyang der 'gyur mi srid do// grub mthas brtags pa'i bdag gang ni// med la thar pa med ces dang*// yod la thar pa med zer ba// phyi nang gzhung gi khyad par yin// grub mthas blo kha ma bsgyur ba'i// 'jig rten pa yi tshogs bsags pa// nges par legs dang mngon par mtho// gang du bsngos pa de de'i rgyu// sangs rgyas chos kyi grub mtha' ba// dag dang lugs de'i 'jig rten pa// dag gi tshogs sog khyad par ni// ye shes tshogs sog yod med te// grub mtha' ma zhugs pa dag la// bdag med rigs pas shes pa med// gang zag bdag med pa tsam yang*// shes med tshogs de ga la srid// rig pa'i gnas chen dang po bzhi// sangs rgyas pa dang thun mong ba// shes pa mu stegs byed la'ang yod// de shes thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur// bshad phyir thar pa'i rgyur yang ni// cis mi 'gyur te thar pa ni// ma thob thams cad mkhyen mi srid// ce na de lan 'dir bsams pa// thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa la// gegs byed nyon mongs pa can dang*// de ma yin pa'i ma rig pa// gnyis po rdzas kyi so sor 'byed// mi skye'i chos la bzod thob nas// nyon mongs can min ma rig pa// spong la brtson 'grus brtsams gyur na// zhag bdun tsam gyis de spangs 'thob// byang chub sems dpa' las dang pos// bsod nams tshogs chen sog pa yi// yun tshad bskal pa grangs med gsum// dag las nyung ba 'dir ma bshad// grangs med gsum po ma rdzogs pa'i// de srid thar par gegs byed kyi// nyon mongs can gyi ma rig pa// byang chub sems dpa' spong mi srid// kun tu rgyu ba bzo sbyangs kyis// rig pa'i gnas la mkhas gyur kyang*// ji srid bdag lta ma btang ba// de srid thar pa'i lam ma zhugs// theg chen pa dang nyan thos kyi// ye shes tshogs sog khyad par ni// chos bdag med pa'i ye shes gang*// yod dang med las 'byed mod kyi// rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs nges pa'i// nyan thos 'ga' la phyi rol don// rang stong nyid du shes pa yi// rigs pas theg pa 'bring la 'jug

/gzung 'dzin gnyis ka rang stong du// shes nas ye shes tshogs sog pa// sems tsam pa las ches lhag pa'i// dbu ma pa rnams kun gyi gzhung*// bskyed rim bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa// dgyes pa rdo rje nga yin zhes// rlom par byed des don dam pa'i// bdag gi ngos 'dzin shes na mkhas// de mi shes na mu stegs kyi// bdag lta nyid du thal 'gyur te// gzhi dus dgyes pa rdo rje yi// ngos 'dzin nyid du gang 'chad pa// de la mu stegs byed rnams kyis// bdag tu btags pa yin no kyai// de lta bu yi mu stegs byed// rjes bzung phyir du sangs rgyas kyis// bde gshegs snying pos sems can kun// khyab par gsungs pa ma yin nam// der bshad ji bzhin sgra yin pa// 'gog la sangs rgyas nyid kyis mdor// dngos la gnod byed tshad ma ni// mang du gsungs pa ma yin nam// de phyir bskyed rim rnal 'byor pa// kun gyi dam pa'i bdag de ni// bdag dang bdag med spros pa dag /nye bar zhi de mkhas par slob// de skad 'gro ba mang po ni// rjes 'dzin dge ba'i bshes rnams kyi// tshogs gnyis sog tshul de lta bu'i// slob ma'i tshogs rnams rjes su bzung*// zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// 'jig rten pa rnams rnam shes la// grags pa'i bden rdzun gtsor byas nas// 'jig rten chos la 'jug par byed// grub mtha' pa rnams ye shes la// grags pa'i bden rdzun gtsor byas nas// rang rang gzhung gi 'thad pa yis// grub mtha'i chos la 'jug par byed// rnam shes chos la 'phral gyi ni// 'khrul rgyus bslad pa kun rdzob dang*// brdzun dang bslu ba'i chos can no// des ma bslad par 'jig rten pa// kun la mthun par snang ba ni// dam pa'i don dang mi bslu bar// 'chad pa 'jig rten lugs kyis ni// bden gnyis so so'i rnam bzhag yin// rigs pa pa rnams rang rang gi

/rigs pas gnod med du grub pa// don dam pa dang de las gzhan// kun rdzob bden pa'i rnam bzhag ste// bsod nams tshogs sog 'jig rten gyi// dam pa'i don dang mthun kho na// ye shes tshogs sog phal che ba// 'jig rten lhan skyes dang mi mthun// ci phyir zhe na 'jig rten gyi// dam pa'i don ni phal che ba// sangs rgyas chos kyi grub mtha' ba// kun gyi kun rdzob nyid phyir ro// 'jig rten lugs kyi don dam bden// nyan thos sde pa'i kun rdzob te// de yi lugs kyi ye shes kyi// ngo na dmigs pa min phyir dang*// nyan thos don dam rdul phra rab// sems tsam lugs kyi kun rdzob ste// de yi lugs kyi rigs dam pa'i// rnam dpyad bzod pa min phyir dang*// rnam shes skad cig cha med pa// sems tsam lugs kyi don dam ni// 'dzin pa kun btags nyid kyi phyir// dbu ma'i lugs kyi don dam pa// rang grags kun rdzob de dang de'i// dbang byas bsod nams tshogs chen sog /nyan thos rnams la spyir btang du// bsod nams tshogs ni mang mod kyang*// rang gi thar pa'i don slad du// bsod nams tshogs la brtson mi dgos// rang sangs rgyas rigs bskal pa brgyar// bsod nams tshogs chen sog ces pa// yon tan mngon du byed phyir te// rang gi thar pa'i phyir ma yin// byang chub sems dpas grangs med gsum// bsod nams tshogs chen la 'bad pa// rang gi thar pa mi gnas pa'i// mya ngan 'das pa kho na'i don// de ltar phar phyin theg pa pa'i// bsod nams tshogs chen kun rdzob bden// bye brag theg pa chen po pas// rnam shes rtog med la snang ba// thad sor bzhag nas rtog pa'i ngor// spyir yang mi dmigs sgo nas so// 'di ni 'gal bar mi bsam te// rnam shes ngo na dmigs pa dang*// ye shes ngo na mi dmigs pa// don gcig la ni 'du phyir ro// khyad par sngags kyi theg pa pa'i// bsod nams tshogs sog don dam pa'i// bden pa kho na'i dbang byas kyi// kun rdzob ring du 'gor phyir ro// dper na phyi nang gsang gsum gyi// mchod 'bul kun rdzob dmigs med du// byas nas ye shes las byung ba'i// mchod pa kho na 'bul de bzhin// 'di yang rang gi thar pa ni// sku gsum dbyer med 'grub phyir yin// de ltar bshad pa'i rnam dkar pos// sngags kyi lag len mang shes pa'i// rlom pas khengs rnams gsang sngags kyi// bsod nams tshogs la mkhas phyir yin// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o//

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// gong du bshad ma thag pa de'i// dmigs gsal rtsing zhib du phye nas// cung zad bshad pa 'di yin no// bskyed rim bsod nams tshogs sog gi /rlom tshod don dam kho na ba// yin mod rdzogs pa'i rim pa yi// bsod nams rnam smin lus la ni// gnad du bsnun pa nyid yin phyir// song tshod kho nar ma zad kyi// rlom tshod kyang ni kun rdzob kyi// bden pa nyid du dogs pa yod// de yi tshe na dbang gsum pa'i// nyams myong song tshod rnam smin lus// thog mar yin kyang dngos gzhi ni// zag med bde phyir don dam dang*// sbyor ba'i dus su lha nyid kyi// 'du shes phyir na don dam bden// gsang ba'i dbang gi nyams myong la// lha yi 'du shes med mi rung*// min phyir de yi bsod nams tshogs// kun rdzob bden par 'gal ba med// bsod nams tshogs chen bden pa gnyis// rang gi thar pa kho na'i don// rdzogs rim bsod nams tshogs sog la// kun rdzob srid kyang de med na// ye shes tshogs chen mi 'byung ba'i// rgyu nyid du ni 'chad dgos so// las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas// bde ba'i cha shas bcu drug pa// yongs rdzogs ma nyams pa dus de// skad cig gnyis par zag med bde// sbar yang gong nas gong du ni// 'phos pa'i chags bral bcu drug cha// dkar po'i tshes su ma slebs tsam// de yang 'gyur med bde ba'i lus// yin pas dkar dang nag phyogs kyi// tshes zla rdzogs sangs rgyas mdzad pa'i// dus su dri med rgyud las te// chags bral la sogs chags pa che// kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od// rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i chos 'dzin pa// rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs// lus gnas lus las ma skyes zhes// gsungs pa'i go don bshad dka' ba// thog mar lus tshor bde ba'i phyir// lus la gnas shing de ma thag

/lus dbang bskyed pa'i las kyi rlung*// 'gags pas lus kyi dbang po yang*// 'gags phyir lus kyi tshor ba dang*// bral ba'i bde ba rtog med pa// bde dang stong pa zung 'jug phyir// tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'o// de phyir rdzogs rim bsod nams tshogs// dngos ni zag med bde ba che// sbyor ba'i dus kyi kun rdzob kyang*// phar phyin theg pa'i bsod nams kyi// tshogs sog kun rdzob las khyad 'phags// dper na las kyi rlung lnga po// yon po'i lam du mi rgyu bar// dbu ma'i lam nas rtag rgyu ba// de tshe gnas pa lam byed kyi// brtson pas nyi zla gcig sbyar ba'i// 'gyur med bde ba lhun gyis grub// las rlung rgyu ba ma 'gags pa// de srid nyi ma zla ba yang*// res 'ga' cig gyur skabs 'gar 'bral// rdul dang nyi ma nye ring las// zla ba'i ngo la 'phel 'grib byung*// las rlung ma lus 'gags pa na// nyi zla 'bral ba mi srid do// de phyir rdzogs sangs rgyas blo la// nyi zla lho byang bgrod pa dang*// bcu gnyis khyim du 'jug pa dang*// zla ba'i cha shas 'phel 'grib dang*// yar ngo mar ngo'i dbye ba dang*// dus kyi me dang mun pa yi// nyi zla zos dang btang ba yi// snang ba rang snang la med de// nang gi ye shes dbu ma yin// lam las nam yang mi 'da' dang*// nyi zla cig gyur rang gnas las// gzhan du 'pho ba med phyir ro// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa// so so skye bos nges pa'i don// gang las rtogs shes bsam par bya// lkog tu gyur pa'i don gang yang*// lung dang rigs pa las rtogs kyi// so so skye bo'i mngon sum gyis// dang po rtogs pa yod ma yin// de yang sngags dang phar phyin gyi// lam pas rtogs tshul so sor dbye// pha rol phyin pas lung las ni// rtogs pa yid ches rjes dpog go

/lung de dpyad pa rnam gsum gyis// dag pa rigs pa dag la ltos// rigs pa yis ni de rtogs pa// dngos po stobs shugs rjes dpag ste// gnyis ka'ang bsam byung rigs pa la// ltos phyir rtog pa kho na'o// sngags pas rtogs tshul rnam gnyis te// man ngag dang ni lung las so// lung ni bla ma'i gsung yin te// dpyad gsum sngon du 'gro mi dgos// bla ma'i lung bzhin man ngag gis// myong las yid ches rnam gsum skye// bla ma dang ni rang nyid dang*// rgyud la yid ches rnam pa gsum// nyams su myong tshe nges don la// 'khrul dang rtog pa med shes 'byung*// sgom byung 'khrul med shes de nyid// 'phags pa'i min yang mngon sum gyi// mtshan nyid tshang phyir de de nyid// mtshan nyid theg par sde snod la// bslab sbyangs mthar phyin gyur pa'i tshe// chos nyid lung dang rigs pa yis// rtogs zhes gsungs so man ngag pas// de ma sbyangs kyang bla ma yi// gsung dang rang gi nyams myong ba// mthun pas mngon sum tshad ma dang*// de nas brgyud la yid ches pa// de tshe rjes su dpag pa 'byung*// bsam gtan dngos gzhi la brten pa'i// bde stong zung 'jug rtog dpyod sogs// yan lag lnga ldan du gsungs kyang*// mngon par gsungs pa'i bsam gtan gyi// dngos gzhi mu stegs byed pa dang*// thun mong nyid du bshad dgos phyir// sngags lam pa dang khyad par phye// ci phyir zhe na mngon pa yi// rtog dpyod sgra don 'dzin pa dang*// dga' ba yid bde rtog bcas dang*// bde ba'ang lus tshor la 'chad mod// sngags pas gang la dmigs pa yi// nges don dmigs rnams rtsing zhib dang*// dga' bde'ang lus dang sems kyi ni// tshor ba dag la mi 'char gyi// lhan skyes ye shes rtog bral ba// dga' dang bde bar 'chad phyir ro// de bzhin kho nar ma zad kyi// pha rol phyin par 'phags pa yi// snyoms 'jug brgyad dang thun mong gi

/snyoms 'jug brgyad kyi khyad par phye// thun mong snyoms 'jug brgyad kyi ni// nyer bsdogs zhi rags rnam pa can// thun mong min pa'i 'phags pa yi// nyer bsdogs zag med zhi gnas so// khyad par theg chen 'phags pa ni// zhi rags rnam pa can dag gi /sems la chags bral byed min te// 'dod par skye ba mi spong phyir// khyad par gzhan yang dbye dgos te// pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa dang*// srid par skye rgyu'i nyon mongs pa// ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba// sngags pas de rgyu'i nyon mongs pa// ched du gnyer nas spong ba ni// tshe de nyid la sangs rgya bar// byed dang mi byed khyad par yin// sngags pas nyon mongs lam byed kyi// ched du spong ba min zhe na// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa dang*// rang bzhin lhan skyes ye shes dang*// ngo bo gcig tu 'gyur mi srid// de phyir de lam 'gyur ma yin// 'gyur na phar phyin theg pa yi// gzhung chen kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur// des na sngags kyi nyams len pas// nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog /thog mar rang gi rgyud nyid la// bskyed nas de de'i ngo bo nyid// rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de nyid nyams su myong byed pa'ang*// yang na de de lhar bskyed pas// nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi /dri ma rim gyis 'gag par byed// spang bya de de'i rang bzhin la// chags pa che dang zhe sdang che// gti mug chen po'i ming gis btags// de nyid lam du byed pa la// nyon mongs rnam rtog lam byed zhes// man ngag pa la grags pa yin// phar phyin pa dang man ngag pa// spang bya rgyang ring thag bsring kyang*// thog mar rang rgyud la bskyed nas// de'i ngo bo ngos 'dzin pa// theg pa gnyis kyi khyad par te// spang bya ma 'ongs lkog gyur pa// gdod nas 'phul dang skye bzhin pa// thug phrad nyid du spong ba'o// rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i gzhung las kyang*// gsang sngags pa dang cha mthun par// chags sogs nyon mongs de gzhal bya// de 'jal 'dzin rnam tshad ma dang*// de myong rang rig 'bras bu zhes// gsungs tshe chags sogs blo bur gyi// dri ma dang ni de myong ba'i// 'dzin rnam rang rig rang gsal te// spang gnyen gnyis po dus kun tu// lhan cig gnas gcig tu 'khod kyang*// byis rnams dri mar zhen pa dang*// mkhas rnams gnyen po de bzung nas// dri ma de dang de sel byed// logs nas tshol dgos ma yin par// rang la gnas pa'i ye shes kyis// rang gi nyes pa kun gzhom bya// ces bya ba 'di grub pa'o//

// ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// gsang ba 'dus pa rim lnga yi// lam gyi dngos gzhi zung 'jug ste// bden pa gnyis po sbyor ba'o// gang zhig zung du 'jug ce na// kun rdzob dang ni don dam pa// zung 'jug ngo bo gang zhe na// gnyis po dbyer med gcig gyur pa'o// phyi dus 'di na bden pa gnyis// dbyer med gyur pa mi srid zer// kun rdzob dbye ba yod min zhing*// de yi ngo bo don dam bden// yod min pa dang de'i ngo bo// gang la 'chad pa yin zhe na// sgyu lus kun rdzob bden pa dang*// de'i rang bzhin 'od gsal lo// sgyu ma lta bu'i lus mthong bas// 'od gsal la sgrib de kun rdzob// des de sgrib pa ci zhe na// sgyu ma dang ni der snang ba'i// gzung bya nam yang yod min zhing*// der snang ba la dri ma dang*// ye shes cha gnyis su phye nas// dri ma de la sgyu 'dzin gyi// rnam par rtog pa'i ming btags nas// 'od gsal me'i sregs pa las// ye shes gcig pur lus pa'i tshe// 'od gsal ba zhes brjod pa yin// rgyu 'dzin dri mas ma gos pa'i// 'od gsal ba de slar yang ni// sgyu ma lta bu'i skur bzhengs pa// de la zung 'jug ces byar brjod// 'od gsal ba des sgyu 'dzin gyi// sa bon bcom dang ma bcom las// zung 'jug res 'ga' ya bral du// 'gyur dang mi 'gyur skabs gnyis srid// dang po slob pa'i zung 'jug dang*// phyi ma mi slob pa'i zung 'jug /dbye ba de yang 'od gsal ba// bar chad med lam du gyur dang*// ma gyur pa las phye ba yin// dang po 'phags lam skyes nas te// phyi ma so skye'i dus na'ang 'byung*// zung 'jug dus kyi 'od gsal du// ma zad sgyu ma'i sku de yang*// don dam pa yi bden kho na// yin te spros pa kun bral phyir// bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa la// 'bad rtsol med pa'i skabs de nas// mi slob pa zhes brjod yin gyi// rdzogs sangs rgyas la rag ma las// tshogs gnyis dbyer med sog pa yi// dngos gzhi mi slob zung 'jug ste// mthar phyin tshe na sangs rgyas kyi// zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// chos drug pa rnams 'od gsal ba// lam gyi mthar thug yin par bzhed// gsang ba 'dus par 'od gsal ba// kho nar ma zad zung 'jug gi

/cha shas bar chad med lam dang*// mthar thug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// sgyu lus kun rdzob bden bshad pa// 'od gsal ba la ltos nas der// bshad kyang phar phyin theg pa la// ltos pa'i don dam bden kho na// dbu ma'i lam du ma zhugs pa'i// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal tsam// 'dir bshad 'od gsal ma yin te// rnam rtog sa bon sreg min phyir// de bzhin dbu mar ma son pa'i// rlung sems tsam ni ma dag lus// bskyed byed nyid do der son pa'i// rlung sems las grub sgyu lus so// tshe 'di nyid la sbrul gyi ni// shun pa rjes pa ji bzhin du// rnam smin lus de mi dmigs par// gyur nas sgyu ma'i sku grub pa// gang de longs spyod rdzogs sku yi// rigs 'dra snga ma nyid yin la// 'od gsal ba yi ldog cha nas// ye shes chos sku'i rgyu mthun no// lus 'di'i 'grub byed ngag dben gyi// man ngag kun la ltos pa'i phyir// rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pa las// chu zla lta bu'i lus grub pa// yin phyir gnyug ma gzhi lus zhes// zer ba lung dang mthun ma yin// 'dir bshad rlung ni 'byung ba las// gyur pa ma yin sems de yang*// rnam shes 'khor bcas ma yin no// 'od zer kha dog lnga zhes pa// gzugs brnyan tshul du 'char yin gyi// rang lus 'byung ba bzhi po las// gyur pa'i kha dog ma yin no// dper na sor bsdud nas gsungs pa'i// stong gzugs mtshan nyid ji bzhin du// rnal 'byor rang gi ye shes nyid// rang gi lus su shar ba'o// de bzhin 'od gsal ba yi yang*// rgyu mthun snga ma sems dben te// sems de gzung 'dzin las grol ba'i// rang rig rang gsal nyid du bzhed// gzung 'dzin gnyis las grol byed thabs// ngag dben skabs kyi man ngag las// rlung sems dbu mar 'dzud byed do// sems kyi rnam par dben pa nas// sgyu ma'i sku la 'jug tshe dang*// 'od gsal ba nas zung 'jug tu// 'jug tshe las kyi phyag rgya dang*// bcas pa'i spyod pa rnam gsum po// byed dang mi byed lugs gnyis las// chags can lam dang chags bral zhes// rnam par bzhag las myur lam ni// sgyu ma'i sku la 'jug pa na// med du mi rung ma yin mod// zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// tshe de nyid la 'grub byed kyi// rgyur ni med na mi 'byung ngo*// de phyir spyod pas 'tshams ma 'byor// gang de bar do'i rten nyid la// zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs sangs rgya// bar do mtshan nyid pa gzhan dang*// 'di ni 'dra ba ma yin te// rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa las// byung ba'i bar do yin phyir ro// skabs 'dir 'phags pa yab sras kyi// bzhed pa'i don dam bden pa ni// med par dgag pa'i stong nyid las// gzhan mi 'chad pa la bsams nas// 'od gsal ngos 'dzin med dgag la// 'chad pa de ni 'dir 'byung ba'i// bden 'dzin rtog pa spong byed pa'i// bar chad med lam ngos ma zin// gzhan dag sgyu ma kun rdzob bden// yul du byed pa rjes thob kyi// ye shes rnam par rtog nyid kyang*// spang bya min phyir lam gyi bden// 'od gsal zhes pa stong pa nyid// yul du byed pa'i mnyam bzhag gi

/ye shes lam gyi bden pa la// don dam bden par bshad pa ni// stong pa nyid dang chu la ni// chu bzhin du song la dgongs zhes// zer mod 'phags pa yab sras kyi// phar phyin theg pa'i rnam bzhag dang*// sngags kyi lam rim so so ba'i// rnam bzhag gcig tu bsres pas nongs// rang gzhung nongs pa de bral ba// sngon byon chen po rnams kyi gsung*// thad sor bzhag las nongs srid na'ang*// rdo rje mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod// ces bya ba 'di grub pa'o// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// chos drug lam gyi go rims ni// ma 'chol gyur na so so yi// ngos 'dzin rtogs sla de 'chad do// gtum mo lam gyi rmang rdor ni// bzhag nas de goms gyur pa na// sgyu lus lam gyi gzhung shing du// 'gyur ro gzhan du de las gzhan// rlung sems dbu mar ma zhugs pa'i// gtum mos rnam rtog gsod mi nus/ de ma sod na sgyu lus kyi// lam gyi bsgrub gzhi mi rnyed do// dbu ma'i lam du de 'jug pa// yon po'i lam du rlung rgyu ba// 'gog byed rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*// 'jam rlung yan lag bzhi ldan dang*// rtsub rlung bum pa can sogs so// skabs der ye shes me chen po// rang gi ngang gi 'bar ba las// byung ba'i 'dzag bde zag med du// 'gyur gyi lus tshor bde ba gang*// rtog par skye ba ma yin no// dbu mar zhugs pa'i rlung dang ni// byang chub sems dang ye shes rnams// tshogs pa gcig tu gyur pa las// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus grub pa// de la sgyu ma'i sku zhes bya// 'di la rgyud sde las gsungs pa'i// 'chad tshul rnam pa gnyis dang ni// man ngag pa dang de las gzhan// 'chad pa'i tshul dang gsum zhes bya// dang po dus 'khor rgyud sogs su// gtum mo'i me yis lcags la ni// dngul chu bcings pa ji bzhin du// ma dag lus kyi khams zad nas// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku 'grub gsungs// gsang ba 'dus par las kyi rlung*// dgu brgya phrag rnams 'gags pa las// mi 'gyur bde ba dgu brgya phrag

/nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'grub byed kyi// ye shes rlung gyur 'od zer lnga// grub nas rnam smin phung po rnams// brjes te sgyu lus 'grub par gsungs// man ngag pa rnams rnam smin lus// 'di nyid sgyu ma lta bur ni// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i tshul// goms par gyur nas de mthong ba// sgyu lus yin zhes gsungs ba yod// gzhan dag gnyug ma gzhi yi lus// man ngag stobs kyis goms pa las// rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i lus// rnam smin phung po'i khong dag tu// ji srid 'tsho bar bzhugs zhes zer// rnam smin phung po 'ja' bzhin du// dmigs med gyur pa ma bzod nas// de skad zer ba yin mod kyi// 'phags pa chen po'i mnyam gzhag tu// ma dag phung po'i snang ba med// rjes la snang ba 'byung srid kyang*// 'khrul snang yin phyir yong mi 'dod// de ltar shes na sgyu lus kyi// rnam bzhag gnas la mkhas par 'gyur// rlung sems dbu mar ma zhugs pa'i// gnyug ma gzhi lus ga nas btsal// rnam smin snang ba ma 'gags pa'i// sgrub pos sgyu lus ji ltar mthong*// rnam smin phung por mi 'dzin cing*// sgyu ma'i lus la mngon zhen pa'i// 'dzin pa yod na bden pa gnyis// zung du 'jug par mi 'gyur bas// sgyu ma'i zhen pa spang bya'i phyir// 'od gsal gzung 'dzin dang bral ba// sgrub pos 'bad nas btsal bar bya// zhen pa gang la skye ba'i gzhi// gtum mos bsgrubs pa'i sgyu lus de// rten dang brten par bcas pa yi// dkyil 'khor nyid du gsal mthong tshe// so so skye bo'i bsgrub po la// mngon par zhen pa ngang gis skye// zhen pas bcings pa'i sgyu lus de// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rgyur mi 'gyur// gzung 'dzin rtog pa spong phyir du// gzhi dus rang bzhin 'od gsal de// lam gyi 'od gsal nyid 'gyur phyir// man ngag stobs kyis bsgrub par bya// de ltar grub pa'i 'od gsal de// lam gyi 'bras bu yin gsungs mod// de la bar chad med lam dang*// rnam grol gnyis su don gyi grub// 'od gsal zhes pa gang zag dang*// chos rnams nyid kyi dbang byas pa'i// gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ye shes te// 'di la rig bya rig byed gnyis// tha dad gyur pa med mod kyang*// de nyid kyis ni de myong bar// tha snyad mdzad pa'i shes bya blos// shes bya de dang de myong ba// chos dang gang zag bdag med pa// rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum mo// gang zag nyid du 'dzin pa yi// zhen pas bcings pa'i rang gsal tsam// nyams su myong ba'i rang rig ni// mu stegs byed pa dag la'ang yod// de phyir gsang ba 'dus pa las// gsungs pa'i don dam byang chub sems// skabs 'di'i 'od gsal nyid du bshad// phyi rabs pa dag skabs 'di yi// 'od gsal ngos 'dzin stong pa nyid// med par dgag la 'chad pa dang*// med dgag de nyid mngon sum du// rtogs pa'i bde ba chen po la// 'chad ces zer ba gnyis byung mod// snga mas rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sar// ye shes med par khas blangs zhing*// phyi mas spyi mtshan dngos yul du// byed pa'i mngon sum khas blangs so// rmi lam rnal 'byor yan lag ste// man ngag stobs kyi tshogs gnyis po// myur du rdzogs pa'i thabs chen po// sad dang rmi lam gnyis ka yi// 'od gsal rang bzhin gcig yin mod// sad rmi gnyis kyi bsod nams tshogs// khyad par shin tu che zhe na// sgyu lus 'byongs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// sad rmi khyad par yod min te// thams cad sgyu ma'i ngang nyid du// khyad par med par rtogs phyir ro// rlung sems dbu mar tshud gyur pa'i// rmi lam bsod nams tshogs chen po'i// bogs 'don rmi lam zad pa yi// gnyid kyi 'od gsal ye shes kyi// tshogs chen po yi bogs 'don te// gnyid dang sad pa'i skabs kyi ni// tshogs la khyad par shin tu mang*// dper na tha mal gnyid dang ni// sad pa'i skabs kyi 'char sgo la// sad la nam yang mi 'grub pa// 'ga' zhig rmi lam du 'char bzhin// dus kyi 'khor lor rmi lam dang*// gnyid 'thug lam gyi spang byar bshad// skabs 'dir lam du bshad pa ni// rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa dang*// de las gzhan pa'i khyad par ro// de der tshud nas gnyid dang ni// rmi lam srid pa min ce na// man ngag pa la grags pa yi// rmi lam gnyid dang de'i 'od gsal// gang yin khyed kyis ngos ma zin// bar do'i lam gyi rnam bzhag tshe// phal pa dang ni khyad par can// gnyis kyi rnam dbye ma phye na// 'dir 'chad bar do ngos mi zin// khyad par can de gang zhe na// 'od gsal mngon sum mthong gyur nas// rkyen gzhan dbang gis spyod pa gsum// gang rung tsam yang ma grub par// 'chi ba'i 'od gsal mngon byas tshe// dbu mar tshud pa'i rlung sems las// gang grub sgyu ma lta bu'i lus// mngon du gyur pa'i lus can de// longs spyod rdzogs skur 'tshang rgya ba// de nyid bar do'i rten la ni// 'tshang rgya ba yi rnam bzhag yin// rlung sems dbu mar ma tshud pa'i// rnal 'byor pa'am phal pa zhig

/shi nas bar dor skyes pa'i tshe// de la de nyid du shes nas// lam la slob par byed do zhes// man ngag pa kun 'chad mod kyi// skabs 'dir 'chad pa'i bar do yi// lam gyi gtso bo de ma yin// 'pho ba dang ni grong 'jug kyang*// rlung sems dbu mar tshud bzhin pas// yin gyi gzhan pas nam yang min// ci phyir zhe na gzung 'dzin gyi// lam nas 'phos pas 'khor ba yi// lam du 'jug pa nyid yin phyir// dbu ma'i lam nas 'phos gyur na// phal cher thar pa'i lam du ste// tha na'ang ngan 'gro'i lam khegs phyir// mngon par mtho las gzhan mi srid// grong du 'jug pa'ang rnal 'byor pa'i// gzung 'dzin lam nas tha mal pa// gzhan gyi gzung 'dzin lam zhig tu// 'jug la dgos pa ci zhig yod// der ma zhugs kyang tshe 'phos nas// 'khor ba'i lam du 'jug par sla// rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pa yi// rnal 'byor rang gi rnam smin lus// tshe bsring byed par ma nus na// gsang sngags lam gyi rten gyur pa'i// skyes bu khams drug ldan pa'i lus// tshe 'phos gyur kyang lus de yi// rtsa khams ma nyams pa zhig gi /dbu mar rang gi dbu ma nas// 'phos pas gzhan gyi lus can de// rnal 'byor par ni sngon bzhin 'gyur// rten de nyid la rnal 'byor gyi// lhag ma ma lus kun bsgrubs nas// tshe 'di nyid la rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// skabs 'dir sa skya paṇa chen gyis// nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid// mi la yan chad de las med// zhes pa'i dgongs pa 'chad zer ba// mang po rang dang gzhan gyi ni// gzhung lugs ji bzhin mi shes par// rmongs pas sbyar ba'i 'chal gtam dag /dbyangs su len pa 'di ltar byung*// mi la man la gdams ngag de// gtan nas med ces zer ba dang*// la la dbang bskur dang 'brel ba'i// chos drug mi la man chad du// yod pa min zhes zer ba byung*// rang phyogs nyid la zhen pa yi// 'dod pas bcings pa'i rjes 'jug dag

/mkhas pas chos spong las bsags nas// rang gi phyogs la smod min nam// 'o na dgongs pa ci zhe na// grub chen rdo rje rgyal po ni// rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa'i// chos kyis thog mar grol gyur kyang*// phyi nas phrin las skyong ba'i tshe// nā ro paṇa chen kho na yi// brgyud 'dzin nyid du zhal bzhes pa// de la mthing bslad mdzad pa'i tshe// lam 'bras dang ni phyag rgya che// nā ro'i brgyud 'dzin de nyid las// byung ba min zhes zer ba yi// dogs pa khong nas bslangs gyur nas// rje btsun mi la yan chad du// nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid// de las gzhan pa'i lam 'bras sogs// brgyud pa de la yod ma yin// gsungs pa yin no gal te yang*// nged kyis lam 'bras ma bsgoms shing*// bsgoms kyang des grol min no zhes// zer na rang gi lugs dang 'gal// zhes pa sa skya paṇa chen gyi// dgongs pa yin no gal te yang*// mi la yan chad la yod pa'i// dbang dang 'brel ba'i chos drug gi /dbang de gang yin dri bar bya// de ngo shes nas de 'og tu// dbang de med pa'i shes byed ci// des na rang gi rgyud pa la// zhen pa spang bya ma yin mod// lung dang rigs pa med bzhin du// chos spong ba ni bsrung bar bya// 'o na grub chen phag gru pas// rang nyid grol ba'i chos de yis// gzhan dag rjes su mi 'dzin ci// zhe na gdul bya'i dbang po dang*// 'tshams pa'i chos bstan bya phyir dang*// 'jug pa bde zhing rtogs sla ba'i// chos kyi gzhan smin mdzad pa yin// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// zung 'jug 'khor lo sdom pa yi// rim pa lnga pa'i nyams len gyi// rtsa ba 'di zhes ngos bzung bya// thog mar lus kyi dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur thob pa'i bla ma ni// 'khor lo sdom pa dngos nyid las// skabs 'di'i byin brlabs blang bya ba// tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod byas pa'i// bla ma'i thugs las zung 'jug gi

/ye shes slob ma'i snying khar ni// man ngag stobs kyis blang bar bya// de tshe de las de 'phos pa'i// lus ngag sems kyi rtags rnams ni// rab dang yang rab 'bring tha ma// shar na byin brlab thob zhes bya// de 'dra de la ji skad du// gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid// zhes dang bla ma'i byin brlabs kyi// skad cig nyid la grol zhes gsungs// byin brlabs thob pa'i slob ma des// bla ma'i thugs las gang 'phos pa'i// bde stong zung 'jug rab 'bring mtha'// gang 'phos de yi rgyun skyong ba'i// rim pa lnga po 'dir gsungs pa// re res kyang ni mthar thug gi /go 'phang thob par gsungs pa las// re shig gnyis su bsdu bar bya// rang byin brlabs pa'i rim pa dang*// sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa yis// phyi rol yul la sems 'phro ba// thams cad snying gi thig ler bsdu// 'di yis stong pa sgrub phyir te// gzung 'dzin rtog pa bkag phyir ro// nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa ni// phyag rgya bzhi po la brten nas// bde ba sgrub pa zhes bya ste// 'dzag med nor bu 'gengs phyir ro// de ltar rim pa gsum po yis// stong pa grub par gyur rjes su// bsgrubs pa'i bde ba zag med ste// rnam par rtog kun khegs phyir ro// dza len dha ra'i rim pa ni// 'bar ba'i bde ba gang bzung ba// bsam mi khyab pa'i rim pa yis// stong pa nyid du ngo sprod pas// bde ba sngon du song ba la/ stong pas rgyas gdab zhes byar bshad// stong pa 'di yang gang zhe na// rigs pas gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshe// spros pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral ba'i// rang stong nyid du bshad kyang sla// sgom pas bde ba nyams myong tshe// gzung 'dzin rtog pa kun bral ba// gzhan stong zhes byar mkhas rnams bzhed// bde mchog rim lnga'i bsdus pa'i don// dril bu zhabs gzhung sa skya pa'i// rje btsun gyis bkral snying po'i don// bshad pas bde chen gnas thob shog/

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i// chos kyi ngos 'dzin bshad pa las// go rim bde blag rtogs par bya// thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro cig /bshad pa 'di yang man ngag gi /lus yongs rdzogs pa cig yin te// thabs dang shes rab kun tshang phyir// bla ma dang ni rdor sems kyi// bsgom bzlas don tshang a yig la// dmigs rtse gtad pas bdag med pa'i// don rtogs sdig sgrib kun dag 'gyur// dngos gzhi chos tshan drug po ni// lam gyi rten dang lam dngos dang*// yan lag gsum du bsdu bar bya// gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar ni// lam gyi rten yin 'di med na// lus 'di bde stong rten mi rung*// 'di yang rlung gi rnal 'byor ni// mthar phyin pa la rag las te// srog thur gcig tu 'dres pa yi// bum pa can med 'di mi 'byung*// de phyir chos tshan dang po 'dir// rlung gi rnal 'byor kha bskang bya// bum pa can yang dbu ma yi// gnas su tshud pa gtso bo ste// der ma tshud pa'i bum pa can// drod tsam 'dren pa'i rgyur srid kyang*// gzung 'dzin bral ba'i bde ba ni// 'dren par nus pa ma yin no// skabs 'dir gtum mo zas za zhes// bya ba bde 'dren nus la brjod// 'bar 'dzag dngos su ma gsungs kyang*// shugs la 'grub pa nyid ces bya// lam gyi dngos po dug gsum gyi// gnyen po nyid du bsgom bya ba// mngon gyur mgo non sgyu lus dang*// drung nas 'byin byed 'od gsal lo// dang po spyir ni chos rnams kun// sgyu ma nyid du 'char byed dang*// bye brag rang lus rten par bcas// sgyu ma nyid du shar ba las// chags sdang ngang gis grol ba na// ye shes lhun gyis grub par 'gyur// skabs 'di'i sgyu lus gtum mo yis// bsgrubs pa'i 'ja' lus nyid du ni// dngos su bshad pa med mod kyang*// gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar ni// mthar phyin pa las 'ja' tshon lus// grub pas chags sdang dbyings su zhi// gtum mo rnam rtog gsod byed kyi// rang sems dbu mar zhugs pa na// kun la mtshan mar mi 'dzin pas// sgyu ma lta bu ngang gis 'char// sgyu mar zhen na sman nyid kyang*// dug tu song dang mtshungs gyur pas// 'od gsal ba yis de sbyangs pas// gti mug rang sangs lhun gyis grub// 'od gsal zhes pa gzhi lam gyi// gnas skabs gcig tu 'dres pa ste// gzhan gyis gti mug drungs mi 'byin// de yang thog mar gzung 'dzin dang*// bral ba'i zhi gnas sngon song nas// 'od gsal nyams su myong ba'i tshe// lhag mthong mngon du gyur zhes bya// gzung 'dzin bral bas bdag med kyi// don grub 'od gsal nyams myong tshe// gti mug rang sar dag pa yin// de la lam gyi dngos po dang*// 'bras bu nyid du rim gyis dbye// lam gyi yan lag bogs 'don dang*// le lo can la spogs chog dang*// 'byor pas dman 'ga' 'bras bu la// sbyor tshul gsum gyi bsdu bar bya// rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag ni// tshogs chen gnyis kyi bogs 'don ste// gnyid kyi 'od gsal ye shes dang*// rmi lam nang du bsod nams tshogs// mang po rdzogs par sla phyir ro// sad pa'i 'od gsal ma myong bar// gnyid kyi 'od gsal mi 'grub te// rgyu med pa las 'bras mi 'byung*// grub nas 'od gsal 'di yi stobs// snga ma las lhag ci yi phyir// zhe na gnyid sad 'dres phyir dang*// gnyid kyi 'od gsal gzung 'dzin gyi// rtog pa 'gog par sla phyir ro// rmi lam gzung 'dzin rtsa dag tu// rlung zhugs pa las byung gyur kyang*// 'od gsal dbu ma'i nang nyid du// rlung sems 'dus pa las byung ngo*// de phyir rmi lam nying 'khrul dang*// 'od gsal 'khrul pa med pa yin// rmi lam ngang du zhing sbyong dang*// sangs rgyas mchod dang sems can ni// smin par byed pa ches sla ste// sad tshe nam yang mi 'grub pa// rmi lam nyid du 'grub phyir ro// rmi lam ngang du gang byung ba// des de'i go mi chod snyam na// 'jig rten pa la mi chod kyang*// mkhas la shin tu go chod de// srid zhi mnyam pa nyid rtogs nas// sad rmi khyad par med phyir ro// de phyir rmi lam bzung sla bas// nges par zin pa nyid du bya// 'od gsal rtogs pa sngon song ba'i// rmi lam snang ba gang shar ba// de la nying 'khrul rang dag ces// zer te 'jig rten phal pa yi// rmi lam dag dang mi mtshungs phyir// mi mtshungs pa de ci zhe na// dang po gzung 'dzin rtsar zhugs pa'i// rlung gis 'jig rten lhan skyes kyi// sems kyang mang du slad phyir dang*// gnyis pa dbu mar zhugs sems kyis// ye shes snang ba sna tshogs pa// spro nus phyir dang spros med kyi// ngang la mnyam par 'jog nus phyir// dper na mkha' la zla snang ba// gdod nas 'khrul zhing chu nang du// de snang yang 'khrul yin mod kyi// rnal 'byor stobs kyi mun khang gi

/mkha' la zla ba shar snang ba// de tshe 'khrul snang gnyis ka yang*// rang sang dag pa yin pa'i phyir// dpe 'di nyid kyi sgo nas ni// nying 'khrul rang dag shes par bya// 'pho ba ma sgoms 'tshang rgya ni// brtson 'grus zhan la spogs chog ste// rang sems dbu ma'i nang du ni// ma tshud pa la 'di mi 'byung*// gzung 'dzin rlung la zhon pa yi// sems ni 'khor ba las mi 'da'// ye shes rlung la chibs pa yi// sems ni rig 'dzin gnas su ste// gnas der thabs lam zab mo dang*// 'jal nas myur du sangs rgya bar// dgongs kyi de las gzhan du ni// tshogs chen gnyis po tshul bzhin du// rdzogs pa sngon du ma song bar// sangs rgyas srid pa ma yin no// bar do rgyal ba longs sku ni// 'od gsal stobs kyis stong pa nyid// rtogs shing ye shes tshogs bsags kyang*// rnam par g.yeng dang 'byor pa yi// stobs chung ba las bsod nams tshogs// bde ba chen po tshul bzhin du// rdzogs par bsgrub ma nus pa 'ga'// bde stong zung du 'jug pa yi// ye shes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// tshe 'di nyid la ma grub pa// 'chi khar 'od gsal mngon gyur nas// dbu ma'i rlung gi bzhon pa can// tha mal bar do'i gzugs dang ni// 'dra mtshungs pa zhig mngon gyur nas// tshe snga ma la man ngag rnams// shes dang goms pa'i stobs dran nas// kha sbyor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// mngon du byed pa'i tshul de ni// khams drug ldan pa'i lus rten la// byed las shin tu sla ba ste// 'di ni ye shes 'ba' zhig pa'i// lus rten nyid la yin phyir ro// chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs kyang*// spyod pa gsum po ma grub pas// bar do'i rten la kha sbyor sku// mngon du byed pa mi rigs te// spyod pa khams drug ldan lus la// yin gyi bar do rlung sems tsam// yin phyir skye ba gzhan rgyud dgos// zer ba byung mod de mi 'thad// spyod pas 'tshams sbyor byed dgos pa// tshe gcig nyid la 'tshang rgya'i don// bden mthong 'tshang rgya ma nus pa// bar dor bde chen lhun gyis grub// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o//

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi// rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa ni// sngon du 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor dang*// dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor rnam gsum mo// sngon 'gro spyi dang mthun par ni// bsod nams tshogs chen bsags byas nas// dngos gzhi'i thog mar ye shes kyi// tshogs sog sngon du btang byas te// bcom ldan dpa' bo gcig pa yi// bskyed rim gsal snang mched byas nas// rwa rtse gnyis su byang sems kyi// thig le bkrag cing 'tsher ba bsams// de nas thig le ba thag tsam// mgrin par 'dus pa snying ga yi// 'jam dbyangs gur kum gzhon nu la// thim ste bde bas lus gang ba// 'dzin med nyid du gnas par bya// de ltar sku yi rdo rje ni// grub nas brtan por bya ba yi// mtshan mo dur khrod gnas su ni// 'jigs pa med par rgyu zhing bsgom// bum pa'i dbang dang 'brel ba yi// rdzogs rim de ltar goms byas nas// gsang ba'i dbang dang 'brel ba yi// gsung gi rdo rje sgrub par bya// rdo rje'i bzlas pa sngon 'gro bas// rlung gi rnal 'byor 'byongs pa na// rtsa gsum po dang 'khor lo bzhi// gsal gdab gtum mo'i 'bar 'dzag gi /rang byin brlab pa goms par bya// de nas gsum pa'i dbang dang ni// 'brel ba'i mtshan ma gyen 'greng gi /rdo rje ro langs mar bcas pa'i// ye shes grub nas bde ba dang*// stong pa zung du 'jug pa ni// goms pas rim gnyis mthar phyin te// bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed po yi// go 'phang myur du thob par shog /grub chen a mo gha badzra// de yis skyo ston 'od 'byung la// de nas rgyud de 'bri khung gi /lo tstsha nas rgyud mthu stobs kyi// dbang phyug dge ba rgyal mtshan las// byung ba legs pa'i blo yis sbyar// 'di yang sems dpa' brag dkar bas// gsol ba btab pa'i ngor yin no//

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// dpal ldan gshin rje gshed dmar po'i// lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs par// dbang bskur thob pa'i bsgrub pa pos// spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin nyid la// byin brlabs zhus nas der skyes pa'i// ye shes thun bzhir nyams len bya// 'di ni lam 'bras las gsungs pa'i// lam zab rnal 'byor ji bzhin pa// gdod nas grub pa'i ye shes ni// byin rlabs dus su mngon gyur pa// de nyid dpe yi ye shes ste// rgyun du skyangs pas 'chi ka 'am// bar do tshun chad 'jig rten las// 'das pa'i ye shes mngon du 'gyur// skabs der shin tu spros med kyi// ye shes myur du skye dka' ba// de la spogs pa'i cho ga ni// rnam rtog 'od gsal zhes bya ba// byin brlabs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyis// lus sems sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// phyi rol yul gyi g.yeng ba kun// bu ga dgu nas nang du bsdu// yul can rnam par rtog pa la// bsres nas mar me ltar gsal ba// spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil bar// gyen du 'phur zhing mthur du ni// 'dril bar yang yang yang bsams nas// snying ga'i dkar nag 'tshams phye ste// dmar zhing 'dril ba nam mkha' la// skar mda' lta bur cher song nas// phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po yi// 'gram du re zhig cher gsal ba// de nas nam mkha'i dbyings dang ni// gcig tu bsres pas rang rig pa'i// bde ba chen po nyid 'gyur gyi// chad pa'i stong par song min no// de tshe rnam rtog dang bral ba'i// lus de bya sgro rlung gis ni// bteg pa lta bur bde ba can// dag pa'i zhing du bsres par bsams// mnyam bzhag de las myur langs te// rnam rtog 'od gsal bsgom pa yi// dge ba gshin rje gshed por bsngo// shin tu spros med man ngag 'di// dbang bskur bzhi pa'i nyams myong gi

/mthar thug yin no tshe gcig la// gshed po'i go 'phang rnyed 'dod na// gsang ba'i dbang dang gsum pa yi// rnal 'byor nyams su blang bya'i phyir// rang byin rlob pa'i rim pa dang*// rdo rje 'jigs byed rnal 'byor zhes// bya ba'i ming can lam 'bras kyi// shes rab ye shes dbang bskur gyi// nyams len dag dang cig tu bsgrub// de skad 'di yang brag dkar bas// gsol ba btab ngor bkra shis so// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas// thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid la// bla ma rgyud pa'i man ngag gi /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rje 'brang nas// bskyed rim yan lag bzhi rdzogs dang*// rdzogs rim phar phyin theg pa yi// zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba dang*// 'pho ba rnal 'byor bla med bzhin// thun mong thun mong min pa yi// sngon 'gro rnal 'byor bla med pa'i// nyams len spyi dang mthun pa yang*// gong ma'i man ngag dag las byung*// bskyed rim mngon par byang chub lnga// rjes mthun pa 'dis 'khor ba yi// mngal skyes la sogs skye ba'i gnas// ma lus sbyong bar nus byas nas// sku yongs rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis// tha mal rnam rtog ma lus spong*// rang snying sgo nga lta bur ni// bsam pa stong ba'i byang chub ste// de nang padma zla ba dang*// phyag mtshan gyi ni khu rdul dang*// bar do'i rnam shes nyid sbyong byed// de las 'od zer cher 'phros pas// snod bcud ma lus dmigs med du// byas pas ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs// tshur 'dus pa las dam tshig pa'i// sgo gsum skye mched byin brlabs te// ye shes spyan drangs dbang bskur ba// tshang bas spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /gzugs sku lhun gyis grub pa'o// sngags bzlas pa dang byang chub sems// zhi lhag zung du sbrel ba las// chos kyi sku las thag mi ring*// 'pho ba sbyong dang las la sbyar// thog mar rtsa gsum gsal btab nas// rlung sems dbu ma nyid du gzhug

/der ma zhugs pa'i 'pho ba ni// ngal ba 'bras bu don med do// de phyir rtsa gsum 'dus mdor ni// chos 'byung nang gi zla ba la// rang sems 'od zer lnga pa bsam// dbu ma'i nang gi snying gar ni// yi dam thugs rje chen po bsgom// tshangs pa'i bu ga'i g.yas g.yon du// bla ma 'od dpag med pa yi// zhabs kyi mthil gnyis gzhag par bsam// 'og rlung cung zad 'then pa las// sems las 'od zer sngon po gcig /'phar nas snying ga'i yi dam la// g.yas su bskor nas spyi gtsug gi /haṃ la thug pas tshangs sgo phye// slar log sngar gyi gnas su thim// slar yang 'od zer dmar po sogs// 'phar bsdud snga ma ltar byas nas// lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig tu// rtags thon ma gyur bar du bsgom// rtags thon gyur tshe btang snyoms bya// tshe grub pa'i mchog tu 'gyur// de skad 'di yang brag dkar bas// gsol ba btab ngor bkra shis so// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag byas nas// ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo yis// grub pa'i mgon po tshe dpag med// bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas// tho rangs dus su skyabs 'gro dang*// sems bskyed stong pa nyid bsgoms nas// smin 'tshams thad kyi nam mkha' la// pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥdamar po// de las 'od 'phros nam mkha'i khams// kun khyab sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs// tshur 'dus tshe dpag med mgon po// bzhengs te thugs gar thal sbyar ba'i// dbus gnas 'chi med bdud rtsi yis// khengs pa'i lhung bzed thugs gar 'dzin// dar dang rin chen rgyan spras shing*// zur phud lnga ldan spyi gtsug gi /ral pas rting pa'i bar du sleb// gnas gsum po'i yi ge las// 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs te// dbang bskur rigs lngas dbu brgyan no// de nas rlung ro gcig bsal bas// lhung bzed la phog de'i rkyen gyis// bdud rtsi 'phyur zhing babs pa rnams// rang gi kha sna ba sbu yi// bu ga rnams su sim gyur pa'i// dmigs pas rngub par gang nus dang*// steng rlung mnan zhing 'og rlung yang*// 'then te bum pa can sgrub bya// de ltar bum pa can gsum dang*// gzungs sngags sum brgya spel byas nas// mi skyo'i bar du bsgrub par bya// de ltar zhag bdun bsgrubs pa yis// tshe zad pa yang zla ba bdun// zla ba bdun du thun gcig po// chag med gyur na tshe zad pa'ang*// lo brgyar 'tsho ba yin zhes gsungs// sngags kyi mgo 'dren oṃ yin te// a ma ra ṇi 'chi ba med// dzī wanti zhes srog gi rgyun// ye swāhā ni gzhi tshugs shig

/dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las gsungs// 'di yang sems dpa' brag dkar ba'i// zhal ngor legs pa'i blo yis sbyar// slar yang chos tshan bcu gsum po'i// 'bri po rkong dbon chos rgyal lo// // ༄༅// swasti/ thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal nas// bsngo ba dang ni smon lam gyi// khyad par sngon du gang bshad pa// bsngo ba gang yin smon lam ste// smon lam thams cad der ma nges// gnas dang gnas ma yin pa yi// smon lam dbye ba rnam pa gnyis// bsngo rgyu'i rdzas can smon lam gyis// gzhan du 'gyur na bsngo ba ste// bsngo mi dgos dang bsngos gyur kyang*// mi 'gyur bsngo ba don med de// de 'dra smon pas smon byed pa// smon lam don med ma yin no// gang gis bsngo dang gang du dang*// ji ltar bsngo ba gsum bshad bya// dang po dge rtsa byed po nyid// yin gyis gzhan pas de mi bsngo// des de 'grub na 'bad med du// grol bar 'gyur dang rang nyid kyi// ma bsngos nyes pa kun grol 'gyur// de lta mod kyi gzhan dag gis// byas pa'i dge la yi rang ba// rang gi bsngo rgyu'i dge bar ni// gang bshad de yang rang gis byas// gnyis pa mngon par mtho ba dang*// nges legs dbye ba'ang rnam pa gsum// nges legs mchog tu bsngos gyur na// mngon par mtho ba zhar la 'grub// dman pa'i nges legs su bsngos na// mngon par mtho dang 'gal 'gyur te// 'khor ba spong dang mi spong ba'i// nges legs gnyis kyi dbye bas so// mu stegs byed kyis gang bsngos pa// srid pa'i rtse las 'da' mi srid// bdag tu lta bas rmongs gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas pa 'ga'i bsngo ba yang*// mya ngan 'das su bsngo min te// mu stegs byed pa'i bsngo ba bzhin// rang nyid sangs rgyas su gyur zhes// bsngo bar byed pos bdag khas blangs// byas pa'i tshe na mu stegs bzhin// btags pa tsam gyis nga nyid ni// blo yis mi dmigs par byas nas// don dam pa de sangs rgyas su// gyur zhes smon par byed de yang*// smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed tsam// yin mod bsngo bar mi 'gyur te// bde gshegs snying po bsngo rgyu yi// rdzas su rung ba min phyir ro// rgyas 'gyur rigs kyis gsos btab pa'i// rang bzhin gnas rigs myang 'das su// smon lam btab pas lhag med tshe// dge rtsa ma lus zad par 'gyur// de nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su// smon lam btab pas sangs rgyas tshe// mi zad brgyad cu mngon du 'gyur// gsum pa ji ltar bsngo ba ni// don dam dpyod byed rigs pa dang*// de yis drangs pa'i ye shes ngor// 'khor gsum mi dmigs par byas nas// bsngo bar byed do gang zag tu// dmigs na thar par mi 'gyur zhing*// chos su dmigs na kun mkhyen du// byed pa'i bsngo bar 'gyur mi srid// de lta mod kyi rnam shes ngor// 'khor gsum snang cha ma dor bas// bsngos na nyan thos su smon yang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur// bsngo ba rnam par bzhag pa yi// tshigs su bcad pa 'di grub pas// sbyin po rnams kyis yon phul ba// nges par don yod nyid du 'gyur//

// ༄༅// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ chos tshan brgya dang brgyad po ni// thog mtha' bar du dge ba yi// rgyan mang pos ni spras pa na// thub pa'i gsung bzhin yid du 'ong*// de ltar sbyar bas chos dang ni// chos min rnam par 'byed mkhas pa// mang pos thub pa'i bstan pa ni// lang 'tsho nyid du byed par shog /'phrog byed rkang pa'i dug gis ni// lan brgyar sngags pa'i lam gsum pa// bdud rtsir byed pa'i mu stegs can// thams cad chos kyi ngom byed shog /chos tshan brgya dang brgyad po yi// dngul dkar me long dwangs pa la// chos dang chos ma yin pa yi// gzugs brnyan gsal bar shar ba na// de dang de yi rnam dbye la// mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed par shog /mkhas gang nyin byed gsal po ni// phra dog sprin gyis mi 'grib cing*// btsun po'i dpag bsam nyon mongs pa'i// 'khril shing bde bas ma bcings par// nam yang sbrul gyi snying po can// min pa'i tsandan ljon phreng gi /lo 'bras phyogs bcur rgyas pa yi// rtse mo mkha' la reg par shog /de ltar mkhas btsun bzang po yi// nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang*// rgyu skar tshogs pa'i rgyan phreng gis// mtshan yang nyi ma ltar byas shing*// nyin yang sprin gyis mi bsgrib par// thub bstan mar ngo zad gyur nas// yar ngo'i cha shas yongs rdzogs pa// mkha' las gzhan du ma 'phos par// bstan 'dzin bde 'byung bgrang yas pa// kun gyi gtsug rgyan 'dzin pa dang*// nyin mor byed pas lha yi lam// nam yang btang ba med bzhin du// rnam dpyod ri khrod la dga' ba'i// gtsug rgyan 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /nyi ma dang ni zla ba yang*// sgra gcan lam du gcig gyur nas// dus min dpa' bo mthar byed pa'i// dus kyi 'khor lor bdag gyur cig /ces chos tshan brgya dang brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i sbyar yig rnga chen gyi lo zhes bya ba rtsom pa po'i rang lo don lnga pa la/

dpal glang ri thang gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba yin no// dpal phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du bsgreng ba la mkhas par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ tshogs gnyis chu gter dbus las legs 'ongs shing*// mkhyen brtse cha shas rdzogs pa'i 'od dkar can// mtshan dpe'i ri dwags mtshan mas rnam mdzes pa'i// thub dbang smra ba'i zla bas mgon mdzod cig /mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung zhing*// thugs rje pad dkar 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// zab dang rgya che'i chos la mnga' mdzad pa// gangs can bstan pa'i rtsa lag sa skya pa'i// legs bshad lang 'tsho gsar pa'i mdzes sdug kun// gang thugs gsal ba'i me long la 'khod cing*// snyan rgyud gdams pa'i chu bo ma lus pa// blo gros kun dgar mdzad pa'i dga' ston gyi// 'gro 'di'i rgud pa sel mdzad legs pa'i blos// legs bshad nor bu'i do shal rim pa yis// thub bstan gzhal med khang mtho brgyan 'os zhes// gsol 'debs sras kyi thu bo sems dpa' che'i// zhal ngor zab dang rgya che ba'i// chos tshan rmad byung brgya dang brgyad// don bzang rnar snyan yid 'ong ba// ston pa'i gsung las gzhan du min// glegs bam 'di ni a shwad tha// yid kyi re ba ci yang skong*// thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me ste// ngan rtog tshang tshing drwa ba'ang bsreg /gang 'dis thub bstan nor bu yi// dri ma rigs pa'i chu yis bkrus// yid ches lung gis byi dor byas// legs bshad rgyal mtshan rtse mor bkod// gangs can khor yug mdzes pa'i legs bshad gtam// 'phrul yig ri bong gzugs 'dzin 'od dkar can// mi zad par gyi ngos la bskrun pa yi// 'kho dgu'i yo byad ma tshang med stsol ba// bsod nams ye shes tshogs la dbang 'byor zhing*// bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i phrin las kyis// dpal ldan skal ba bzang po'i gdul bya kun// skyong mdzad gang des 'jam mgon bla ma yi// bka' drin bsab phyir mngon par 'du byas pa'i// rab dkar dge ba'i chu 'dzin yid 'ong bas// 'jam mgon thugs kyi mkha' dbyings mdzes byas nas// skal ldan rma bya'i yid la chos kyi char// ci yang babs nas thub bstan mdzes byed shog/

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
